: CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift: : CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift mutation in the C-terminal regulatory domain (e.g., S338X, R334X) in Waldenström macroglobulinemia (WM). CXCR4 WHIM-like mutations co-occur with MYD88 L265P in ~30-40% of MYD88-mutant WM and cause constitutive CXCR4 signaling via loss of the C-terminal regulatory domain. These mutations confer relative resistance to BTK inhibitor (BTKi) monotherapy — lower overall response rate and major-response rate, slower IgM decline kinetics compared to CXCR4-WT MYD88-mutant WM (Treon NEJM 2015; Castillo Blood 2020). Fires to route ALGO-WM-2L step 1 to carfilzomib-based therapy (IND-WM-2L-CARFILZOMIB-CXCR4MUT) rather than zanubrutinib BTKi monotherapy (IND-WM-2L-ZANUBRUTINIB), as BTKi efficacy is substantially attenuated in CXCR4-mutated WM. Detection: CXCR4 C-terminal sequencing by targeted PCR + Sanger or NGS panel with CXCR4 C-terminus coverage. Note: standard NGS panels frequently omit CXCR4 C-terminus; dedicated assay required. Bone marrow aspirate with CD138+ enrichment preferred for adequate WM clone representation. CXCR4 mutation testing is recommended at WM diagnosis per NCCN B-Cell Lymphomas 2025 (alongside MYD88 L265P) to guide initial therapy selection. In CXCR4-mutated patients, BTKi monotherapy response is attenuated; proteasome-inhibitor-based regimens or BR are preferred 1L per NCCN/ESMO. In 2L, carfilzomib-based regimens offer benefit in BTKi-refractory or BTKi-intolerant CXCR4-mutated WM.

: Fit performance status (ECOG 0-1): pat: : Fit Performance Status (ECOG 0-1): Der Patient ist bei körperlich anstrengender Aktivität, aber ambulant und leicht arbeitend, voll aktiv oder eingeschränkt. Berechtigt für Volldosis-Chemotherapie und Intensivtherapien (CHOEP, BEACOPP-eskaliert, HD-MTX, ASCT-Konsolidierung, CAR-T).
: Fitness for FOLFIRINOX in metastatic P: : Eignung für FOLFIRIRINOX bei metastasierendem PDAC per PRODIGE-4 / ACCORD-11 Einschlusskriterien (Conroy NEJM 2011): ECOG 0-1, Alter ≤75 (≤76 per Protokoll; Konvention <=70-75 in der realen Welt), Bilirubin ≤1,5× ULN (bei Bedarf gelöstes postbiliäres Stenting), keine signifikante Herzkomorbidität, ausreichende Leber-/Nieren-/Knochenmarkfunktion. Wählt IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-FOLFIRINOX über IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-GEM-NAB-PAC (mOS 11.1 vs. 6.8 Mo in PRODIGE-4; Toxizitätsabtausch bei fit-Patienten akzeptabel). Frail / ECOG ≥2 / Bilirubin erhöht → de-eskalieren zu Edelstein-nab-paclitaxel (MPACT, Von Hoff NEJM 2013).
: Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expre: : Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expression (≥75% of viable tumor cells with ≥2+ membrane staining by VENTANA FOLR1 RxDx) in platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma. Mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRASOL — mPFS 5.6 vs 4.0 mo, OS 16.5 vs 12.7 mo vs investigator-choice chemo) is FDA-approved 2L+ ADC.
: Follicular lymphoma NOT meeting any GE: : Follikuläres Lymphom, das kein GELF-Kriterium erfüllt — geringe Tumorbelastung — Beobachtungs- und Wartekandidat; kein Überlebensvorteil, der für eine frühe Behandlung in asymptomatischer low-burden FL gezeigt wird
: Follicular lymphoma meeting GELF crite: : Follikuläres Lymphom, das die Kriterien des GELF für eine hohe Tumorbelastung erfüllt — eines von: Knotenmasse ≥7 cm; ≥3 Knotenstellen je ≥3 cm; B-Symptome; Milz unter Umbilikus; Pleura/peritoneale Effusion; Zytopenie (Hb <10, plt <100K, ANC <1,5K), die auf Lymphom zurückzuführen ist; LDH >ULN; β2M erhöht; schnell fortschreitende Erkrankung
: Follicular lymphoma meeting any GELF c: : Follikuläres Lymphom, das jedes GELF-Kriterium erfüllt — hohe Tumorbelastung, die eine systemische Therapie 1L (R-CHOP / BR / R-CVP / R2) rechtfertigt, anstatt zu beobachten und zu warten
: Follicular lymphoma with clinical feat: : follikuläres Lymphom mit klinischen Eigenschaften bezüglich der Transformation zu aggressivem Lymphom (typischerweise DLBCL): schnelle Krankheitsprogression, isolierte schnell wachsende Knotenmasse, plötzlicher LDH-Anstieg, neue B-Symptome, Hyperkalzämie, extranodale Beteiligung Beginn
: Germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic var: : Germline BRCA1 oder BRCA2 pathogene Variante bei HER2-negativem Brustkrebs (HR+ oder TNBC). Olaparib (OlympiAD — mPFS 7,0 vs 4,2 mo vs Chemo) und Talazoparib (EMBRACA — mPFS 8,6 vs 5,6 mo) sind FDA-genehmigt für metastasierende gBRCA HER2-negative Brust. Adjuvante Olaparib (OlympiA) für hochrisikoreiche HER2-negative gBRCA frühe Brust.
: Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation O: : Germlin- oder somatische BRCA1/2-Mutation ODER breitere HRR-Wegänderung (ATM, CDK12, PALB2, etc.) — sagt PARPi-Ansprechraten voraus; öffnet olaparib/talazoparib-Indikation in mCRPC.
: HCV RNA PCR mandatory at SMZL diagnosi: : HCV RNA PCR obligatorisch bei SMZL Diagnose — HCV-getrieben SMZL reagiert auf direkt wirkende Antivirale (DAA) mit Regression in 50-75%; Rituximab verzögert bis antivirales Ansprechen beurteilt.
: HER2 (ERBB2) activating exon-20 mutati: : HER2 (ERBB2) aktiviert Exon-20 Mutation im NSCLC Adenokarzinom — ~2-3% Prävalenz; unterscheidet sich von HER2 Verstärkung oder Überexpression. Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd; DESTINY-Lung01/02 — ORR 49-58%) ist der FDA-zugelassene 2L+ gezielte ADC. HER2-amp / IHC-only NSCLC hat schwächere T-DXd-Ansprechdaten - Kinase-domain-Mutation ist der bessere vorausschauende Biomarker.
: HER2 amplification / overexpression in: : HER2-Verstärkung / Überexpression bei Brustkrebs (IHC 3+ ODER IHC 2+ mit ISH verstärkt) — ~15-20% der invasiven Brust. Definiert HER2-positive Behandlungsspur: Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab + Chemo (CLEOPATRA 1L), T-DXd 2L (DESTINY-Breast03 — mPFS 28.8 vs 6,8 mo vs T-DM1).
: HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC: : HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC 2+ with non-amplified ISH) — ~50-55% of HER2-non-positive breast cancers. T-DXd 2L+ approved in HR+ and TNBC HER2-low post-chemo (DESTINY-Breast04 — mPFS 9.9 vs 5.1 mo, OS 23.4 vs 16.8 mo).
: IDH1 R132 mutation in intrahepatic cho: : IDH1 R132 Mutation des intrahepatischen Cholangiokarzinoms nach Progression gemcitabine/cisplatin- basierte Therapie. Wege 2L gezielte Behandlung auf ivosidenib.
: IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutatio: : IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutation in AML — ~8-12% prevalence. Enasidenib (IDHIFA / IDHENTIFY — phase-3 R/R AML; monotherapy ORR 38%, CR 19%) is FDA-approved for R/R-AML-IDH2; also active 1L combination with azacitidine in unfit (AG221-AML-005 — ORR 71%).
: IMDC (International Metastatic RCC Dat: : IMDC (International Metastatic RCC Database Consortium) mittlere oder schlechte Risikoscore in metastasiertem Klarzellen-RCC (Heng JCO 2009). Sechs unerwünschte Faktoren: KPS <80%, Zeit von der Diagnose bis zur systemischen Therapie <1 Jahr, Hämoglobin < unterer Normgrenzwert (-12 g/dl), korrigiertes Calcium > ULN, Neutrophilen > ULN, Thrombozyten > ULN. 0 Faktoren = günstig; 1-2 = mittel; ≥3 = arm. CheckMate-214 (Motzer NEJM 2018) hat die Überlegenheit von Nivolumab + Ipilimumab gegenüber Sunitinib für Zwischen- und Untergruppen mit schlechtem Risiko (mOS 47 vs. 26 mo, ITT) festgestellt. KEYNOTE-426 (Pembro+axi) profitiert über alle Risikogruppen hinweg; nivo+ipi bevorzugt in Int/Arme durch langfristiges dauerhaftes Reaktionssignal. Routen ALGO-RCC-METASTATIC-1L Schritt 1 bis IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-NIVO-IPI; günstiges Risiko sinkt bis zum Standard IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-PEMBRO-AXI.
: Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-ris: : Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-risk in relapsed/refractory Burkitt lymphoma 2L salvage, routing to R-DHAP (cisplatin-based) over R-ICE (ifosfamide-based). Three clinical scenarios: (1) Prior hemorrhagic cystitis — any prior ifosfamide- or cyclophosphamide-related hemorrhagic cystitis is a contraindication to further ifosfamide even with mesna; residual mucosal damage increases bleeding risk; (2) Pelvic RT field overlap — prior irradiation to bladder field dramatically increases ifosfamide-related bladder toxicity; avoid; (3) Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy grade ≥2 — ifosfamide causes both peripheral and central neuropathy; additional neurotoxicity risk unacceptable when baseline neuropathy already impairs function; (4) Bladder outlet obstruction, single kidney, or other bladder structural contraindication to mesna- protected ifosfamide. In these scenarios R-DHAP (dexamethasone 40 mg d1-4 + cytarabine 2 g/m² q12h d2 + cisplatin 100 mg/m² d1) is the preferred platinum salvage — equivalent salvage activity to R-ICE (CORAL trial subgroup) with different toxicity profile (renal/ototoxicity from cisplatin vs bladder/neuropathy from ifosfamide).
: KIT activating mutation (exon 11 / 13): : KIT activating mutation (exon 11 / 13) in mucosal or acral melanoma subtype — ~15-20% prevalence in those subtypes (rare in cutaneous). Imatinib (Carvajal 2013 — ORR 23% in KIT-mut mucosal/acral) and nilotinib are off-label active; integrate with standard IO if eligible.
: KMT2A rearrangement (MLL fusion at 11q: : KMT2A-Neuordnung (MLL-Fusion bei 11q23) bei AML — ~5-10% Prävalenz bei adulter AML; ELN-2022-Schadenrisikoklassifikator. Revumenib (Menin-Inhibitor; AUGMENT-101-Phase 1/2) FDA-genehmigt 2024 für rezidivierte/refraktäre KMT2A-rearrangierte akute Leukämie nach ≥ 1 Vorlinie (ORR ~63%, CR/CRh ~23%). Ziftomenib-Alternativ-Menin-Hemmer in Spätphasenstudien. Gemeinsame Partner: AF9 (t(9;11) und AF4 (t(4;11)).
: KRAS G12C mutation — ~13% of NSCLC ade: : KRAS G12C-Mutation — ~13% des NSCLC-Adenokarzinoms; Rauchen-assoziiert. Sotorasib (CodeBreaK 200 — mPFS 5,6 vs 4,5 Mo Docetaxel) und Adagrasib (KRYSTAL-1) sind 2L+ FDA-zugelassene kovalente G12C-Inhibitoren. 1L ist immer noch IO ± Chemo pro PD-L1 (kein 1L G12C-Inhibitor Überlegenheit noch).
: MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biall: : MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biallelic) — distinct WHO 5th-ed entity with poor outcomes on HMA monotherapy and reduced alloHCT benefit; consideration of intensified / experimental therapy or palliative intent
: MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q): : MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q) plus one additional non-7 abnormality) — lenalidomide-responsive subgroup with ~67% RBC transfusion independence; favorable prognosis
: MET exon 14 skipping — ~3-4% of NSCLC: : MET exon 14 skipping — ~3-4% des NSCLC-Adenokarzinoms; älter / Raucher angereichert. Capmatinib (GEOMETRY mono-1 — ORR 41-68%) und Tepotinib (VISION) sind FDA-zugelassene selektive MET-TKIs für die An-line-Anwendung. RNA-NGS bevorzugt für die Splice-Site-Detektion.
: MF with B2 blood involvement (Sézary c: MF mit B2-Blutbeteiligung (Sézary-Zellzahl ≥1000/μL ODER ≥5% Sézary durch Morphologie) — definiert das Sézary-Syndrom / IVA1-Stadium; Wege zur systemischen Therapie mit Mogamulizumab
: MF with large-cell transformation (LCT: : MF mit großzelliger Transformation (LCT - ≥ 25 % Großzellen bei Biopsie-Review) - aggressive Variante; Mandate systemische Therapie-Reassessment, Brentuximab Vedotin, wenn CD30+
: MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — treatment-defin: : MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — Behandlungs-definierender Biomarker. KEYNOTE-177 etablierte Pembrolizumab 1L über FOLFOX+bev (PFS 16.5 vs. 8.2 mo). Diese HF intensiviert sich in Richtung des Immuntherapie-Tracks und überschreibt den Standard RAS/BRAF-gesteuerten Chemoalgorithmus.
: MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement: : MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement (double-/triple-hit) confirmed by FISH — DA-EPOCH-R + IT methotrexate prophylaxis preferred over R-CHOP per multiple retrospective and small prospective series.
: MYD88 L265P is the hallmark mutation o: : MYD88 L265P ist die charakteristische Mutation der Waldenström-Makroglobulinämie, die in > 90 % der WM vorhanden ist. Drives konstitutive NF-κB-Aktivierung durch BTK. iNNOVATE (Dimopoulos NEJM 2018) und die iNNOVATE langfristige Follow-up etabliert Ibrutinib + Rituximab > Placebo + Rituximab unabhängig von der vorherigen Therapie; MYD88-L265P-positive Krankheit hat die höchste Ansprechrate auf BTKi Monotherapie (ORR ~90%, Major-Response ~70%), während MYD88-WT WM schlecht anspricht. 1L symptomatisches WM mit MYD88-L265P in Richtung BTKi-basierte Therapie (Ibrutinib, Zanubrutinib pro ASPEN oder Ibrutinib + Rituximab) über DRC-Chemoimmuno, wenn Chemo-Vermeidung bevorzugt wird (kardiale, gebrechliche, hyperviskositätskontrollierte).
: Mantle cell lymphoma with MIPI low ris: : Mantelzell-Lymphom mit MIPI-niedrigem Risiko (MIPI < 5,7 / 0-3 vereinfachte Punkte) — unterstützt eine standardverstärkte Induktion bei fit jüngeren Patienten (Nordisch / R-DHAP-basiert) ohne weitere Eskalation der Behandlung
: Mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid / p: : Mantelzell-Lymphom mit Blastoid/pleomorpher Morphologie ODER TP53-Mutation OR del(17p) — chemoimmun-resistente aggressive Variante; Route direkt zur BTKi-basierten Therapie
: Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor prop: : Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor proportion score (TPS) ≥50% by 22C3 IHC, no actionable driver mutations (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/NTRK/ KRAS-G12C/HER2 wild-type or unselected). KEYNOTE-024 (Reck NEJM 2016; 5-year update Reck JCO 2021) established pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L over platinum-doublet chemo for TPS ≥50% (mOS 26.3 vs 13.4 mo, 5y OS 31.9% vs 16.3%). FDA-approved 2016. Atezolizumab (IMpower-110) and cemiplimab (EMPOWER-Lung-1) similarly approved. ESMO/NCCN 2024 prefer pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L for TPS ≥50% over chemo + IO combinations (KEYNOTE-189 / -407) when patient is fit and the TPS-50% determination is reliable.
: Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS: : Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS wild-type status: KRAS exon 2 (codons 12, 13), exon 3 (codons 59, 61), exon 4 (codons 117, 146) AND NRAS exon 2/3/4 ALL wild-type by NGS or extended-RAS PCR. Defines the ~50% of mCRC eligible for anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy (cetuximab, panitumumab) when combined with chemotherapy backbone. Left-sided RAS-WT mCRC particularly benefits from 1L anti-EGFR + FOLFOX/ FOLFIRI (CALGB/SWOG-80405, FIRE-3, PRIME, CRYSTAL — survival benefit driven by left-sided primaries; right-sided RAS-WT does NOT benefit and routes to bevacizumab + chemo).
: Multiple myeloma high-risk cytogenetic: : Multiples Myelom Hochrisikozytogenetik: eine von t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), del(17p)/TP53 Verlust, Verstärkung oder Verstärkung von 1q21 durch interphasen FISH auf CD138 angereicherten Plasmazellen
: NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion — pan-tumor acti: : NTRK1/2/3 Genfusion — Pan-Tumor-Treiber; <1% in NSCLC. Larotrectinib (NAVIGATE — ORR 75% Pan-Tumor) und Entrectinib (STARTRK-2) sind FDA Gewebe-agnostische TRK-Hemmer. Behandlungsdefinieren, wenn festgestellt.
: Oligometastatic esophagogastric adenoc: : Oligometastatic esophagogastric adenocarcinoma per OMEC-1 (OligoMetastatic Esophagogastric Cancer) European Delphi consensus (Kroese et al., Eur J Cancer 2023, PMID 36947929). Defined as ≤3 distant metastatic lesions amenable to local therapy in a patient with controllable primary disease and ECOG 0-1 fitness. Excluded scenarios: peritoneal carcinomatosis, leptomeningeal disease, >3 brain metastases. RENAISSANCE / AIO-FLOT5 trial (NCT02578368) eligibility narrower: ≤1 incurable organ-system involvement, no ascites, ≤1 retroperitoneal LN station — uses FLOT chemo ± surgical resection (gastrectomy/oesophagectomy + metastasectomy). Triggers MDT consideration of metastasis-directed local therapy (metastasectomy or SBRT) added to systemic chemo, and registration on RENAISSANCE-pattern trials where available.
: PIK3CA hotspot activating mutation (E5: : PIK3CA-Hotspot-Aktivierungsmutation (E542K, E545K, H1047R/L) bei HR+/HER2- metastasierendem Brustkrebs – vorhanden in ~40% der Fälle. Nach Progression bei endokrinem ± CDK4/6i sind Alpelisib + Fulvestrant (SOLAR-1 — mPFS 11.0 vs. 5.7 mo) oder Capivasertib + Fulvestrant (CAPItello-291 — mPFS 7.3 vs. 3.1 mo) 2L+ gezielte Optionen.
: PMF with anemia as dominant clinical p: : PMF mit Anämie als dominantes klinisches Problem (Hb < 10 g/dl OR transfusionsabhängig) — Momelotinib bevorzugt gegenüber Ruxolitinib (MOMENTUM-Studie: Milz + Symptom + Verbesserung der Hb)
: PV or ET high-risk for thrombosis: age: : PV- oder ET-Höchstrisiko für Thrombose: Alter > 60 Jahre ODER vorherige arterielle/venöse Thrombose ODER (nur ET) JAK2 V617F + CV-Risikofaktoren (IPSET-Thrombose hoch) — Auslöser einer Zytoreduktion (HU 1L) zusätzlich zur Ausgangsphlebotomie + ASS
: Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+: : Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+) — TKI (imatinib/dasatinib/ponatinib) + Chemotherapie ist Standard; Ph-ähnliche B-ALL-Signatur erfordert eine JAK/ABL-bahn-gezielte Addition.
: Platinum-sensitive ovarian relapse — P: : Platin-empfindlicher ovarieller Rückfall — Platin-freies Intervall (PFI) > 6 Monate von der letzten Platin-Dosis bis zum Rezidiv. Behandlungsdefinierung: Re-Platinum Doublet (Carbo + Paclitaxel/PLD/gem) ± Bevacizumab-Wartung. PARPi-Wartung nach Ansprechen, wenn HRD-positiv.
: Post-CROSS-CRT-then-esophagectomy with: : Post-CROSS-CRT-then-ösophagektomie mit Resterkrankung — Pathologie zeigt ypT+ und/oder ypN+ (kein pCR). ~70% der CROSS-Patienten fallen in diese Kategorie. Behandlungsdefining: verschiebt den Patienten aus dem resektable-1L (CROSS neoadjuvant)-Weg in adjuvantes Nivolumab × 1 Jahr pro CheckMate-577 (DFS 22 vs 11 mo Placebo, HR 0,69). Eignungsfenster: initiieren innerhalb von 4-16 Wochen nach der Operation. Gilt sowohl für Adenokarzinom und squamoous-cell histology.
: Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor: : Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor (ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib). Triggers selection of non-covalent BTKi (pirtobrutinib), BCL2i (venetoclax-based regimens), CAR-T (lisocabtagene maraleucel, brexucabtagene autoleucel), or PI3Ki — depending on disease (CLL, MCL, WM). Resistance often driven by BTK C481S or PLCG2 mutation.
: RET fusion (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, othe: : RET-Fusion (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, andere) — ~1-2 % des NSCLC-Adenokarzinoms. Selpercatinib (LIBRETTO-001 — ORR 85% TKI-naive) und pralsetinib (ARROW) sind von der FDA zugelassene selektive RET-TKIs; bevorzugt 1L gegenüber Multikinase (Cabo, Vandetanib).
: ROS1 fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, othe: : ROS1-Fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, andere) — ~1-2 % des NSCLC-Adenokarzinoms; nie-raucher-angereichert. Behandlungsdefining: Entrectinib (ZNS-aktiv) oder Repotrectinib (TRIDENT-1, einschließlich post-crizotinib Widerstand) bevorzugte 1L; Crizotinib historische Option.
: Rapid progression in CRC: relapse with: : Rapid progression in CRC: relapse within ≤6 months of completing adjuvant chemo (oxaliplatin-resistant phenotype), new peritoneal carcinomatosis with ascites + obstruction, OR rapid LDH/CEA doubling (>50% rise over 4-8 weeks). Alters 2L+ regimen choice + may contraindicate oxaliplatin re-introduction.
: Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prio: : Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prior systemic therapies, NOT a candidate for anti-CD19 CAR-T (axi-cel / liso-cel / tisa-cel) due to frailty, organ dysfunction, comorbidity burden, manufacturing-window risk, prior CAR-T failure, or absent funded referral pathway. Routes 3L+ to loncastuximab tesirine (LOTIS-2 Caimi 2021 Lancet Oncol; ORR 48%, CR 24%, mPFS 4.9 mo, mOS 9.5 mo) — off-the-shelf outpatient ADC ideally suited for non-CAR-T-eligible frail patient. Distinct from universal RF-CAR-T-INELIGIBLE-AGE-COMORBID (which gates on age ≥75 + Charlson ≥4) — this flag covers the broader DLBCL-specific ineligibility composite including UA access constraints (no funded international referral pathway).
: Resected stage III cutaneous melanoma: : Resected stage III kutanes Melanom — adjuvant-eligible Biologie (positive Sentinellymph-node Biopsie oder klinisch nachgewiesene Knotenerkrankung, chirurgisch residiert über breite lokale Exzision ± Abschluss Lymphadenektomie oder therapeutische Hals / Einfallsdezersion pro chirurgische Beurteilung). Behandlungsdefining: verschiebt den Patienten aus dem metastasierenden 1L-Weg in eine adjuvante Immuntherapie (KEYNOTE-054 Pembrolizumab × 12 Monate, CheckMate-238 Nivolumab × 12 Monate) oder adjuvante BRAFi+MEKi (COMBI-AD Dabrafenib + Trametinib) für BRAF V600 Mutanten. Adjuvante Therapie wurde innerhalb von 12 Wochen nach einer definitiven Operation in den Registrierungsstudien eingeleitet.
: Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicat: : Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicated, or intolerant in AITL 2L+. Scenarios driving ineligibility: (1) Access — romidepsin is not approved in Ukraine (as of 2026); available only via named-patient programme or clinical trial; many patients cannot access; (2) Cardiac contraindication — class I/II QTc-prolonging cardiac arrhythmia or baseline QTc ≥480 ms; romidepsin HDACi class causes dose-dependent QTc prolongation and is contraindicated in significant baseline arrhythmia; (3) Prior HDACi intolerance — prior romidepsin or belinostat-related grade ≥3 cardiac event, thrombocytopenia, or GI toxicity requiring discontinuation. In all cases belinostat (BELIEF, 2014; PTCL ORR 25.8%, AITL ORR ~46%) is the preferred alternative HDACi: less QTc prolongation than romidepsin, IV weekly schedule, and UA-accessible via named-patient. Azacitidine remains an orthogonal alternative (HMA, not HDACi) routed via step 1 default.
: Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favour: : Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favourable subtype of ATLL. Smoldering: ≥5% circulating abnormal lymphocytes, no organ involvement (skin/lung lesion permitted), LDH normal, BUN normal, albumin normal, no hypercalcemia, no lymphadenopathy or organomegaly. Chronic-favourable: similar to smoldering but lymphadenopathy/organomegaly permitted, LDH ≤2× ULN, BUN ≤ULN, albumin ≥ULN, Ca normal, no CNS/bone/GI/effusion. AZT+IFN-α (anti-HTLV-1 mechanism) yields 5-yr OS ~46% vs ~20% for chemotherapy in these subtypes (Bazarbachi 2010 meta-analysis, JNCI). Aggressive subtypes (acute/lymphoma/chronic-unfavourable) do NOT respond to AZT+IFN — route those to CHOEP+mogamulizumab via RF-ATLL-HIGH-RISK-BIOLOGY.
: Symptomatic CNS metastases — ICI doubl: : Symptomatische ZNS Metastasen — ICI Doublet (nivo+ipi) intrakranial aktiv; BRAFi+MEKi für viszerale Krise.
: T-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression ≥: : T-Zell-Lymphom mit CD30 Ausdruck ≥10% von IHC — die Voraussetzungen für brentuximab vedotin- basierendes Regime (CHP-Bv je ECHELON-2)
: Treatment-defining biomarkers in metas: : Behandlungsdefinierende Biomarker in metastasierendem Magen/GEJ Adenokarzinom: HER2+ (IHC 3+ ODER 2+/ISH+) → Trastuzumab+chemo TOGA / T-DXd 2L+; CLDN18.2+ (≥75% der Tumorzellen mit 2+ membranöser Färbung) → zolbetuximab+chemo SPOTLIGHT/GLOW; MSI-H → pembrolizumab mono; EBV+ Subtyp (TCGA molekulare Klasse) — unterschiedliche Biologie, ICI-begünstigt.
: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC):: : Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): estrogen receptor (ER) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND progesterone receptor (PR) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND HER2-negative (IHC 0 or 1+, OR IHC 2+ with ISH non-amplified). TNBC represents ~15-20% of all invasive breast cancers and is defined by the absence of all three hormone/growth-factor receptor targets. Clinical significance: TNBC lacks ER, PR, and HER2 targets, precluding endocrine therapy (tamoxifen, aromatase inhibitors) and HER2-directed therapy. Treatment is chemotherapy-based: - Early TNBC: pembrolizumab + neoadjuvant chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-522; Schmid NEJM 2022) — pCR rate 64.8% vs 51.2% with chemo alone, regardless of PD-L1 status. KEYNOTE-522 is the standard-of-care regimen. - Metastatic TNBC (BRCA-WT): pembrolizumab + chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-355) for CPS ≥10; chemotherapy alone (nab-paclitaxel, paclitaxel, or gemcitabine+carboplatin) for CPS <10. - Metastatic TNBC + germline BRCA1/2 mutation: olaparib or talazoparib preferred 1L over chemotherapy (OlympiAD; exploits HRD). Fires to route ALGO-BREAST-1L step 3 toward the TNBC track (step 4 stage gate → PARPi or pembro+chemo routing) instead of the HR+/HER2- track (CDK4/6i+AI, step 5). The engine sequential check (step 1: HER2+ gate via RF-BREAST-HER2-AMP- ACTIONABLE; step 3: TNBC gate via this RF) means HER2-positive patients are already routed away before step 3 fires. The HER2-negative component of the TNBC definition is therefore confirmed by the prior sequential filtering, but is included in the trigger for completeness and for use in non-sequential contexts.
: Visceral organ involvement (pulmonary,: : viszerale Organbeteiligung (pulmonale, gastrointestinale oder andere viszerale Stelle) ODER extensive/schnell fortschreitende mukokutane Erkrankung (weitverbreitete kutane Läsionen, Tumor-assoziierte Lymphödeme oder Ulzerationen) in Kaposi-Sarkomen jeder epidemiologischen Form (AIDS-assoziiert, iatrogen, klassisch oder endemisch). Eine solche symptomatische/extensive Erkrankung wird nicht durch eine Immunregeneration (ART/Immunsuppression Rebalance) oder eine lokale Therapie allein ausreichend kontrolliert und führt zu einer Eskalation der systemischen Chemotherapie.

Ein Erst-Grad-Verwandter des Patienten (Eltern, Geschwister oder Kind) hat eine dokumentierte Position...: source-linked OpenOnco Onco Wiki Fakten für onkologische Entscheidungsunterstützung und KI-Retrieval.

Ein Erst-Grad-Verwandter des Patienten (Mutter, Geschwister oder Kind) hat ein dokumentiertes positives Keimlinientestergebnis für BRCA1 oder BRCA2 – die kanonischen HBOC (Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer)-Spektrumgene. Der Patient selbst wurde noch NICHT keimliniengetestet und hat keine aktuelle persönliche Krebsdiagnose. Pro autosomal-dominanter Vererbung trägt der Patient eine **50% vorherige Wahrscheinlichkeit**, auch ein BRCA-Träger zu sein – weit höher als die ~5-10% positive Ausbeute von nur-stammstammstammversuchenden Populationen – und bietet eine starke klinische Motivation für Kaskadenkeimlinientests. Unterscheidet sich von RF-BRCA-HBOC-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION (Feuer auf Stammbaummuster allein, bevor ein Verwandter positiv getestet hat) und von RF-BRCA-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (Feuer nach dem eigenen positiven Keimlinientest). Präventivpersona RedFlag (§20, v0.2-B Kaskadentestpilot 2026-05-19).

A first-degree relative of the patient (parent, sibling, or child) has a documented positive germline test result for TP53 (Li-Fraumeni Syndrome — one of the most penetrant hereditary cancer syndromes known). The patient themself has NOT yet been germline-tested and has no current personal cancer diagnosis. Per autosomal-dominant inheritance, the patient carries a **50% prior probability** of also being a TP53 carrier — combined with the ~70-90% lifetime cancer risk of confirmed TP53 carriers and the radiation-avoidance implications of confirmed carrier status — this is one of the highest-stakes cascade-testing scenarios in clinical oncology prevention. Distinct from RF-LI-FRAUMENI-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION (fires on Chompret / classic LFS pedigree criteria before any relative has tested positive). ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no: ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no equivalent alternative. H1/H2 antihistamines (diphenhydramine, famotidine), corticosteroids (hydrocortisone, methylprednisolone), and bronchodilators are all ADJUNCTS, NOT replacements. Delay or omission of epinephrine in anaphylaxis is the leading modifiable cause of fatal outcome — give EARLY (within 5 min of recognition), give IM thigh (NOT SC, NOT deltoid), and REPEAT every 5-15 min if symptoms persist. Common pitfall in chemotherapy infusion reactions: treating with diphenhydramine + steroid alone while withholding epinephrine for "mild" symptoms — escalate immediately if hypotension, bronchospasm, or upper airway involvement. Patients on β-blockers who develop refractory anaphylaxis: add glucagon 1-5 mg IV bolus then 5-15 µg/min infusion (bypasses β-receptor block via intracellular cAMP elevation). Auto-injectors not widely available in Ukraine — emergency department / oncology day-unit protocols should pre-position 1 mg/mL ampules + syringes and drill the IM-thigh administration. Ukraine: registered, NSZU- covered, ubiquitous.

APC (Adenomatous Polyposis Coli) is the: APC (Adenomatous Polyposis Coli) is the gatekeeper tumor suppressor of the WNT/β-catenin pathway. APC forms the destruction complex with AXIN1/2, GSK-3β, and CK1α that phosphorylates β-catenin (CTNNB1) at exon 3 residues (S33/S37/T41/S45) targeting it for proteasomal degradation. Loss of APC → β-catenin accumulates, translocates to the nucleus, activates TCF/LEF transcription of MYC, CCND1, and pro-proliferative genes. Frequency: somatic APC mutation in ~80% of sporadic CRC (earliest event in adenoma-carcinoma sequence). Germline: FAP (familial adenomatous polyposis) — >100 adenomas, nearly 100% CRC risk by 40y without colectomy; AFAP (attenuated FAP) — fewer adenomas, later onset. Clinical relevance: APC mutation is diagnostic/prognostic context in CRC; no APC-targeted therapy approved. Surrogate: nuclear β-catenin by IHC confirms WNT pathway activation when sequencing unavailable.

AR (androgen receptor) gene amplification detected on tumor or ctDNA NGS in mCRPC — INFORMATIONAL signal of mechanistic ARSI resistance. AR amplification is one of the most common acquired resistance mechanisms to abiraterone / enzalutamide / apalutamide / darolutamide; detected in ~30-50% of post-ARSI mCRPC ctDNA samples. AR-amp argues against ARSI-after-ARSI sequencing (limited cross-class benefit) and for early switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 (if PSMA-PET-positive). FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-amp status — surfaces in MDT brief to flag patients in whom further ARSI escalation is unlikely to add benefit. AR amplification is one of three dominan: AR amplification is one of three dominant AR-pathway-driven ARSI-resistance mechanisms in mCRPC (alongside AR-V7 splice variant and AR ligand-binding- domain mutations). High-level AR-amp (ctDNA CN ≥2.5 by Guardant360, or tissue NGS CN ≥4) is detectable in 30-50% of mCRPC progressing on abiraterone or enzalutamide and correlates with shorter PFS/OS on continued ARSI. Distinct from AR-V7 (splice variant — see BIO-AR-V7): AR-amp = wild-type-AR overexpression (still ligand-binding-domain competent; can still respond to higher-affinity ARSI in some cases), AR-V7 = constitutively-active LBD-truncated isoform (ligand-independent, ARSI cannot bind). Clinical use: ctDNA AR-CN trajectory under ARSI monitors clonal selection; rising AR-CN signals impending progression. HOWEVER: NO FDA-approved Tx decision keyed on AR-amp; guidelines (NCCN, ESMO, EAU) treat it as informational / prognostic. Use in MDT brief to flag patients at risk of ARSI-resistance and to discuss switch to taxane (docetaxel, cabazitaxel), 177Lu-PSMA-617 (PSMA-positive), or PARPi (HRR-mutated). PROPHECY (Antonarakis 2019): AR-V7-positive on Epic CTC IHC associated with HR ~3 for inferior PFS/OS on ARSI vs AR-V7-negative; switch to taxane (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) recovers responses. INFORMATIONAL — FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-V7; surfaces in MDT brief to flag patients in whom ARSI-after-ARSI is unlikely to work.

AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice: AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice variant of the androgen receptor lacking the ligand-binding domain. Detected most commonly on circulating tumor cells (CTCs) by Epic AR-V7 Nucleus Detect IHC. Clinical relevance in mCRPC: AR-V7-positive patients have markedly inferior PFS/OS on abiraterone or enzalutamide compared to AR-V7-negative (PROPHECY, Antonarakis 2019, J Clin Oncol — HR ~3 for inferior survival). Switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) recovers responses. HOWEVER: FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-V7; guidelines treat it as investigational / informational. Use in MDT brief to flag patients in whom ARSI-after-ARSI is unlikely to work and for whom a switch to taxane (or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 if PSMA-positive) should be discussed. KB scope choice: AR-V7 ships as biomarker + RF (informational) only — no new IND, no algorithm step in this chunk. Tx-modifying signal ("switch ARSI → taxane") would require a new taxane-mCRPC IND branched on AR-V7, which is deferred.
ARASENS (darolutamide + docetaxel + ADT): ARASENS (darolutamide + docetaxel + ADT): OS benefit in high-volume mHSPC. Requires docetaxel-eligible patient. Alternative formulations: ADT + abiraterone + docetaxel (PEACE-1) for centers without darolutamide access.
ARASENS: significant OS benefit for trip: ARASENS: significant OS benefit for triplet vs ADT + docetaxel in high-volume mHSPC. Requires docetaxel-eligible patient (ECOG 0-1, no significant comorbidity). UA-access constrained by darolutamide reimbursement gap — flagged for clinical-review queue.
ARIEL3 (recurrent platinum-sensitive mai: ARIEL3 (recurrent platinum-sensitive maintenance after CR/PR to most recent platinum, ≥2 prior platinum lines): BRCA-mut mPFS 16.6 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.23); HRD+ 13.6 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.32); all-comers 10.8 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.36). Third PARPi maintenance option after olaparib (SOLO-2) and niraparib (NOVA). Distinct AE: ALT/AST elevation common but usually transient; non-progressive creatinine elevation (transporter effect) is not nephrotoxicity.
ARPI-naive mCRPC routes to abiraterone o: ARPI-naive mCRPC routes to abiraterone or enzalutamide added to ADT in the OpenOnco model. PARP-inhibitor monotherapy is reserved for HRR-altered disease (PROfound established BRCA-driven olaparib). Lu-177-PSMA requires prior taxane / ARPI exposure (VISION) and cabazitaxel is later-line.

GnRH-agonist co-administration (POEMS, PROMISE-GIM6 in breast) reduces premature ovarian failure rate. Direction `investigate` because flag drives parallel fertility-preservation pathway, not alternative oncologic indication. Bridges to RF-PREGNANCY-ACTIVE if patient becomes pregnant during/after therapy.

ATC predominantly affects elderly (media: ATC predominantly affects elderly (median age ~70); aggressive CRT is rarely tolerated in ≥75 with comorbidity. For BRAF-wt elderly: tracheostomy + symptom control + hospice often appropriate; selected fit elderly may benefit from pembrolizumab monotherapy (better tolerated than cytotoxic). Goals-of-care discussion within first MDT meeting is ATA-recommended given disease tempo. Severity critical because of high stakes; priority 50 because BRAF status overrides this in conflict (RF-THYROID-ANAPLASTIC-HIGH-RISK-BIOLOGY priority 30).

Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressiv: Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressive rare cancer of the adrenal cortex. Bimodal age distribution (pediatric and adult peaks) reflects two distinct biological contexts: pediatric ACC is overwhelmingly hereditary (Li-Fraumeni / Beckwith-Wiedemann), adult ACC is mostly sporadic with ~10% hereditary component. Functional ACC presents with hormonal syndromes: hypercortisolism (Cushing — most common, ~50% of functional ACC), virilization (androgen-secreting; especially in women), feminization (estrogen- secreting; rare; in men), Conn syndrome (aldosterone-secreting; rare). Non-functional ACC presents with mass effect, abdominal pain, or as incidental imaging finding. Staging: ENSAT (European Network for the Study of Adrenal Tumors) staging system; tumor size >6 cm, capsular invasion, regional nodes, distant metastasis are key prognostic factors. Mitotic count (Weiss score / Helsinki score) drives recurrence-risk stratification. Treatment fundamentals (full Indications pending): radical adrenalectomy with curative intent for resectable disease — open approach historically preferred (laparoscopic associated with positive-margin / peritoneal-seeding risk in retrospective series). Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the: Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the FOXL2 p.C134W mutation (present in ~97% of cases), which is the only pathognomonic molecular alteration in any solid tumor. FOXL2 is a granulosa cell transcription factor; the C134W mutation is a dominant-negative gain-of-function that prevents normal granulosa cell differentiation. Clinically, tumors present with estrogen excess (abnormal uterine bleeding, endometrial pathology) or abdominal mass. Prognosis is generally favorable for stage I (90% 10-yr OS) but late recurrences (10–20 years) are characteristic. No FDA-approved targeted therapy as of 2026; FOXL2 inhibition and CDK4/6 inhibitors are in clinical trials. FOXL2 mutation testing is diagnostic, not therapeutic selection (ESCAT IIB — clinical utility as diagnostic/prognostic marker).

Patients with active CNS metastases — particularly progression after IO/HER2-directed therapy — pull tucatinib + trastuzumab + capecitabine into the conversation because the HER2CLIMB trial demonstrated CNS activity. Germline BRCA1/2 status brings PARP-inhibitor reasoning into the longer sequencing arc but does not displace the HER2-directed backbone at any line.

Radium-223 ist für symptomatische Knochen-Prädominant-Erkrankungen ohne Viszeralmetastasen (ALSYMPCA) reserviert. Das OpenOnco-Modell schneidet alle drei parallelen Optionen auf und nutzt rote Fahnen (viszerale Belastung, Transformation, Markreserve), um die Auswahl zu verengen.
After response to platinum, OpenOnco rou: After response to platinum, OpenOnco routes maintenance choices by combined BRCA / HRD status. BRCA-mutant disease (germline or somatic) routes to olaparib maintenance as the canonical first option (SOLO-1). HRD-positive non-BRCA disease pulls niraparib (PRIMA) and olaparib combinations into the conversation, often with bevacizumab continued from induction. HRD-negative disease without BRCA mutation typically relies on bevacizumab maintenance or observation; the chapter is explicit that adding a PARP inhibitor to HRD-negative non-BRCA disease is not the canonical default.

Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) spiegelt die ursprüngliche Größe des Follikelpools wider und ist der beste Einzelbiomarker der Ovarialreserve. In der Trägerpopulation BRCA1/2 wird AMH als ENTSCHEIDUNGS-SUPPORT für risikoreduzierende Salpingo-oophorektomie (RSSO / BSO) Timing, Fertilitätsberatung und Oozyten-Kryopreservation-Planung verwendet — NICHT als Screening-Test auf Eierstockkrebs. NCCN Genetische/Familienbrust/Ovarial 2025 empfiehlt BSO im Alter von 35-40 (BRCA1) / 40-45 (BRCA2) nach Abschluss des gebärenden Geschlechts. AMH ist ein Input, der die personalisierten Kosten/Nutzen von vor-BSO-Oozyten-Kryopreservation und nach-BSO-Menopausen-Hormonersatzentscheidungen informiert. AMH sagt kein Ovarialkrebsrisiko voraus und ersetzt nicht die keimlinien-Mutation-getriebene BSO-Empfehlung. ESCAT X — AMH treibt die Auswahl der Krebsbehandlung nicht an; kategorisiert als reproduktive counselling Unterstützung.

Autologous T cells genetically modified: Autologous T cells genetically modified ex vivo with lentiviral vector encoding chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19, with 4-1BB costimulatory domain (CD137) and CD3-zeta signaling domain. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, single IV infusion → in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against CD19+ B-cell malignancies. Approved for R/R B-ALL ≤25 years (ELIANA) and R/R DLBCL adult (JULIET).
Autologous T cells transduced with a len: Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a CAR with anti-CD19 single-chain variable fragment (FMC63), 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and CD3-zeta activation domain. Distinguishing feature is administration of a defined 1:1 ratio of CD4+ and CD8+ CAR-T cells (separately manufactured, then combined), which is hypothesized to deliver more predictable expansion kinetics and a more favorable CRS/ICANS profile vs CD28-based products. Lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning precedes a single IV infusion. Approved by FDA Feb 2021 and EMA April 2022 for relapsed/ refractory large B-cell lymphoma (TRANSCEND-NHL-001), expanded in 2022 to 2L (TRANSFORM trial), and in 2024 to relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL (TRANSCEND-CLL-004) and to relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma (TRANSCEND-FL).

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) containing a murine anti-BCMA single-chain variable fragment (scFv), a CD8α hinge/ transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3- zeta activation domain. Recognizes B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo CAR-T expansion, peak ~7-11 days post-infusion, with sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. First CAR-T therapy approved for multiple myeloma (FDA Mar 2021, KarMMa). Expanded to 2L+ R/R MM (KarMMa-3) in 2024 for triple-class-exposed patients.

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that contains two BCMA-targeting heavy-chain-only variable domains (VHH) in tandem, a CD8α hinge/transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3-zeta activation domain. The bivalent VHH design improves avidity for B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. Approved by FDA Feb 2022 and EMA May 2022 for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after ≥4 prior lines (CARTITUDE-1) and expanded in 2024 to 2L+ R/R MM in lenalidomide-refractory patients (CARTITUDE-4).
Autologous T-cells engineered with anti-: Autologous T-cells engineered with anti-CD19 CAR (CD28 costim + CD3-zeta activation, identical receptor construct to axi-cel) but manufactured with a CD19-depletion step prior to transduction — reduces malignant CD19+ B-cell contamination of the apheresis product (clinically meaningful in leukemic MCL where circulating malignant cells are prominent). Following lymphodepleting conditioning, engineered cells expand in vivo, recognize CD19+ B-cells, trigger cytotoxic killing.
Autologous T-cells transduced with retro: Autologous T-cells transduced with retroviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19 with CD28 costimulatory + CD3-zeta activation domains. Following lymphodepleting conditioning (fludarabine + cyclophosphamide), engineered cells expand in vivo, recognize CD19+ B-cells (malignant + normal), trigger cytotoxic killing + cytokine release. Single infusion; persistence weeks to months.

BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, encoded: BCMA (B-cell maturation antigen, encoded by TNFRSF17) is universally expressed on malignant plasma cells in multiple myeloma — therapeutic target for the entire BCMA-directed class: - **BCMA × CD3 bispecifics**: teclistamab (MajesTEC-1, ORR 63% / ≥CR 39% in penta-refractory MM); elranatamab (MagnetisMM-3 — pivotal trial for elranatamab; SRC entry NOT YET INGESTED, flagged in commit body). - **BCMA CAR-T**: ciltacabtagene autoleucel (CARTITUDE-1, ORR 97% / sCR 67% in heavily pre-treated R/R MM); idecabtagene vicleucel (KarMMa, R/R MM). - **BCMA ADC**: belantamab mafodotin (DREAMM-7/8, R/R MM). Cross-disease relevance: MM is the only adult disease with BCMA-directed therapy in clinical use. BCMA+ status is assumed by histology (plasma-cell neoplasm) in clinical trials — formal IHC/flow measurement not part of standard MM workup but documented in trial eligibility logs and as reference for BCMA-loss / antigen-escape surveillance at relapse on BCMA-directed therapy. BLM germline biallelic pathogenic variants cause Bloom syndrome — autosomal-recessive disorder of replication-fork resolution (BLM RecQ helicase loss). Phenotype: severe pre- and postnatal growth restriction, characteristic facial features + sun-sensitive erythematous facial rash (telangiectatic), immunodeficiency, diabetes, and very high lifetime cancer risk with broad spectrum: leukemia (AML, ALL), lymphoma, early colorectal + gastric + skin (BCC, SCC, melanoma) + breast + GU cancers. Median age at first cancer diagnosis ~25 years; many patients develop multiple primary cancers. Confirmed-carrier (biallelic) surveillance protocol (per Bloom Syndrome Registry / Cunniff et al. 2017): strict sun protection from infancy; annual dermatology + comprehensive skin exam; complete blood count q3-6mo (leukemia surveillance); colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 12-15 with polypectomy; EGD q1-2y from age 12-15; breast MRI + mammography annual from age 18-20 in women; symptom-directed evaluation with low threshold (cancers present atypically and at all ages). Avoid ionizing radiation when possible — radiosensitivity is documented. Monoallelic (heterozygous) BLM carriers may have modestly elevated cancer risk (Ashkenazi BLM-Ash founder variant — small CRC association in some studies); standard-population screening reasonable. ESCAT IIA (biallelic carriers).

Barrett's esophagus (intestinal metaplasia of the distal esophagus with goblet cells on biopsy after EGD performed for chronic GERD or Barrett's-specific surveillance) in an individual without a current esophageal adenocarcinoma diagnosis. Established precursor lesion to esophageal adenocarcinoma — annual progression rates: non-dysplastic Barrett's ~0.1-0.3%/year to EAC, low-grade dysplasia (LGD) ~0.7-2%/year, high-grade dysplasia (HGD) ~7-19%/year. Endoscopic surveillance and endoscopic eradication therapy (radiofrequency ablation, endoscopic mucosal resection) for dysplastic Barrett's substantially reduce EAC incidence and mortality. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 ratification 2026-05-18, v0.3 chronic-condition pilot).

Broad-spectrum carbapenem β-lactam that: Broad-Spektrum Carbapenem β-Lactam, das multiple Penicillin-bindende Proteine (PBP-2 hauptsächlich, auch PBP-3 und -1) mit rascher bakterizider Aktivität gegen die meisten Gram-negativen Bacilli (einschließlich ESBL-produzierende Enterobacterales, AmpC-Überproduzenten und viele Pseudomonas), Gram-positive Cocci (außer MRSA, Ampicillin-resistente Enterokokken) und die meisten Anaeroben einschließlich Bacteroides fragilis bindet. Extrem stabil gegen die meisten β-Laktamasen einschließlich ESBLs und AmpC, aber hydrolysiert durch Carbapenemes (KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM, IMP). Geringeres Anfallsrisiko als Imipenem (kein DHP-1-Hemmer erforderlich; reduzierte PBP-2-Affinität im ZNS). FDA-genehmigt 1996. Reserviert für dokumentierte oder stark vermutete MDR Gram-negative Infektionen, schwere Sepsis mit breitspektrumiger Abdeckung und FN Ausfall der ersten empirischen Therapie nach 72-96 Stunden.

CA 19-9 is the principal serum biomarker for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) — used for (a) prognosis at diagnosis, (b) treatment response monitoring (declining CA 19-9 during neoadjuvant / systemic therapy correlates with PFS / OS — Tempero 2024), and (c) longitudinal surveillance in high-risk germline carriers per the CAPS Consortium 2020 (CDKN2A, BRCA1/2, PALB2, ATM, STK11, MMR with positive FH; PRSS1 mutation with hereditary pancreatitis). CD22 expression on lymphoblasts in relapsed/refractory B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) — CD22 expressed on >90% B-ALL blasts; flow cytometric / IHC confirmation typically available at diagnosis. Gates inotuzumab ozogamicin (INO; anti-CD22 calicheamicin ADC) for R/R adult B-ALL. INO-VATE ALL (Kantarjian 2016 NEJM): inotuzumab vs standard chemotherapy in R/R B-ALL — CR/CRi 80.7% vs 29.4%, MRD-negative 78.4% of responders, mPFS 5.0 vs 1.8 mo, mOS 7.7 vs 6.7 mo. Bridge to alloHCT is the curative-intent goal — INO-induced remission + prompt transplant in MRD-negative responders associated with durable disease control. Distinct from blinatumomab (anti-CD19 BiTE) — alternative or sequential R/R B-ALL option. CD22-loss escape uncommon; Ph-positive B-ALL also eligible (combined with TKI).
CD22+ status (≥20% of blasts/lymphoma ce: CD22+ status (≥20% of blasts/lymphoma cells expressing CD22 by flow or IHC) is the standard eligibility threshold for inotuzumab ozogamicin (anti-CD22 calicheamicin ADC) — INO-VATE used flow ≥20% of blasts. Cross-disease relevance: - **B-ALL** (~90%+): CD22+ on virtually all B-ALL — required for inotuzumab in R/R B-ALL (INO-VATE 2L+; CR/CRi 81% vs 29% chemo). Also gates moxetumomab (HCL) and emerging CD22 CAR-T trials. - **B-cell NHL** (variable): CD22+ in CLL, MCL, FL, DLBCL — quantitative threshold matters for ADC dosing rationale; qualitative positive for diagnostic panel use. - **HCL**: CD22+ universally (target of moxetumomab). Quantitative measurement matters: weak / partial CD22 expression predicts inferior ADC response. VOD/SOS risk post-allo-HCT (~14% in INO-VATE) — pre-transplant inotuzumab dose limit. `ihc_no_variant` skip reason — protein expression target, not variant lookup.

CSF1R (CD115) is the receptor for colony: CSF1R (CD115) is the receptor for colony-stimulating factor 1 (CSF1/M-CSF) and IL-34. In TGCT (diffuse type, formerly PVNS), the predominant mechanism is CSF1 overexpression by a minority neoplastic cell population (via COL6A3-CSF1 fusion in ~50%), which recruits and drives proliferation of CSF1R-expressing macrophages and osteoclast-like giant cells constituting the bulk of the tumor mass. Pexidartinib (PLX3397) is a CSF1R/KIT/FLT3 inhibitor FDA-approved (2019) specifically for TGCT. CSF1R is also expressed broadly on tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) — multiple investigational agents target TAMs via CSF1R (emactuzumab, cabiralizumab) but none is approved for non-TGCT indications. Do not confuse with KIT (CD117) — pexidartinib inhibits both, but the TGCT approval is CSF1R pathway-driven.

CTCAE v5.0 IRR grading + NCCN/ESMO/MASCC: CTCAE v5.0 IRR grading + NCCN/ESMO/MASCC anaphylaxis management framework. Highest-risk agents for IRR: rituximab cycle 1 (~75% any-grade, ~10% G3+), obinutuzumab cycle 1 day 1 (~65%), daratumumab cycle 1 (~50% IV; ~13% SC), amivantamab cycle 1 day 1 (~65% IV; ~13% SC), cetuximab cycle 1 (~3% G3+; SE US ~20% with alpha-gal IgE), paclitaxel (~10% any-grade; cremophor vehicle hypersensitivity), carboplatin/oxaliplatin (cumulative; cycles 6+ — true IgE-mediated, desensitization protocol indicated), L-asparaginase (anaphylaxis ~5-10% with native E. coli formulation; less with PEG-asparaginase / Erwinia), bleomycin (rare; idiosyncratic). Premedication standard: acetaminophen 650-1000 mg PO + diphenhydramine 25-50 mg PO/IV + ranitidine 50 mg IV (or famotidine 20 mg IV) ≥30 min before infusion; add IV steroid for high-risk agents (rituximab cycle 1, obinutuzumab cycle 1, daratumumab cycle 1, amivantamab cycle 1, taxanes). Slow first-cycle infusion rate is universally protective. Desensitization (incremental dose escalation over 3-4h with 12-step protocol) allows continuation of life-saving therapy in true IgE-mediated reactions — requires allergy/immunology + ICU-capable setting.

PD-L1 wird nicht durch Daten unterstützt.
CTLA-4 irAE pattern differs from PD-1: e: CTLA-4 irAE pattern differs from PD-1: earlier onset (often within first cycle), more colitis, more hypophysitis, less pneumonitis / thyroiditis (vs PD-1). CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift mutation in the C-terminal regulatory domain (e.g., S338X, R334X) in Waldenström macroglobulinemia (WM). CXCR4 WHIM-like mutations co-occur with MYD88 L265P in ~30-40% of MYD88-mutant WM and cause constitutive CXCR4 signaling via loss of the C-terminal regulatory domain. These mutations confer relative resistance to BTK inhibitor (BTKi) monotherapy — lower overall response rate and major-response rate, slower IgM decline kinetics compared to CXCR4-WT MYD88-mutant WM (Treon NEJM 2015; Castillo Blood 2020). Fires to route ALGO-WM-2L step 1 to carfilzomib-based therapy (IND-WM-2L-CARFILZOMIB-CXCR4MUT) rather than zanubrutinib BTKi monotherapy (IND-WM-2L-ZANUBRUTINIB), as BTKi efficacy is substantially attenuated in CXCR4-mutated WM. Detection: CXCR4 C-terminal sequencing by targeted PCR + Sanger or NGS panel with CXCR4 C-terminus coverage. Note: standard NGS panels frequently omit CXCR4 C-terminus; dedicated assay required. Bone marrow aspirate with CD138+ enrichment preferred for adequate WM clone representation. CXCR4 mutation testing is recommended at WM diagnosis per NCCN B-Cell Lymphomas 2025 (alongside MYD88 L265P) to guide initial therapy selection. In CXCR4-mutated patients, BTKi monotherapy response is attenuated; proteasome-inhibitor-based regimens or BR are preferred 1L per NCCN/ESMO. In 2L, carfilzomib-based regimens offer benefit in BTKi-refractory or BTKi-intolerant CXCR4-mutated WM.

Cancer-prevention research context (CPPS: Cancer-prevention research context (CPPS protocol): Calcium carbonate ~3000 mg/day = 1200 mg/day elemental calcium, divided BID-TID with meals. Frequently combined with vitamin D (400-1000 IU/day) in trials. Recommended dietary allowance (RDA) for adults: ~1000-1200 mg/day total elemental calcium (diet + supplements). Avoid exceeding 2000-2500 mg/day total (UL — upper level). Take with food (acid required for absorption); separate from iron, thyroid hormone, bisphosphonates, tetracycline / fluoroquinolone antibiotics by ≥2 hours.
Cancer-prevention research context (FAP: Cancer-prevention research context (FAP duodenal polyposis): ~4 g/day EPA (typically as 2 g BID free fatty acid or icosapent ethyl). Hypertriglyceridemia: 4 g/day (2 capsules BID 1 g each, icosapent ethyl). Take with food. Note FAP cancer-prevention dose has only RCT-trial support, not FDA labeling.
Cancer-prevention research context (PACE: Krebsvermeidungsforschungskontext (PACES-Protokoll): Eflornithin 500 mg PO täglich + Sulindac 150 mg PO täglich (Kombination, nicht Monotherapie). Neuroblastom-Wartung (Iwilfin, on-label, separates Kontext): Gewichtsabhängig; ~750-1500 mg/m2 PO BID — siehe Iwilfin-Label. Audiometrische Überwachung: Ototoxizitätsrisiko; Ausgangswert + periodisches Audiogramm. CBC + LFTs in regelmäßigen Abständen.
Cancer-prevention research context (VITA: Cancer-prevention research context (VITAL protocol): 1 g/day EPA+DHA ethyl-ester capsule (Omacor; ~460 mg EPA + 380 mg DHA). Most epidemiologic-based recommendations: 1-2 g/day total EPA+DHA from fish or supplements. Hypertriglyceridemia (on-label): 4 g/day. Take with food. Some advocate split BID dosing for tolerability. No specific cancer-prevention dose has been validated outside VITAL (null result).

Cancer-prevention research context (VITAL, AMATERASU): 1000-4000 IU PO daily. Most cancer-prevention trials used 1000-2000 IU/day (VITAL: 2000 IU/day) or 2000 IU/day with calcium 1000 mg. Repletion of deficiency (25-OH-D <20 ng/mL): 50,000 IU weekly for 6-8 weeks then maintenance. Maintenance / general supplementation: 800-2000 IU/day. Goal serum 25-OH-D: 30-50 ng/mL (75-125 nmol/L); avoid >100 ng/mL (hypervitaminosis risk).

TROP2 IHC is informational, NOT a gating biomarker — pivotal trial enrolled unselected populations. Histology-based gate (non-squamous) reflects the subgroup analysis showing benefit concentration. clinical_direction = investigate because absolute PFS benefit modest (~0.7 mo overall; ~1.9 mo non-squamous) and OS not reported significantly improved at primary analysis. Capecitabine is contraindicated CrCl <30: Capecitabine is contraindicated CrCl <30 (renally cleared, severe toxicity risk). Oxaliplatin is hepatically cleared but has additive nephrotoxicity in pre-existing CKD; risk-benefit unfavourable in severe CKD where neuropathy is also harder to manage. sLV5FU2-Bev (simplified bolus + 46h CIVI 5-FU + leucovorin + bev) provides a reasonable backbone for mCRC in severe CKD when chemo is still desired. 5-FU is hepatically metabolised (DPD); no dose adjustment needed for renal impairment (parent and metabolites only ~5-10% renal). Bevacizumab dose reduced to 5 mg/kg q2w (vs standard 5-7.5 mg/kg q2w) to limit proteinuria worsening; close BP + UPC monitoring. DPYD pre-screening strongly recommended (CPIC).

Carboplatin + paclitaxel is widely used: Carboplatin + paclitaxel is widely used as first-line chemotherapy for advanced/recurrent adult granulosa cell tumor (AGCT), extrapolated from ovarian cancer chemotherapy practice. No large randomized trial specific to GCT. BEP (bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin) is an alternative (especially in younger patients or when platinum-taxane sensitivity unknown). Response rates ~50–70% in recurrent disease. Surgery remains primary modality; chemo is for advanced/inoperable or chemotherapy-sensitive recurrence. Hormone-directed therapy (leuprolide, letrozole) is active in hormone receptor-positive GCT, especially for maintenance.
Carboplatin + paclitaxel remains the uni: Carboplatin + paclitaxel remains the universal cytotoxic backbone for first-line advanced ovarian cancer in the OpenOnco model. The maintenance decision is made when the patient completes induction and the platinum response is established. Patients who do not respond to platinum re-enter a different algorithm and do not benefit from PARP-inhibitor maintenance in the canonical first-line model. Bevacizumab can begin during induction and continue into maintenance — the chapter is explicit that bevacizumab and PARP inhibitors are not mutually exclusive, particularly for HRD-positive non-BRCA disease.

Cholecalciferol (D3) is hepatically hydr: Cholecalciferol (D3) is hepatically hydroxylated to 25-hydroxyvitamin D (calcidiol), the storage form measured clinically, then renally hydroxylated to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol), the active hormone. Calcitriol binds the nuclear vitamin D receptor (VDR), modulating ~1000+ genes including those involved in cell-cycle arrest (p21, p27), apoptosis, differentiation, and innate immunity. Cancer-prevention rationale: observational ecological gradients (latitude, sunlight) and large cohort 25-OH-D associations suggest reduced incidence of colorectal, breast, and possibly other cancers at higher serum levels. VITAL RCT (Manson NEJM 2019, NCT01169259): 2000 IU/day for ~5 years did NOT reduce total invasive cancer incidence (primary endpoint), with a non-significant 17% reduction in cancer mortality.
Chondrosarcoma decision-making is domina: Chondrosarcoma decision-making is dominated by subtype + grade. Dedifferentiated (~10%) — biphasic with high-grade sarcoma component, behaves aggressively (5-yr OS ~30%) → doxorubicin + ifosfamide adjuvant by extrapolation from soft-tissue sarcoma protocols. Mesenchymal (~3–5%, young adults) — HEY1-NCOA2 fusion-positive small-round-blue-cell biology, treated like Ewing (VDC/IE protocols) — chemo-sensitive. Grade III conventional — consider adjuvant systemic therapy on trial. IDH1 R132 mutant (~40–50% of conventional) — ivosidenib has signal in advanced unresectable disease (Tap et al JCO 2020); off-label / trial. CDKN2A loss is prognostic in dedifferentiated subtype.
Chondrosarcoma metastasizes preferential: Chondrosarcoma metastasizes preferentially to lung — surveillance chest CT every 6–12 mo for ≥10 years standard. Pulmonary metastasectomy for oligometastatic disease yields long-term survival in ~30% of resected patients (extrapolated from sarcoma literature). Local recurrence post-resection rate is grade-dependent (10% grade I, 50% grade III) — re-biopsy mandatory because grade upgrade and dedifferentiation can change adjuvant strategy. Pathologic fracture requires en-bloc resection (pre-fracture curettage no longer adequate — tumor seeding through fracture hematoma). Ollier / Maffucci patients require lifetime imaging surveillance — ~25% lifetime malignant transformation risk.

Chromogranin A (CgA) ist ein granin-familiäres Sekretorprotein, das allgegenwärtig in neuroendokrinen Zellen exprimiert wird. Serum CgA wird als Biomarker für GEP-NET Tumormasse und Behandlungsreaktion und als Zusatz zur MEN1-Trägerüberwachung neben krankheitsspezifischen Hormonen (Gastrin, Insulin, Glucagon, VIP) verwendet. Spezifität ist LOW – PPI-Verwendung (massive falsch-positive Erhöhung), Niereninsuffizienz, Herzinsuffizienz, atrophische Gastritis und Assay-Plattformvariabilität alle confound Interpretation. Sensitivität ~60-90% über NET-Subtypen (höchste in funktionellem Kleinbowel-NET, niedrigste in pNET / Insulinom). ESCAT X — CgA treibt die Auswahl der Behandlung nicht unabhängig an; es ist nur ein Trend-Monitoring-Tool. NCCN NET 2025 und Endokrine Society MEN 2023 erkennen Cg A an, betonen aber seine Grenzen.

Chronic HBV (adult): 300 mg PO once dail: Chronic HBV (adult): 300 mg PO once daily with food, indefinite duration (long-term suppression). HIV-1 (adult): 300 mg PO once daily as component of combination ART. Renal adjustment required: CrCl 30-49 → 300 mg q48h; CrCl 10-29 → 300 mg q72-96h; HD → 300 mg weekly after dialysis. Pediatric (≥2 y, ≥10 kg): 8 mg/kg PO daily, max 300 mg. Continue HBV therapy long- term — abrupt discontinuation risks severe HBV reactivation / acute hepatitis flare (black-box warning).
Chronic HBV (adult, compensated liver di: Chronische HBV (Erwachsene, kompensierte Lebererkrankung): 25 mg PO einmal täglich mit Nahrung, unbefristete Dauer. HIV-1: TAF ist ein Bestandteil von Fixkombinationen (z.B. Biktarvy = Bictegravir + Emtricitabin + TAF; Genvoya; Descovy) — Dosis eingestellt durch das FDC, typischerweise 25 mg TAF / Tag. Keine Anpassung der Nierendosis für CrCl ≥15 ml/min; HD-Patienten können 25 mg täglich nach Dialyse an Dialysetagen erhalten. Differentiation syndrome — boxed warning class effect — not observed in ClarIDHy cholangio cohort but possible per labelling and AML experience; clinicians should remain aware. Classical P-loop mutation of ABL1. Reduc: Classical P-loop mutation of ABL1. Reduces nilotinib sensitivity (IC50 ~5-7x baseline) and imatinib sensitivity (IC50 ~10-20x); associated with adverse prognosis on imatinib. Dasatinib, bosutinib, ponatinib retain in-vitro activity. Per ELN-2020 / ELN-2025: detection on nilotinib or imatinib failure → switch to dasatinib (preferred 2G-TKI option) or ponatinib. P-loop mutations as a class (E255K, Y253H, G250E) generally favor dasatinib-based salvage; T315I excluded per separate biomarker.
Classical gatekeeper mutation analogous: Classical gatekeeper mutation analogous to EGFR T790M and ALK L1196M. T315 normally forms a hydrogen bond with imatinib; the T→I substitution introduces a bulky isoleucine side chain that sterically blocks all type-II ATP-competitive TKIs (imatinib, nilotinib, dasatinib, bosutinib). Ponatinib (PACE, Cortes 2013) was specifically designed to accommodate the I315 side chain via a triple-bond linker and remains active. Asciminib (ASCEMBL, Rea 2021) — an allosteric STAMP inhibitor binding the myristoyl pocket — also retains activity at higher doses (200 mg BID for T315I). Per ELN-2020 and ELN-2025, T315I screening is mandatory at TKI failure or suboptimal response; presence dictates ponatinib or asciminib choice over 2G-TKI. In Ph+ B-ALL, T315I emerges rapidly under non-ponatinib TKI pressure — ponatinib + chemo (or + blinatumomab) is preferred when detected.

Distinct from MCED (BIO-CFDNA-METHYLATION-MCED) in that ctDNA-MRD assumes a known prior cancer diagnosis with post-curative-intent surgery / chemoradiation. Strongest evidence in CRC (GALAXY / CIRCULATE-Japan, Kotani Nat Med 2023): MRD-positive post-op patients ~22% 18-mo DFS vs ~93% MRD- negative; MRD-positive benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy. Emerging evidence in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (IMvigor010 ctDNA subgroup), early breast cancer (c-TRAK-TN), NSCLC (post-IMpower010 retrospectives), pancreatic, gastric. ESMO 2024 endorses ctDNA-MRD as a prognostic biomarker for CRC stage II adjuvant decision-making (May inform adjuvant chemo discussion when MRD+ at 4-8 weeks post-op). NOT recommended for asymptomatic-population screening — entry is surveillance of KNOWN prior cancer survivors. `applicable_in_asymptomatic: false` — patient has documented cancer history, not asymptomatic in the prevention sense. Companion to BIO-EBV-STATUS (qualitative: Companion to BIO-EBV-STATUS (qualitative tissue EBER-ISH). EBV-DNA is the *quantitative* serum marker used for: - **Extranodal NK/T nasal-type lymphoma**: pre-treatment baseline; monitoring during SMILE / DDGP / asparaginase-based regimens; post-treatment surveillance. Rising EBV-DNA on therapy correlates with poor response; persistent post-treatment positivity predicts relapse. - **PTLD**: EBV-driven PTLD shows EBV-DNA load decrease with rituximab + reduced immunosuppression; trend is response surrogate. - **HIV-associated EBV+ DLBCL / plasmablastic / primary effusion**: contextual; not standardly used for treatment decisions. - **Post-HSCT monitoring**: weekly EBV-DNA used to detect early PTLD risk; preemptive rituximab if doubling. In alcohol use disorder (AUD), blocks endogenous opioid-mediated reward signaling triggered by alcohol ingestion → reduces craving and heavy-drinking days. Competitive inhibitor of 5-alpha-reducta: Competitive Hemmkörper der 5-alpha-Reduktase Typ 2 Isoenzym; blockiert die Umwandlung von Testosteron zu Dihydrotestosterone (DHT) in Prostata, Haarfollikel und Haut. Reduziert intraprostatische DHT um ~85-90%, während Serumtestotestoester ~10-15% steigt. Prostatakrebs Prävention Begründung: Senkung DHT reduziert androgen-getriebene epitheliale Proliferation. Prostatakrebspräventionsstudie (PCPT, NCT00000484, Thompson NEJM 2003 + 2013 Langzeit): 25% relative Reduktion der Inzidenz von Prostatakrebs nach 7 Jahren, aber Signal für einen erhöhten Gleason ≥7 Nachweis (re-analyziert und teilweise auf Detektionsneigung zurückzuführen; Langzeitmortalität nicht erhöht).
Competitive inhibitor of both type 1 and: Competitive inhibitor of both type 1 and type 2 isoforms of 5-alpha- reductase, contrasting with finasteride (type 2 selective). Covalently and irreversibly binds alpha-: Covalently and irreversibly binds alpha-1 and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, producing a long-acting, non-competitive blockade of catecholamine-mediated vasoconstriction. Cronkhite-Canada syndrome — acquired non-Mendelian polyposis- ectodermal syndrome. Rare (~1000 reported cases globally; primarily middle-aged + elderly adults). Clinical presentation: gastrointestinal polyposis (juvenile-like, throughout stomach + small bowel + colon diffusely) + ectodermal changes (diffuse alopecia, nail dystrophy with onycholysis, skin hyperpigmentation) + protein-losing enteropathy (hypoalbuminemia, edema, weight loss, electrolyte derangement). Lifetime CRC risk ~12-25%; gastric cancer also elevated per IPCG case-series. Pathogenesis unclear — autoimmune-like; may respond to immunosuppression (prednisone, azathioprine) + nutritional support; untreated mortality high (~50% 5-year if uncontrolled). Cumulative anthracycline cardiotoxicity: Cumulative anthracycline cardiotoxicity is dose-dependent: doxorubicin ≥250 mg/m² lifetime — significant CHF risk, ≥450 mg/m² — high risk (Swain 2003); epirubicin equivalent ≈ 0.7x doxorubicin; idarubicin ≈ 4x doxorubicin per mg. Standard R-CHOP delivers 300 mg/m² across 6 cycles — leaves headroom for relapse/salvage. Patients who received AC-T (240 mg/m² doxorubicin) for breast then progress to lymphoma have ~60 mg/m² remaining safely; substitute liposomal doxorubicin or R-CEOP. Trastuzumab cardiotoxicity is reversible (unlike anthracycline) but co-administration with anthracycline contraindicated; staggered AC→T → trastuzumab standard. Mediastinal RT (Hodgkin survivor) doubles anthracycline cardiotoxicity risk per equivalent dose.

Suppresses ACTH secretion from corticotroph adenomas (Cushing disease) and, via SSTR2/SSTR5, GH/IGF-1 secretion from somatotroph adenomas (acromegaly), including tumors with an inadequate response to first-generation SSA. Two formulations: subcutaneous (short-acting, Cushing disease) and long-acting release (LAR, intramuscular monthly — acromegaly and surgery-ineligible/persistent Cushing disease).

DICER1 germline pathogenic variants cause DICER1 tumor predisposition syndrome — broad spectrum centered on pleuropulmonary blastoma (PPB) in early childhood, ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in adolescence / young-adult females, multinodular goiter + differentiated thyroid cancer, cystic nephroma, embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (cervix / bladder / kidney), pineoblastoma, and pituitary blastoma. Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (per International PPB Registry Consensus / Stewart et al. 2019 / DICER1 Cancer Predisposition Surveillance Statement): chest CT (low-dose) at age 3-6 months + 2.5 years + 8 years (PPB peak incidence < 6 years), chest X-ray q6mo to age 8 then annually to age 12, abdominal/pelvic US q6-12mo from infancy through age 8 then annual through adolescence, thyroid US q3y starting age 8, gynecologic exam + transabdominal pelvic US annual from age 8-10 (Sertoli-Leydig). Symptom-directed brain MRI for pineoblastoma / pituitary blastoma concern. Smoking avoidance is critical (synergistic lung-tumor risk). ESCAT IIA.

Diagnostic criterion for ET (~25%) and P: Diagnostic criterion for ET (~25%) and PMF (~25–30%); essentially absent in PV. Mutually exclusive with JAK2 V617F and MPL W515 (the three drive ~95% of MPNs). Type 1 (52-bp del) carries more myelofibrotic phenotype and better OS in PMF; type 2 (5-bp ins) more thrombocytosis-predominant ET phenotype with lower thrombosis risk. JAK inhibitors (ruxolitinib, momelotinib, fedratinib, pacritinib) are not mutation-specific — they target downstream JAK-STAT, so they work in CALR-, JAK2-, and MPL-driven disease. Mutant CALR is also a tumor-specific neoantigen — anti-mutCALR immunotherapy in early-phase trials.
Diagnostic for PV (V617F or exon 12 — to: Diagnostic for PV (V617F or exon 12 — together ≥98%), ET (~50–60% V617F), PMF (~50–60% V617F). Mutually exclusive with CALR and MPL. JAK2 inhibitors (ruxolitinib COMFORT-I/II; fedratinib JAKARTA-2; pacritinib PERSIST-2; momelotinib MOMENTUM) treat MF symptoms + splenomegaly across all driver genotypes. Ruxolitinib is also 1L for hydroxyurea-resistant / -intolerant PV (RESPONSE) and approved for symptomatic / high-risk ET in some jurisdictions. Allele burden reduction on therapy correlates with longer-term outcomes in PV / MF but is not a treatment switch trigger.

Differentiated thyroid carcinoma — most: Differentiated thyroid carcinoma — most indolent of common cancers. Standard care: surgery → risk-stratified RAI ablation → TSH suppression → calibrated thyroglobulin (Tg) monitoring. Radioiodine-refractory progressive disease is the trigger for systemic therapy: - Multikinase TKI 1L: lenvatinib (SELECT) or sorafenib (DECISION). - Targeted by genotype: * BRAF V600E (~50% PTC): dabrafenib + trametinib (MARCH/REINK compassionate-use; FDA tumor-agnostic 2022 BRAF V600E approval for solid tumors); single-agent dabrafenib also active. * RET fusion: selpercatinib (LIBRETTO-531; positive 2024) and pralsetinib (ARROW) — selpercatinib FDA-approved for RET-fusion+ thyroid cancer. * NTRK fusion: larotrectinib / entrectinib (tumor-agnostic). * Re-differentiation strategies: short-course MAPK inhibitor (selumetinib / dabrafenib + trametinib) restoring RAI uptake — under study. Aggressive variants (tall cell, hobnail, columnar, diffuse sclerosing) upstage to higher recurrence-risk groups even when small.

Symptoms: dyspnea, fever, lung infiltrates, hypoxia, pleural / pericardial effusion, bone pain, edema, hyperleukocytosis, hypotension, renal dysfunction. Treat empirically with dexamethasone + hemodynamic support; hold olutasidenib for severe cases until DS resolves.

Do NOT use radioactive iodine (RAI) in M: Do NOT use radioactive iodine (RAI) in MTC — parafollicular C-cells do not concentrate iodide; RAI has zero efficacy.

Do NOT use this regimen if cumulative an: Verwenden Sie dieses Schema NICHT, wenn sich kumulatives Anthracyclin an 550 mg/m2 Lebensdauer nähert.

Do NOT use with confirmed history of sev: NICHT mit bestätigter Vorgeschichte schwerer VOD/SOS — absoluter KI anwenden.

Do NOT use without on-site tocilizumab (: Nicht ohne Tocilizumab vor Ort (≥ 2 Dosis) anwenden — tödliches CRS möglich.

Do not add GO in adverse-risk AML (TP53-: Nicht GO in die AML mit unerwünschtem Risiko (TP53-mutanter, komplexer Karyotyp, Monosomie 7) einzufügen — kein Nutzen + Toxizität besteht fort.

Do not add chemoimmunotherapy before eva: Fügen Sie keine Chemoimmuntherapie hinzu, bevor Sie das Ansprechen auf DAA im Monat 6 bewerten (vorzeitige Eskalation negiert die Essenz der antiviralen ersten Logik).
Do not administer Gardasil-9 during acut: Gardasil-9 darf nicht während einer akuten schweren Erkrankung verabreicht werden — verschieben.
Do not administer Gardasil-9 during preg: Gardasil-9 darf während der Schwangerschaft nicht angewendet werden — auf das Postpartum verschieben (obwohl eine versehentliche Impfung keine Teratogenität aufweist).
Do not administer PPI on UBT day — false: Verabreichen Sie PPI nicht am UBT-Tag — falsch-negatives Ergebnis.
Do not administer bendamustine at CrCl <: Do not administer bendamustine at CrCl <30 mL/min without dose adjustment — toxicity increases exponentially.

Do not administer therapy without prior: Eine Therapie ohne vorherige Schilddrüsenblockade (Kaliumiodid/Iod) darf nicht angewendet werden.

Do not auto-prescribe aspirin without bl: Aspirin darf nicht automatisch verschreiben, ohne Blutungsrisiko, GI/Nierenfunktion und gleichzeitige Abschätzung von Thrombozyten- und Gerinnungshemmern.

Do not combine with other myelosuppressi: Nicht ohne Einstellung mit anderen myelosuppressiven Substanzen kombinieren.

Do not combine with peg-IFN without a cl: Nicht mit Peg-IFN ohne ein klares Protokoll kombinieren.

Do not combine with warfarin without mod: Nicht mit Warfarin kombinieren, ohne eine modifizierte INR-Überwachung zu haben — INR steigt erheblich.
Do not combine with warfarin without str: Nicht mit Warfarin kombinieren, ohne eine strenge Überwachung zu haben — Blutungsrisiko (obwohl niedriger als Ibrutinib).

Do not consider e-cigarettes / vaping a: Nicht in Betracht ziehen e-Zigaretten / vaping ein stopping-Tool — IARC empfiehlt dagegen; die stoppage-Tools oben haben Sicherheitsprofil festgelegt.
Do not consider observation equivalent t: Nicht als Beobachtung der antiviralen Unterdrückung betrachten — Inzidenz-Reduktion fehlt.
Do not continue >12 weeks without object: Do not continue >12 weeks without objective response (PR/CR) — early switch to ICI or BRAFi+MEKi if BRAF-co-mutated.

Do not continue HRT by default without s: Die HRT darf nicht standardmäßig ohne Überprüfung der gemeinsamen Entscheidung im Jahr 5 und jährlich fortgesetzt werden.
Do not continue PPI indefinitely after a: Nach akutem Ereignis (Stressulkus, Post-NSAID) dürfen Sie die PPI nicht unbegrenzt fortsetzen — bei jeder Nachbeobachtung erneut bewerten.
Do not continue PPI without active indic: Nicht ohne aktive Indikationsüberprüfung weiter PPI – De-Verschreibung ist die höchstmögliche Intervention, nicht Überwachung.
Do not continue after the first progress: Nach der ersten Progression nicht mehr weiterführen — die Wirksamkeit von Einzelwirkstoffen ist begrenzt; die klinische Empfehlung ist in Betracht zu ziehen.
Do not continue at Grade ≥3 irAE without: Bei Schweregrad ≥ 3 irAE darf nicht ohne dauerhafte Absetzen weitergeführt werden.
Do not continue at grade 3 effusions / e: Nicht bei Erguss/Ödem der Klasse 3 weiterführen — halten + Diuretikum; dauerhaftes Absetzen in Betracht ziehen.
Do not continue at suspicion of pneumoni: Nicht weiter bei Verdacht auf Pneumonitis — sofortiger Halt + Pulmonologe + Kortikosteroide.
Do not continue ipi+nivo with Grade ≥3 i: Ipi+nivo darf nicht mit Grad ≥3 irAE fortgesetzt werden — auf nivo warten oder aufhören.
Do not continue maintenance at Grade ≥2: Die Erhaltung der neuropathie ≥ 2 darf nicht fortgesetzt werden — dauerhafter Abbruch.
Do not continue maintenance with diagnos: Die Erhaltung mit diagnostizierter zweiter maligner Erkrankung darf nicht fortgesetzt werden, ohne den Nutzen des Risikos zu überprüfen.
Do not continue observation in the prese: Nicht weiterhin beobachten in Gegenwart von Darmmetaplase / Dysplasie bei der Biopsie - dies ist vorkanzerös, erfordert die Tilgung + verstärkte Überwachung Endoskopie.
Do not continue observation when transfo: Beobachten Sie nicht weiter, wenn Transformationsflaggen auftreten (schnelle Lymphadenopathie, B-Symptome, steigende LDH) – Weg zur Behandlungsperson.
Do not continue through Grade ≥3 irAE wi: Sie dürfen nicht über Grad ≥ 3 irAE ohne dauerhafte Absetzen der Behandlung weitergeführt werden.
Do not continue with active uncontrolled: Nicht mit einer aktiven unkontrollierten Infektion fortfahren — Pause bis Auflösung vorgeschrieben ist.
Do not continue with gr ≥3 irAE without: Bei gr ≥ 3 irAE darf nicht ohne hochdosierte Steroide (1-2 mg/kg Prednisolonäquivalent) weiter gegeben werden — eine Verzögerung der Behandlung kann tödlich sein.
Bei gr ≥ 3 irAE darf nicht ohne erneute Bewertung des Nutzens/Risikos fortgesetzt werden — adjuvant ist kurative Absicht, Schwelle für das dauerhafte Absetzen niedriger als metastasiert.
Do not continue without response — if no: Nicht ohne Reaktion weiterführen — wenn kein TI um 6 Monate, stoppen; alternative (luspatercept, imetelstat) betrachten.
Do not default to medical therapy ahead: Nicht vor der chirurgischen Bewertung für ein operativ zugängliches Somatotrophadenom ohne multidisziplinäre Diskussion der medizinischen Therapie voreingestellt werden.
Do not default to total bilateral adrena: Nicht auf die gesamte bilaterale Adrenalinektomie ohne Berücksichtigung kortikal-sparing Technik in bilateralen / erblichen Erkrankungen -- Risiko für lebenslange Nebenniereninsuffizienz.
Do not defer prophylactic thyroidectomy: Verzögern Sie die prophylaktische Schilddrüsenektomie in der HST-Klasse (M918T) nicht über das erste Lebensjahr hinaus — MTC kann in den Kinderschuhen invasiv sein.
Do not delay ENT-oncology referral for f: Verzögern Sie nicht die ENT-Onkologie-Beweisung für die Ergebnisse der Masse / Knochenerosion auf CT — prompte Biopsie erforderlich ist.
Do not delay GI screening to age 50 — fi: Verzögern Sie die GI-Screening-Prüfung nicht auf das Alter von 50 Jahren — Feuerwehr-Kohorten-Anleitung unterstützt die Prüfung der früheren Initiierung im Alter von 40-45 Jahren.
