Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-HEPATOBILIARY currently a STUB; SRC-ROAR-SUBBIAH-2020 (biliary cohort) not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — JAK-inhibito: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — JAK-inhibitor therapy is genotype- agnostic (works for V617F, CALR, MPL, and triple-negative MF) because it targets downstream activated JAK-STAT signaling rather than the upstream mutation. Risk stratification (DIPSS-Plus, MIPSS70+v2) considers V617F allele burden indirectly via cytogenetics / molecular high-risk features. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025 STUB.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — JAK2 mutatio: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — JAK2 mutation status is required for diagnosis (WHO 2022 major criterion) and dictates eligibility for JAK-targeted therapy. Risk model: IPSS-PV (age, leukocytosis, thrombosis history). The V617F allele burden may correlate with phenotype severity but is not used as a treatment-selection threshold in current guidelines (per SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025, SRC-ESMO-MPN-2015). Exon 12 JAK2 mutations (~3%) cause idiopathic erythrocytosis with similar management — see notes on detection. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025 currently STUB; awaits full ingestion.

ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — JAK2 mutation status is required for diagnosis and risk stratification (IPSET-thrombosis upgrades JAK2- positive patients into higher-risk strata per SRC-ESMO-MPN-2015). V617F allele burden does not determine treatment choice. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025 STUB; awaits full ingestion.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — definitional: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — definitional, prognostic, and MRD- trackable. Co-occurring FLT3-ITD high-allelic-ratio shifts NPM1-mut AML from favorable to intermediate/adverse risk per SRC-ELN-AML-2022; see also BMA-FLT3-ITD-AML for FLT3-targeted therapy. Mutation- specific therapy (e.g., menin inhibitors revumenib / ziftomenib in NPM1-mutated R/R AML) is in late-phase trials but has no FDA approval for NPM1 yet; menin-inhibitor sources not in repo.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — diagnostic c: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — diagnostic criterion + risk stratifier (favorable in MIPSS70+v2 when type-1). JAK inhibitors are mutation- agnostic (downstream JAK-STAT inhibition). Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025 STUB.

ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1 — diagnostic criterion. CALR type-1 (52-bp deletion) is more common in PMF and confers better OS than type-2 per several retrospective series; type-2 is enriched in ET. CALR- specific therapeutics (anti-CALR monoclonal antibodies, e.g. INCA 033989) are in early-phase trials only; no in-repo source ingested yet. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-MPN-2025 STUB.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. ATC is a clin: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. ATC is a clinical emergency — initiate BRAF testing on the same day as biopsy diagnosis per SRC-NCCN-THYROID-2025 ("RAID" workflow). Resistance: development of MEK reactivation, alternative MAPK isoforms; triple combination with anti-PD-1 (ATLEP trial) is investigational. Source-gap: SRC-ROAR-SUBBIAH-2018 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. CD30 IHC is u: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. CD30 IHC is universally positive in cHL, so the biomarker is essentially a histologic-confirmation gate rather than a selection threshold for the drug class. Bibliographic records SRC-ECHELON-1-CONNORS-2018 and SRC-AETHERA-MOSKOWITZ-2015 are available; SRC-CHECKMATE-744 remains a source gap and claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off. PD-1 checkpoint inhibitors (pembrolizumab KEYNOTE-204, nivolumab CheckMate-205) are alternative biology-driven options in R/R cHL.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. Existing BMA-: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. Existing BMA-ALK-FUSION-ALCL covers ALK- rearranged subset (where crizotinib R/R has different role). For sALCL, BV+CHP is genotype-agnostic 1L (covers ALK-positive and ALK- negative). ECHELON-2 enrolled CD30+ PTCL with ≥10% expression — that threshold is the standard inclusion gate. Bibliographic record SRC-ECHELON-2-HORWITZ-2019 is available; SRC-AHOD1331 remains a source gap and claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. Gastric HER2: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. Gastric HER2 scoring (Hofmann 2008) differs from breast: basolateral/lateral membranous staining ≥10% qualifies (cf. circumferential criterion in breast). HER2 testing recommended for all metastatic gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma at diagnosis. Heterogeneity is significant: ≥4 endoscopic biopsies preferred. Bibliographic record SRC-DESTINY-GASTRIC01-SHITARA-2020 is available; SRC-TOGA-BANG-2010 and SRC-KEYNOTE-811 remain source gaps. Claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. HER2 testing: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. HER2 testing for adenocarcinoma histology only (not squamous). Heterogeneity high — ≥4 biopsies recommended. Bibliographic record SRC-DESTINY-GASTRIC01-SHITARA-2020 is available; SRC-TOGA-BANG-2010 and SRC-KEYNOTE-811 remain source gaps. Claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. HRD assays ar: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. HRD assays are not interchangeable — Myriad MyChoice CDx, FoundationOne CDx, and Caris all use different scoring models; FDA companion-diagnostic specificity matters. HRD- negative patients still derive smaller niraparib benefit (PRIMA all- comers) but ESMO 2024 explicitly de-prioritizes PARP maintenance in HRD-negative platinum-sensitive recurrence — documented disagreement with NCCN that lists niraparib for HRD-negative as well. Flagged for clinical-co-lead review. Bibliographic records SRC-SOLO1-MOORE-2018, SRC-PAOLA1-RAY-COQUARD-2019, and SRC-PRIMA-GONZALEZ-MARTIN-2019 are available; claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. IDH1 mutation: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 1. IDH1 mutations are mutually exclusive with FGFR2 fusions in cholangiocarcinoma; molecular profiling should cover both. Ivosidenib also has on-label use in IDH1-mutated AML (see existing BMAs). Resistance mechanisms: IDH2 isoform switching, receptor tyrosine kinase upregulation. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-HEPATOBILIARY STUB; SRC-CLARIDHY-ABOU-ALFA-2020 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 2 (predictive bi: ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 2 (predictive biomarker — selects between drug classes, no targeted IGHV agent). IGHV-mutated favorable-risk patients without TP53 disruption have durable PFS with FCR (E1912 showed FCR was non-inferior to ibrutinib+rituximab in IGHV-mut), but FCR carries long-term MDS/AML risk so younger patients are increasingly offered targeted therapy regardless. Bibliographic record SRC-ELEVATE-TN-SHARMAN-2020 is available; SRC-CLL14-FISCHER-2019 and SRC-ECOG-E1912-SHANAFELT-2019 remain source gaps. Claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.

ESCAT IA / OncoKB Level 2 (predictive biomarker; not a target). MGMT testing recommended for ALL newly-diagnosed GBM; methodology = MS-PCR or pyrosequencing; mosaic / weakly-methylated intermediate cases remain therapeutically ambiguous. In MGMT-unmethylated GBM, the benefit of TMZ is small but Stupp remains standard outside of trials per SRC-EANO-GBM-2024 — see notes on contradictions: NCCN does not withhold TMZ from unmethylated patients while EANO 2024 explicitly considers RT-alone an acceptable alternative for unmethylated elderly. This represents a documented evidence-based disagreement between guidelines — flagged for clinical-co-lead review. Source-gap: SRC-STUPP-NEJM-2005, SRC-PERRY-NEJM-2017, SRC-CETEG-NOA09 not ingested.
ESCAT IA per ESMO precision-medicine WG. OncoKB Level 1. Companion Diagnostik: cobas 4800 BRAF V600 Mutation Test, THxID-BRAF, FoundationEine CDx. V600K verhält sich klinisch wie V600E (leicht niedrigere Ansprechraten) und teilt alle Zulassungen.
ESCAT IA per PAPILLON. OncoKB Level 1. N: ESCAT IA per PAPILLON. OncoKB Level 1. NGS bevorzugt als PCR für die Erkennung – viele Ex20in-Varianten fehlen durch Hotspot PCR-Panels. A763_Y764insFQEA ist die seltene klassisch-TKI-sensible Ausnahme.
ESCAT IA per THOR cohort 1. OncoKB Level: ESCAT IA pro THOR-Kohorte 1. OncoKB-Level 1. Begleitdiagnostik: Therascreen FGFR RGQ RT-PCR Kit. Hyperphosphatämie und okuläre Toxizität (CSR) sind Erdafitinib-Klasse Effekte, die eine Überwachung erfordern.
ESCAT IA — defines the disease + drives: ESCAT IA — definiert die Krankheit + treibt intensive Regimewahl. ZNS-Prophylaxe obligatorisch. Vermeiden Sie R-CHOP — Unterhaut.
ESCAT IA — extended-RAS WT testing is co: ESCAT IA — extended-RAS WT-Tests sind begleiterdiagnostische Standards.
ESCAT IA. ASCENT established sacituzumab: ESCAT IA. ASCENT established sacituzumab govitecan (anti-Trop-2 ADC with SN-38 payload) as standard ≥2L for metastatic TNBC pretreated with ≥2 prior chemo lines (≥1 in metastatic). No biomarker gating — Trop-2 expression is universal in TNBC. Severe AE profile: neutropenia G3+ 51% (G-CSF primary prophylaxis recommended), diarrhea G3+ 10%. UGT1A1*28 homozygous patients require dose reduction. Default 2L for non-BRCA TNBC; default 3L for BRCA-mut TNBC after PARPi failure. UA access barrier: not registered; named-patient import / EAP / cross-border only.
ESCAT IA. BRCA-mutant 2L+ maintenance —: ESCAT IA. BRCA-mutant 2L+ Wartung — am meisten nachgewiesen PARPi (SOLO2). Plan-Track aggressiv, weil es erhebliche PFS/OS über keine Wartung.
ESCAT IA. CAPItello-291 established capi: ESCAT IA. CAPItello-291 etablierte Capivasertib + Fulvestrant für HR+/HER2- mit PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN-Änderung nach KI ± CDK4/6i Progression. Breitere Biomarkerabdeckung als Alpelisib (die nur auf PIK 3CA eingeht): pfadveränderte Kohorte angereichert ~41 % ITT. Durchfall (72 %) Management dominante Workflow-Bürde – Loperamid zur Hand ab Tag 1, intermittierende 4-on/3-off-Dosierung verbessert absichtlich die Verträglichkeit. UA Zugangsbarriere: CapivaSertib noch nicht registriert; benannt-Patienten Import / EPA nur. PTEN-Verlust-Definition erfordert operativ kombiniertes IHC + NGS (pro CAPItello-Einschreibungskriterien). Wenn sowohl PIK3CA-mut als auch AKT1/PTEN koexistieren, wird Capivasertib gegenüber Alpelisib bevorzugt, um die Trassenspektrumabdeckung und die intermittierende Verträglichkeit der Dosis zu erreichen.
ESCAT IA. CD74-ROS1 specifically linked: ESCAT IA. CD74-ROS1 specifically linked to higher CNS dissemination — bias toward CNS-active TKI (entrectinib, repotrectinib) over crizotinib.
ESCAT IA. Catch-all for non-canonical ex: ESCAT IA. Catch-all for non-canonical exon 20 PIK3CA hotspots.
ESCAT IA. Catch-all for non-canonical exon 9 PIK3CA hotspots covered by SOLAR-1 / CAPItello inclusion criteria.
ESCAT IA. Companion diagnostic includes: ESCAT IA. Companion Diagnostik umfasst R248C in der Platte.
ESCAT IA. Companion diagnostic panel pos: ESCAT IA. Companion Diagnose Panel positiv.
ESCAT IA. DESTINY-Breast04 included a sm: ESCAT IA. DESTINY-Breast04 included a small TNBC HER2-low cohort (n=63) with consistent benefit signal — T-DXd should be preferred over sacituzumab when HER2-low confirmed (IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH-). When HER2-IHC = 0, sacituzumab govitecan (ASCENT) is the default ≥2L. ILD risk dominant safety concern — baseline CT chest + active monitoring. UA access barrier: T-DXd registered but reimbursement under negotiation. Sequencing question (T-DXd then sacituzumab vs reverse) is unsettled; ALGO-BREAST-TNBC-2L defaults to T-DXd-first for HER2-low.
ESCAT IA. DESTINY-Breast04 transformed H: ESCAT IA. DESTINY-Breast04 transformed HER2-low (IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/ISH-) from a "negative" category into an actionable one for T-DXd. HR+ subset must have progressed on endocrine ± CDK4/6i and received ≥1 prior chemo line for metastatic disease (OR rapid progression making chemo immediately needed). ILD risk dominant safety concern (~12% any grade, 1.3% G3+ in DB-04) — baseline CT chest + active monitoring; immediate hold + corticosteroids if pneumonitis suspect. UA access barrier: T-DXd registered but reimbursement under negotiation; significant out-of-pocket cost. Sequencing question: T-DXd vs sequential targetable-mutation drugs (capivasertib/alpelisib/elacestrant when applicable) is unsettled — see ALGO-BREAST-HR-POS-2L for default ordering.
ESCAT IA. Differentiation syndrome class: ESCAT IA. Differentiation syndrome class AE — prophylactic dexamethasone protocol per ELN. Companion dx: Abbott RealTime IDH1.
ESCAT IA. Disease-defining; doesn't 'sel: ESCAT IA. Disease-defining; doesn't 'select' BTKi but the DIS-MCL algorithm is BTKi-centric.
ESCAT IA. EMBRACA established talazopari: ESCAT IA. EMBRACA established talazoparib (1 mg PO daily) for germline BRCA1/2-mutant HER2- metastatic breast (≤3 prior cytotoxic regimens). Comparable efficacy to olaparib (no head-to-head trial), different AE profile: more haematologic (anaemia G3+ ~39%), less GI than olaparib. Patient preference and AE-profile drive the olaparib-vs-talazoparib choice. KNOWN GAP: dedicated REG-TALAZOPARIB-BREAST regimen entry not yet authored — current placeholder points to REG-OLAPARIB-BREAST. Engine trace must surface that talazoparib dosing differs (1 mg PO daily monotherapy continuous; reduce to 0.75 mg if anaemia, then 0.5 mg). Follow-up authoring task. UA access: talazoparib not reimbursed.
ESCAT IA. EMERALD established elacestran: ESCAT IA. EMERALD established elacestrant (oral SERD) for ESR1-mutant HR+/HER2- after AI ± CDK4/6i progression. ESR1 mutations are acquired on AI therapy (~30-40% of post-AI metastatic) and predict AI resistance — ctDNA testing at progression is the preferred detection method (subclonal, polyclonal in tissue). Modest absolute PFS gain in overall ESR1-mut cohort (3.8 vs 1.9 mo) but enriched in long-CDK4/6i-exposed subgroup. Other oral SERDs (camizestrant, giredestrant, imlunestrant) and PROTACs (vepdegestrant) in late development. UA access barrier: elacestrant not registered; named-patient import / EAP / cross-border only.
ESCAT IA. HER2-low reclassification (IHC: ESCAT IA. HER2-niedrige Reklassifizierung (IHC 1+ oder 2+/ISH-) ist jetzt klinisch umsetzbar – ein Paradigmenwechsel von binär HER2+/- zu einer dreistufigen Klassifikation (HER2-positiv / HER2-low / HER2zero). Reflex HER2 IHC mit sorgfältiger 1+ vs 0 Unterscheidung jetzt bei allen metastasierenden Brustproben pro NCCN/ESMO erforderlich. ILD-Management: CT-Basis-Truhe, Überwachung bei jedem Zyklus, Dosisreduktion/Hold/Discontinuing-Algorithmus pro NccN. DESTINY-Breast06 weiter verlängerter Nutzen für HER2-ultralow (IHC 0 mit unvollständiger/faint Färbung) — diese spezifische Untergruppe erfordert eine separate BIO-Entität (BIO-HER2-ULTRALOW), wenn die Neuklassifizierung durch Pathologie bestätigt wird.
ESCAT IA. HER2CLIMB established tucatini: ESCAT IA. HER2CLIMB established tucatinib + trastuzumab + capecitabine for HER2+ metastatic ≥3L (post-trastuzumab + post-T-DXd in current era). Major unmet need addressed: active brain metastases — first regimen with prospectively-demonstrated intracranial activity. CNS-PFS doubling justifies preferred positioning when brain mets present (active or treated). MRI brain required pre-treatment to characterize CNS disease. Diarrhea management dominant clinical workflow burden — combined effect of tucatinib + capecitabine. UA access barrier: tucatinib not registered; named-patient import / EAP only. T-DM1 remains an alternative when tucatinib not accessible (KATHERINE / EMILIA data — not modeled in this batch).
ESCAT IA. INAVO120 (NCT04191499): inavol: ESCAT IA. INAVO120 (NCT04191499): Inavolisib + Palbociclib + Fulvestrant in der PIK3CA-mutanten HR+/HER2- metastasierten Brust mit endokrin-resistenter Erkrankung (Erscheinung auf/innerhalb von 12 Mo des Abschlusses einer adjuvanten enokrinen Therapie oder des de-novo metastastatisch). Median PFS 15.0 vs 7.3 mo (HR 0.43). FDA-Zulassung Oktober 2024 (Itovebi). Mutant-selektives Design ergibt eine niedrigere Hyperglykämie + Ausschlagbelastung als Alpelisib unter Wahrung der Wirksamkeit. Vorbehandlung PIK3-CA-Test (Gewebe NGS oder ctDNA) erforderlich. Test-source SRC-INAVO120-TURNER-2024 noch nicht in KB aufgenommen — Zitate fallen zurück auf NCCN + ESMO-Richtlinie Quellen; markiert für die Nachbereitung der Quell-Stub-Generation. UA-Zugangsbarriere: inavolisib nicht registriert; nur der Name des Patienten Import / EAP.
ESCAT IA. INDIGO trial is the first phas: ESCAT IA. INDIGO-Studie ist die erste Phase III RCT, die PFS-Vorteil mit einem gezielten Wirkstoff in niedriggradigen Gliomen demonstriert. IDH-Mutationstests durch Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation oder Immunhistochemie (IDH1 R132H-Antikörper - umfasst >90%) sind nun in allen WHO-Grad 2-3 Gliom pro WHO-CNS 2021 Klassifikation obligatorisch. Vorasidenib hat eine bessere CNS-Penetration als Ivosidenib (speziell für Gehirntumor Kontext entwickelt). Starkes Sicherheitsprofil: Überwachung der Lebertoxizität (LFTs) erforderlich — Höhe der Stufe 3+ ALT ~10%. Verwechseln Sie nicht mit GBM (IDH-Wildtyp Grad 4), wo Vorasidenib keine Zulassung besitzt.
ESCAT IA. OlympiAD established olaparib: Escat IA. OlympiAD etablierte Olaparib für keimlinienförmige BRCA1/2-mutante HER2- metastasierte Brust (≤2 vorherige Chemolinien für metastastatische; HR+-Subset muss ≥1 vorherige endokrine Linie haben). Für TNBC-SubSet Olaprib beträgt typischerweise ≥2L (nach 1L Pembro + Chemo für PD-L1+ oder Chemo allein für Pd-L1-). Talazoparib (EMBRACA) ist die alternative PARPi – vergleichbare Wirksamkeit, mehr Anämie, weniger GI. Zugang zu den Daten: olaparib für die Indikation der Brust erstattet; talazoparib noch nicht erstattet.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. 1L remains gem: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. 1L remains gemcitabine + cisplatin ± durvalumab (TOPAZ-1). FGFR2-fusion testing recommended at diagnosis by NCCN to plan 2L. Detection: RNA-NGS preferred (intronic breakpoints commonly missed by DNA panels). Resistance: gatekeeper V564F, molecular brake L617M, kinase-domain N549K — futibatinib retains activity vs many of these. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-HEPATOBILIARY / SRC-FIGHT-202 / SRC-FOENIX-CCA2 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. CXCR4 WHIM-lik: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. CXCR4 WHIM-ähnliche Mutationstests empfohlen, da es BTKi-Ansprechraten moduliert. MYD88-WT WM (~10%) reagiert weniger gut auf BTKi.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Companion diag: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Companion diagnostic: cobas EGFR Mutation Test v2, FoundationOne CDx. Universal testing required for advanced non-squamous NSCLC.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Detection: RNA: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Detection: RNA-NGS preferred over DNA-NGS (intronic breakpoints). KIF5B-RET most common partner (~70%); fusion-partner generally does not influence TKI response (unlike ALK). Trial-source gaps: SRC-LIBRETTO001-DRILON-2020, SRC-LIBRETTO-431, SRC-ARROW not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Differentiatio: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Differenzierungssyndrom AE-Klasse-Effekt.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. E542K is a hel: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. E542K ist ein helical-domain (exon 9) Hotspot. Begleiter-Diagnose: therascreen PIK3CA + Guardant360 CDx + FoundationOne Liquid CDx. Hyperglykämie ist Klassen-Effekt AE für Alpelisib.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. E545K is a hel: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. E545K ist ein helical-domain (exon 9) Hotspot. Companion-Diagnose: therascreen PIK3CA + Guardant360 CDx + FoundationOne Liquid CDx. Hyperglykämie ist Klassen-Effekt AE für Alpelisib.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ELN 2022: high: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ELN 2022: High-Allelic-Ratio FLT3-ITD ohne NPM1 = Nebenrisiko; FLT3-ITD mit NPM1-(jedem AR) = Zwischenprodukt. Vergleichsdiagnostik: LeukoStrat CDx FLT-3-Mutationstest (RT-PCR-basiert).
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Fusion-partner: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Fusionspartnerspezifische Zelle für die Vollständigkeit beibehalten (entspricht BMA-ALK-EML4-V1-NSCLC-Muster).
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Fusionspartner-spezifische Zelle für die Vollständigkeit beibehalten.

ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Fusionspartnerspezifische Zelle für die Vollständigkeit beibehalten. ETV6-NTRK3 treibt auch infantiles Fibrosarkom, angeborenes mesoblastisches Nephroma und einen Bruchteil des sekretären Brustkarzinoms an – getrennte BMA-Zellen pro Krankheit.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. H1047L is a ki: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. H1047L ist ein Kinase-Domain (Exon 20) Hotspot. Begleitdiagnostik: therascreen PIK3CA + Guardant360 CDx + FoundationOne Liquid CDx. Hyperglykämie ist Klasseneffekt AE für Alpelisib.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. H1047R is a ki: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. H1047R ist ein Kinase-Domain (Exon 20) Hotspot. Companion-Diagnose: therascreen PIK3CA + Guardant360 CDx + FoundationOne Liquid CDx. Hyperglykämie ist Klassen-Effekt AE für Alpelisib.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. IFS is the pro: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. IFS is the prototype tumor for the paradigm shift from cytotoxic to targeted therapy in pediatric oncology. Prior standard (VAC chemotherapy) achieved ~70% response but with substantial toxicity. Larotrectinib enables less mutilating surgery in localized IFS. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-PEDIATRIC-SARCOMA / SRC-SCOUT not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. L858R+co-occur: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. L858R+ko-befallende TP53-Mutationen assoziiert mit kürzerem PFS – in Kombination 1L für Hochrisiko-Subsets berücksichtigen.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. MASC re-classi: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. MASC re-classified from acinic cell carcinoma in 2010 — driven entirely by ETV6-NTRK3 fusion. Detection: pan-TRK IHC screen → confirm by FISH or NGS. Resistance: solvent-front (NTRK G595R / G623R) and gatekeeper (G667C) mutations → next-gen TRK inhibitor selitrectinib / repotrectinib in trials. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-HEAD-AND-NECK / SRC-NAVIGATE-DRILON-2018 / SRC-STARTRK2-DRILON-2020 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Monitoring by: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Überwachung durch RT-qPCR auf internationaler Ebene; MMR (≤ 0,1% IS bei 12mo) definiert optimales Ansprechen pro ELN 2020/2025. Wahl des 1L TKI, angetrieben durch Komorbiditätsprofil (kardiovaskulär für Nilotinib; Pleuraerguss für Dasatinib usw.).
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. NTRK-fusion sc: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. NTRK-fusion screening in GIST should be reserved for KIT/PDGFRA-WT cases (after SDHB IHC to exclude SDH-deficient GIST). Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-SARCOMA / SRC-NCCN-GIST-2025 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Per task brief: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Per task brief: D835 R/R is well- characterized for gilteritinib (type-I) advantage over type-II.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. RAI ablation r: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. RAI-Ablation bleibt 1L für differenzierte PTC. NTRK-TKI ist für RAI refraktäre progressive Erkrankung. Erkennung: RNA-NGS bevorzugt. Quelle-Gap: SRC-NCCN-THYROID-2025 Platzhalter.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Reflex testing: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Reflex testing for BRAF V600E in metastatic non-squamous NSCLC mandatory. Class 2 (V600 non-E) and Class 3 (kinase-impaired) BRAF mutations are NOT covered by these approvals — see separate cells. ICI monotherapy generally less effective in BRAF V600E NSCLC than BRAF/MEKi at progression.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Reflextest für KRAS G12C in metastasiertem NSCLC. STK11/KEAP1-Komutationen können die Reaktion modulieren.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Resistance: F6: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Resistance: F691L gatekeeper, D835 TKD emerge under gilteritinib pressure — see BMA-FLT3-D835-AML-RR and BMA-FLT3-F691L-AML for next-step considerations. Distinguish from BMA-FLT3-ITD-AML which covers 1L.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. SRC-NCCN-THYRO: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. SRC-NCCN-THYROID-2025 is not yet ingested — using SRC-NCCN-CNS-2025 as a placeholder for NCCN-derived guidance pending thyroid guideline ingestion (matches DIS-MTC source-gap flagging). Trial-source gap: SRC-LIBRETTO-531-WIRTH-2024 not yet ingested. Calcitonin doubling time <12 mo and structural progression are systemic-therapy triggers.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap: SR: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-SARCOMA / SRC-NCCN-GIST-2025 / SRC-B2222-DEMETRI / SRC-EORTC-62005 / SRC-SSG-XVIII not yet ingested — using SRC-NCCN-MELANOMA-2025 placeholder per DIS-GIST source gap. SRC-IRIS-OBRIEN-2003 cited as the imatinib pivotal CML/GIST-era reference. Resistance: secondary KIT exon 13/14 (ATP-binding) or 17/18 (activation loop) mutations emerge during therapy.

ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-SARCOMA / SRC-NCCN-GIST-2025 / SRC-NAVIGATOR / SRC-VOYAGER not yet ingested. CNS toxicity (cognitive effects, intracranial hemorrhage) is on-target / dose- related — dose modifications standard. Companion-diagnostic genotyping via NGS panel mandatory before avapritinib initiation. Adjuvant imatinib has NO benefit in D842V GIST — these patients should be observed post-resection.

ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-SM-2025 / SRC-EXPLORER / SRC-PATHFINDER not yet ingested. AdvSM diagnosis requires WHO- defined C-findings (cytopenias, hepatomegaly + dysfunction, organ damage). Indolent SM is generally NOT treated with KIT-TKI; symptomatic treatment only.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. TLS prophylaxi: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. TLS prophylaxis mandatory at venetoclax ramp-up.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ctDNA testing: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ctDNA-Test bei Progression am 1./2. Gen TKI ist Standard; Geweberebiopsie, wenn Plasma negativ. Companion-Diagnose: cobas EGFR Mutation Test v2.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ~1-2% NSCLC ad: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ~1-2% NSCLC Adenokarzinom. RNA-NGS bevorzugt für Fusionsdetektion; FISH und IHC Alternativen.
ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ~5% NSCLC aden: ESCAT IA. OncoKB Level 1. ~5% NSCLC Adenokarzinom. Erkennung durch RNA-NGS / FISH / IHC (D5F3). EML4-ALK am häufigsten Partner; Variante Typ (v1 vs v3) beeinflusst Widerstandsmuster und TKI Auswahl.
ESCAT IA. Partner identification is info: ESCAT IA. Partneridentifikation ist informativ, aber nicht therapieverändernd.
ESCAT IA. Ponatinib preferred for highes: ESCAT IA. Ponatinib preferred for highest molecular-response rates and to preempt T315I emergence. CNS prophylaxis essential. Allo-HCT consideration based on MRD response per ELN/NCCN.
ESCAT IA. RNA-NGS preferred for fusion d: ESCAT IA. RNA-NGS bevorzugt für Fusionserkennung; einige DNA-Panels vermissen intronic Breakpoints.
ESCAT IA. SOLAR-1 established alpelisib: ESCAT IA. SOLAR-1 etablierte Alpelisib + Fulvestrant für PIK3CA-mutante HR+/HER2- nach KI ± CDK4/6i Progression. Hotspots in den Exons 9 (E542K, E545K, Helical) und 20 (H1047R, H1047L, Kinase) durch Gewebe NGS oder ctDNA nachgewiesen. Hyperglykämie-Management dominante Workflow-Bürde — Vorbehandlung HbA1c + Nüchternglukose; Metformin erste Linie bei Hyperglobuliem. UA Zugangsbarriere: Alpelisib registriert, aber NSZU nicht abdecken; außerhalb der Tasche. CAPItello-291 (capivasertib) überlappende Option für diese Gruppe plus AKT1/PTEN — siehe ALGO-BREAST-HR-POS-2L zur Auswahlgrundlage.
ESCAT IA. T-DXd preferred 2L per DESTINY: ESCAT IA. T-DXd preferred 2L per DESTINY-Breast03 (median PFS 28.8 vs 6.8 mo vs T-DM1, HR 0.33). ILD risk (~10.5% any grade) requires baseline CT chest + active monitoring; immediate hold + corticosteroids if pneumonitis suspect. UA-availability is major access barrier (registered, reimbursement under negotiation). Routed to via ALGO-BREAST-HER2-POS-2L unless brain metastases present (then HER2CLIMB tucatinib triplet preferred).
ESCAT IA. The combination of IDH mutatio: ESCAT IA. Die Kombination von IDH-Mutation + 1p/19q-Codeletion ist eine der stärksten molekularen Biomarker-to-Behandlungsbeziehungen in der Neuroonkologie: Sie prognostiziert sowohl Diagnose (Oligodendrogliom, definitiv) als auch Chemosensibilität (PCV-Antwort). ATRX-Mutitionsstatus (IHC) wird zum EXCLUDE Astrozytom verwendet, wenn die Codeletion gefunden wird – die beiden Marker schließen sich je WHO-CNS 2021 aus. Testworkflow: IDH zuerst (IHC ± Sequenzierung) → wenn IDH-mutant → 1p/19q FISH oder SNP Array → wenn codeleted = Oligodendrogliom → PCV+RT. Wenn nicht codeled und ATRX verloren = Astrozytom → unterschiedliche Behandlungswege. TERT Promotormutation co-occurs in ~95% der Oligoddrogliome und kann die Diagnose verstärken, wenn 1p19q FISCH ist equivokal.
ESCAT IA. Two concordant phase III RCTs: ESCAT IA. Two concordant phase III RCTs (SPOTLIGHT + GLOW) with survival benefit in CLDN18.2+ HER2-negative subgroup. Companion diagnostic (VENTANA RxDx) FDA-cleared — reflex CLDN18.2 IHC testing now NCCN Category 1 for all newly diagnosed metastatic gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma alongside HER2, MSI, PD-L1. N/V management (nausea/vomiting prominent AE profile for zolbetuximab — intensive antiemetic prophylaxis required including 5-HT3 + NK1 antagonist + dexamethasone on Day 1). EMA approval pending as of 2026-05-03.
ESCAT IA. Variant typing not strictly re: ESCAT IA. Variant-Typierung nicht unbedingt für 1L Entscheidung erforderlich, sondern informiert Prognose und Überwachung Intensität. RNA-NGS berichtet Variante.
ESCAT IA. v3 + co-occurring TP53 has wor: ESCAT IA. v3 + co-occurring TP53 hat schlechteste Prognose — stärkster Fall für Lorlatinib 1L. Variant-Identifikation erfordert RNA-NGS; nicht nachweisbar durch IHC allein.
ESCAT IB (no biomarker gating; broad app: ESCAT IB (no biomarker gating; broad applicability). Default 2L HR+/HER2- when no targetable mutation found (no PIK3CA / AKT1 / PTEN alteration → no capivasertib/alpelisib; no ESR1 mutation → no elacestrant) and HER2-low not actionable / T-DXd not available. Pivotal trial BOLERO-2 used everolimus + exemestane; PrECOG 0102 validated fulvestrant substitution (mechanistically equivalent; preferred when fulvestrant already in use). Stomatitis prophylaxis with dexamethasone mouthwash (SWISH) reduces G2+ stomatitis from ~33% to ~2% — mandatory pre-medication. Pneumonitis (~16% any grade) and immunosuppression-related infections require monitoring. UA access: everolimus registered (generics + brand Afinitor) but NSZU does not cover breast indication — out-of-pocket; generic substantially cheaper.
ESCAT IB (note: disease_id is DIS-RCC as: ESCAT IB (Anm.: disease_id ist DIS-RCC als engste Übereinstimmung; diese Indikation ist speziell Nierenangiomyolipom in TSC — ein gutartiges glattes Muskel-/Fetttumor, nicht RCC). TSC-Management erfordert multidisziplinären Ansatz (Neurologie, Nephrologie , Pulmonologie/LAM, Dermatologie, Ophthalmologie, Genetik). Nieren-AML-Überwachung: MRT oder Ultraschall q1–3 Jahre je nach Größe und Wachstum; Embolisierung für akute Blutung (Wunderlich-Syndrom) oder wenn Operation erforderlich vorbehalten. Everolimus vs. Embolisierung: Everolimos bevorzugt für den Anbau von AML < 3 cm oder multiplen AML; Embolisation für akute Blutungen oder sehr große (> 8 cm) AMLs. Sorafenib, Sunitinib und MTOR-Inhibitoren (Everolimus, Temsirolimus) sind für konventionelle Klarzellen-RCC zugelassen – andere Indikationen als TSC-assoziierte AML. Maligne Transformation der renalen AML ist extrem selten (<1%).
ESCAT IB (slightly lower than M918T beca: ESCAT IB (slightly lower than M918T because LIBRETTO-531 1L superiority data are most robust in M918T-enriched cohorts; C634 is treated identically by FDA label and clinical practice). OncoKB Level 1. Mandatory pheochromocytoma + hyperparathyroidism screening (MEN2A syndrome). Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-THYROID-2025 placeholder; SRC-LIBRETTO001-DRILON-2020 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IB (tumor-specific approval, rando: ESCAT IB (Tumor-spezifische Zulassung, randomisierte Evidenz gepoolt). Compound Mutationen (G719X+S768I, G719x+L861Q) reagieren oft gut auf Afatinib. Universal NGS für EGFR-Erkennung gelegentlicher Mutationen.
ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 1. ESR1 mutation: ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 1. ESR1 mutations are acquired (rarely present in primary tumor) and frequently polyclonal — ctDNA preferred over single-site biopsy. Other oral SERDs (camizestrant, giredestrant, imlunestrant) and combinations (elacestrant + abemaciclib, etc.) in late-stage development; not yet FDA-approved as of 2026-04 per SRC-NCCN-BREAST-2025. Source-gap: SRC-EMERALD-BIDARD-2022 not yet ingested.
ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 1. cobas EZH2 Mu: ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 1. cobas EZH2 Mutation Test is the companion diagnostic. EZH2-WT subset has FDA approval as well but with ~halved ORR — mutation testing improves selection per ESMO 2024. EZH2-Y641 in DLBCL: investigational; not approved (DLBCL trials in combination with R-CHOP have not yet read out positively per SRC-NCCN-BCELL-2025). Source-gap: SRC-E7438-202 (Morschhauser 2020) not yet ingested.
ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 2 (initially Lev: ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 2 (initially Level 2A in CRC pre-MOUNTAINEER; Level 1 tumor-agnostic for T-DXd 2024). HER2 testing recommended for metastatic CRC with RAS/BRAF-WT genotype per SRC-NCCN-COLON-2025. RAS mutation = exclusion criterion for anti-HER2 therapy. Bibliographic record SRC-DESTINY-CRC01-SIENA-2021 is available; SRC-MOUNTAINEER-STRICKLER-2023 and SRC-HERACLES remain source gaps. Claim-level linkage requires clinical sign-off.
ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 3A (predictive o: ESCAT IB / OncoKB Level 3A (predictive of resistance / response modifier rather than a direct drug target). Detection: NGS targeted panel (CXCR4 C-terminal exon 2). Patients with both MYD88-L265P and CXCR4-WHIM mutation have higher disease burden (IgM, BM infiltration) per SRC-NCCN-BCELL-2025. Source-gap: SRC-ASPEN, SRC-INNOVATE-WM not yet ingested.
ESCAT IB per ESMO mCRC living guideline. OncoKB Level 1. Companion diagnostic: any FDA-approved BRAF V600E test (cobas, FoundationOne CDx). Not approved as monotherapy in CRC — combination only. Source ID note: task brief referenced SRC-ESMO-CRC-2024 but the actual KB entity is SRC-ESMO-COLON-2024 (matches the file naming convention for ESMO sources).
ESCAT IB — extended RAS testing is the c: ESCAT IB — erweiterte RAS-Tests ist die kanonischen praktikable Verwendung von NRAS in mCRC.
ESCAT IB. OCEANS regimen — primary plati: ESCAT IB. OCEANS-Therapie — primär platinempfindliche 2L-Empfehlung in UA-Setting (vollständige NSZU-Abdeckung aller Komponenten).
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Combo with ant: ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Combo mit Anti-EGFR-Antikörper ist obligatorisch. Frontline noch FOLFOX/FOLFIRI ± bev.
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Critical TKI-s: ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Critical TKI-selection point: D835 confers resistance to type II FLT3i (quizartinib, sorafenib) but NOT to type I FLT3i (gilteritinib, midostaurin, crenolanib). Companion diagnostic: LeukoStrat CDx detects both ITD and TKD D835.
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. FDA companion: ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. FDA companion diagnostic: therascreen FGFR RGQ RT-PCR (covers FGFR2 fusions and FGFR3 mut/fusions). Detection: RNA-NGS preferred for fusions. Hyperphosphatemia is on-target toxicity requiring dose modification.
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. RAI ablation r: ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. RAI ablation remains 1L for differentiated PTC; selective RET-TKIs are deployed in RAI-refractory progressive metastatic disease. Detection: RNA-NGS preferred. Source-gap: SRC-NCCN-THYROID-2025 placeholder; SRC-LIBRETTO001-DRILON-2020 / SRC-ARROW not yet ingested.
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap as: ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Quelle-Gap als DIS-GIST.
ESCAT IB. OncoKB Level 1. Source-gap as DIS-GIST. Adjuvant imatinib applies in high-risk resected non-D842V PDGFRA GIST (3 yr).

ESCAT IB. p53-aberrant IHC pattern (not: ESCAT IB. p53-aberrant IHC pattern (not TP53 sequencing) is the clinical standard for molecular subtype assignment in the ESMO 2023 / ProMisE classification. This is distinct from BMA-TP53-MUT-ENDOMETRIAL (gene mutation level, ESCAT IIIB, no targeted therapy) — the IHC pattern's actionability is about treatment intensification (chemoRT over RT alone), not about a targeted agent. The 4-class molecular subtyping (POLE-ultramutated → best prognosis, MMR-deficient, NSMP, p53-abn → worst prognosis) is now required in all newly diagnosed endometrial carcinomas per ESMO 2023 and NCCN 2025. Testing priority: POLE sequencing first, then MMR IHC (MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2), then p53 IHC. Practical note: p53-abn IHC CANNOT be interpreted in the context of concurrent POLE mutation — POLE-ultramutated tumors are assigned regardless of p53 IHC (POLE overrides per ESMO hierarchy rule).
ESCAT IIA (FDA-approved disease-specific: ESCAT IIA (FDA-approved disease-specific). HER2 testing (IHC + reflex ISH for IHC 2+) recommended at diagnosis for unresectable / metastatic BTC per SRC-NCCN-HEPATOBILIARY. Gastric-style scoring (Hofmann 2008 — basolateral / lateral membranous staining ≥10%) is generally applied. HER2 amplification frequency varies by anatomic subsite: highest in gallbladder + extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (~10-15%), lower in intrahepatic CCA (~3-5%). FDA accelerated approval Nov 2024 based on HERIZON-BTC-01; confirmatory study and traditional approval pending. UA access: zanidatamab not registered in UA (named-patient / EAP only as of 2026-05). Trastuzumab + pertuzumab combination has separate weak evidence in BTC (MyPathway Meric-Bernstam 2021 ORR ~23%) but is not the FDA-approved disease-specific combination — zanidatamab is the disease-specific actionable option.
ESCAT IIA (accelerated approval based on: ESCAT IIA (accelerated approval based on ORR; confirmatory data pending). NRG1-fusion PDAC is enriched in KRAS-wild-type tumors (testing KRAS early identifies a subpopulation that warrants comprehensive RNA-seq). ORR of 40% in CRESTONE PDAC cohort is particularly impactful given the absence of other effective targeted therapies in 2L-3L PDAC. Testing strategy: if KRAS-wild-type PDAC identified, proceed to RNA-based comprehensive genomic profiling to detect NRG1 (and other rare fusions: NTRK, ALK, RET, FGFR). Zenocutuzumab is generally well tolerated: infusion reactions (premedication required), fatigue, nausea; no grade 3-4 cardiotoxicity seen in CRESTONE.
ESCAT IIA (accelerated approval, basket: ESCAT IIA (beschleunigte Zulassung, Korbtestdaten; bestätigende Phase III anhängig). RNA-Sequenzierung ist erforderlich — NRG1-Fusionen werden durch DNA-basierte NGS-Panels aufgrund großer intronischer Breakpoints nicht zuverlässig nachgewiesen. Zenocutuzumab-Mechanismus: Blockiert NRG1 Ligand an der Bindung HER3, verhindert HER2-HER3 Heterodimerisierung und nachgeschaltete onkogene Signalisierung – unterscheidet sich von Kinase-Inhibitoren und nicht anfällig für Gatekeeper-Mutationen. NRG1-Fusions-NSCLC-Tumors sind typischerweise ICI-resistent (niedriger TMB, niedriger PD-L1); verzögern Sie Zenocutuzumab nicht für ICI Rekhallenge. KRAS, EGFR, ALK-Tests sind noch erforderlich — NRG1 ist mit diesen Treibern selten zusammen.
ESCAT IIA (no FDA approval; clinical evi: ESCAT IIA (no FDA approval; clinical evidence from small series; MAP2K1 mutation strongly predicts MEK inhibitor response in HCL-V subset). Differentiate HCL-V from classic HCL: HCL-V lacks TRAP positivity, CD25, CD123, CD11c (or dim); BRAF V600E absent; often more aggressive behavior. Standard HCL treatments (cladribine monotherapy, vemurafenib for BRAF-mutant classic HCL) are largely ineffective in HCL-V. Clinical trial enrollment preferred for MAP2K1-mutant HCL-V (basket trials of MEK inhibitors in MAPK-altered hematologic malignancies). Consider ofatumumab, bendamustine, ibrutinib (off-label) as alternatives if MAP2K1 mutation absent.
ESCAT IIA (not IA) because the gastric-s: ESCAT IIA (not IA) because the gastric-specific MSI-H evidence is primarily from tumor-agnostic KEYNOTE-158 and a subgroup of KEYNOTE-859 rather than a dedicated MSI-H gastric trial with OS primary endpoint. ESCAT IIA (resistance biomarker — guides: ESCAT IIA (resistance biomarker — guides what NOT to use). OncoKB Level R1. ESCAT IIA — strong retrospective + singl: ESCAT IIA — starke retrospektive + einarmige Evidenz für ALK-TKI in R/R ALK+ ALCL. Der ALK Status nach IHC (ALK1-Antikörper) ist für die ALCL Diagnose pro WHO obligatorisch.

ESCAT IIA. OncoKB Level R1 (resistance t: ESCAT IIA. OncoKB Level R1 (resistance to imatinib/sunitinib). Source- gap as DIS-GIST plus SRC-INVICTUS / SRC-NAVIGATOR not yet ingested. ctDNA monitoring useful to detect emerging D816V before radiographic progression.

ESCAT IIA: JAK3 mutation enriches for JA: ESCAT IIA: JAK3 mutation enriches for JAK inhibitor sensitivity in CTCL; no FDA-approved JAK inhibitor for oral CTCL use as of 2026. Clinical decision: JAK3 testing in MF/SS informs trial eligibility for JAK inhibitor basket trials; does not currently change standard therapy sequence. Standard sequence for MF/SS: skin-directed therapy (topical steroids, phototherapy PUVA/UVB) → bexarotene → mogamulizumab or brentuximab vedotin (CD30+) → romidepsin → clinical trial (including JAK inhibitor trials for JAK-altered disease). Itacitinib (JAK1-selective) and cerdulatinib (JAK/SYK) have phase II CTCL data; watch for label updates. Note: mogamulizumab is CCR4-targeted (not JAK3-specific) and is FDA-approved for R/R MF/SS regardless of JAK3 status.
ESCAT IIA: JAK3 mutation predicts JAK in: ESCAT IIA: Die JAK3-Mutation prognostiziert die Empfindlichkeit des JAK-Inhibitors bei ATLL; keine Zulassung für ATLl für JAK Inhibitoren ab 2026. ATLI wird durch HTLV-1 (Human T-Zell-Leukemia Virus 1) verursacht und ist in Japan, der Karibik und Teilen Afrikas/Südamerikas endemisch. Molekulare Landschaft: JAK3 Mutationen (~35%), CCR4-Mutationen ( ~25%), RHOA G17V (~20%), PD-L1-Amplifikation. Mogamulizumab (CCR4-targeted) hat eine Aktivität im ATLG unabhängig vom JAK-3-Status und ist Standard in Japan. Allogenes HCT ist potenziell heilbar für fitte Patienten mit aggressivem ATLL in CR. Zugang zu Ruxolitinib: JAK3-Mutationstests sollten bei allen rezidivierten ATLl durchgeführt werden; wenn positiv, ist Ruxolithib Off-Label oder über die mitfühlende Anwendung/Basket-Studie eine vernünftige Option, wenn Standardtherapien scheitern.
ESCAT IIA: MAP2K1 is an actionable MAPK: ESCAT IIA: MAP2K1 ist eine reaktionsfähige MAPK-Wegänderung bei LGG; MEK-Inhibitoren (Trametinib) und RAF-Inhibitor (Tovorafenib) aktiv. BRAF Fusionstests (FISH/RNA-Seq) sollten zuerst in pLGG durchgeführt werden — BRAF-KIAA1549 Fusion ist der dominierende Treiber und wird am robustesten mit RAF Inhibitoren behandelt. MAP2-K1-Mutation kann identifiziert werden, wenn BRAF Verschmelzung und BRAF V600E fehlen. IDH1/2 Mutationsstatus ist für erwachsene LGG kritisch: IDH-mutant → Vorasidenib; IDH -Wildtyp + MAP2K1 → MEK-Inhibitoren in der Untersuchung. Umfassende molekulare Tests empfohlen: ID H1/2, BRAF (Fusion + V600E), MAP 2K1, CDKN2A/B, 1p/19q Codeletion (molekulares Oligodendrogliom), TERT Promotor.
ESCAT IIB. Encoded under BIO-RAS-MUTATIO: ESCAT IIB. Unter BIO-RAS-MUTATION kodiert (noch keine variantenspezifische BIO für KRAS G12D). FLAG: Die spezielle BIO-KRAS-G12D würde die Granularität verbessern.
ESCAT IIB. Unter BIO-RAS-MUTATION kodiert (noch keine variantenspezifische BIO für KRAS Q61X). FLAG: Die spezielle BIO-KRAS-Q61X würde die Granularität verbessern.
ESCAT IIB. OncoKB Level 3A. MYD88+CD79B: ESCAT IIB. OncoKB Level 3A. MYD88+CD79B co-mutation definiert MCD-Subtyp mit stärkstem BTKi-Rational. Nicht auf FDA DLBCL-Label.
ESCAT IIB. OncoKB Level 3A. Reflex KRAS: ESCAT IIB. OncoKB Level 3A. Reflex KRAS Sequenzierung im metastasierenden PDAC, da G12C und G12D nun praktikabel sind.
ESCAT IIB. PCNSL biology overlaps MCD-DL: ESCAT IIB. PCNSL Biologie überlappt MCD-DLBCL.
ESCAT IIB: BCL2 overexpression is a pred: ESCAT IIB: BCL2 overexpression is a predictive enrichment marker, not a mandatory companion diagnostic for venetoclax approval in AML. Eligibility is determined by age (≥75) or fitness for intensive chemotherapy. BCL2 IHC or flow cytometry adds predictive information in clinical decision-making, particularly in younger unfit patients where the response probability needs to be weighed. TLS (tumor lysis syndrome) prophylaxis mandatory: ramp-up dosing (20mg → 50mg → 100mg → 200mg → 400mg over 3 days), aggressive hydration, allopurinol/rasburicase. Differentiate from lymphoma indications where BCL2 rearrangement (not just expression) drives ESCAT tier — in AML, BCL2 expression (protein) is the relevant biomarker.
ESCAT IIB: CTNNB1 mutation is a validate: ESCAT IIB: CTNNB1 mutation is a validated prognostic biomarker in EC that modifies adjuvant treatment decisions for low-stage endometrioid disease. L1CAM IHC (>10% positive cells) is an acceptable surrogate if CTNNB1 molecular testing is unavailable — both identify the high-recurrence NSMP subgroup. Molecular classification workflow for all EC: (1) POLE mutation testing (ultramutated → best prognosis); (2) MMR IHC (dMMR → pembrolizumab); (3) p53 IHC (abnormal = serous-like → worst prognosis); (4) CTNNB1 exon 3 sequencing (NSMP high-risk reclassification). CTNNB1 mutation in the context of dMMR or p53-aberrant EC does not independently modify management — MMR and p53 status take precedence in those molecular classes.
ESCAT IIB: FOXL2 C134W is a diagnostic b: ESCAT IIB: FOXL2 C134W is a diagnostic biomarker with emerging predictive utility. Clinical use: (1) Diagnosis — FOXL2 testing should be part of workup for any suspected AGCT; (2) ctDNA monitoring — FOXL2 C134W in plasma ctDNA detects subclinical relapse (AGCT recurs at median 10–15 years post-diagnosis; serial ctDNA surveillance is under investigation); (3) Therapeutic target — clinical trials with CDK4/6 inhibitors actively enrolling (refer patients to NCT03462186 or institutional protocols). Inhibin B and AMH are serum markers used for AGCT monitoring (not FOXL2-specific but clinically useful). Staging surgery (BSO + peritoneal staging) is curative for early-stage disease (stage I; 90% 10-yr OS). Fertility-sparing surgery (unilateral SO) may be considered for young patients with stage IA disease.
ESCAT IIB: GNAS mutation is a diagnostic: ESCAT IIB: GNAS-Mutation ist ein diagnostisches/Risiko-Stratifizierungstool im IPMN-Management, kein therapeutisches Ziel. Die disease_id DIS-PDAC wird als engstes Match verwendet, da IPMn ein prämaligner Vorläufer von PDAC ist; es gibt keine dedizierte IPMNS-Krankheitseinheit in der KB. Klinischer Workflow für Pankreaszysten: (1) Imaging Charakterisierung: MRI/MRCP (vorzugsweise), CT für Wandbild-Nodule-Detektion. (2) EUS-FNA mit Zystenflüssigkeitsanalyse für Zysten ≥2 cm oder mit relevanten Merkmalen. (3) Zystflüssigkeit CEA (> 192 ng/mL = Mucinous), Amylase (niedrig in serous), Zytologie (atypisch/ maligne Zellen = sofortige Chirurgie), GNAS/KRAS NGS-Panel. (4) GNAs+ (oder KRAS+) bestätigt Mucinus → geben IAP/NCCN-Überwachungsprotokoll ein. (5) Zusätzliche molekulare Marker (TP53, SMAD4, CDKN2A-Mutationen in Zystenflüssigkeit) können auf eine hochgradige Dysplasie hinweisen, die auch ohne bildgebende Hochrisiko-Stigmata resektionsbedürftig ist. GNAS R201 Testing: erfordert dedizierte Pankreaszystenflüssigkeit NGS-Panel (z.B. Pancrasite von LabCorp, oder institutionelle Panel); nicht durch Standard Tumorgewebe NGS Panels abgedeckt.
ESCAT IIB: HNF1A mutation is a diagnosti: ESCAT IIB: HNF1A-Mutation ist ein diagnostischer/Risiko-Schichtungsmarker, der hauptsächlich für die hepatozelluläre Adenom-Subtypisierung mit sekundärer Relevanz für die HCC-Phänotypisierung eingesetzt wird. Praktische Hinweise: (1) Für HCA: LFABP IHC (Färbungsverlust) ist die validierte Surrogat für HNF1-A-Inaktivierung – verfügbar in den meisten Pathologielabors; NGS-Bestätigung fügt Spezifität hinzu, ist aber nicht obligatorisch, wenn IHC negativ ist. (2) Für HCC auf NGS: HNF1A ist eine somatische Mutation zufälliger Befund; ändert NCCN/AASLD-Behandlungsalgorithmus nicht; korreliert möglicherweise mit besser differenzierter Tumorbiologie. (3) Germline HNF 1A (MODY3): Sulfonylharnstoffbehandlung ist hochwirksam; empfiehlt eine endokrinologische Empfehlung, wenn die Keimlinie HNF-1A zufällig bei einem HCC-Patienten gefunden wurde. (4) HNF1-A ist NICHT in routinemäßig umfassenden NGS-Panels für HCC Biomarker-Zuschussfähigkeit (die sich auf VEGF-Weg, PD-L1, TMB, MSI für Immuntherapiefähigkeit konzentriert). DIS-HCC wird als security_id sowohl für HCC (~10%) als auch für HCA-Kontexten verwendet; HCA hat keine dedizierte Krankheitseinheit in der KB.
ESCAT IIB: NF2 loss is a key molecular c: ESCAT IIB: NF2 loss is a key molecular characterization marker for meningioma but does not yet select systemic therapy (unlike AKT1 E17K which has phase II trial data for targeted approach). Clinical priority: (1) molecular profiling of grade II-III meningioma (NF2, TRAF7, AKT1, SMO, KLF4, CDKN2A/B, TERT) to identify targetable alterations beyond NF2; (2) refer progressive/recurrent grade II-III meningioma to clinical trial (AKT inhibitor trials, CDK4/6 inhibitor trials, trabectedin trials); (3) NF2 germline testing if clinical NF2 syndrome suspected (bilateral VS, multiple meningiomas, age <25). Watch for updates: NF2-YAP pathway and FAK inhibitors (defactinib) in NF2-deficient mesothelioma and meningioma trials.
ESCAT IIB: PIK3R1 mutation in EC activat: ESCAT IIB: PIK3R1 mutation in EC activates the same PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway as PIK3CA and PTEN loss, but currently lacks a PIK3R1-specific companion diagnostic and approved targeted therapy. Management: (1) First, characterize EC molecular class (POLE, MMR, p53, CTNNB1) to guide first-line adjuvant decisions; (2) PIK3R1 testing is relevant for trial eligibility (PI3K pathway basket trials), not for current standard therapy selection; (3) For recurrent/advanced pMMR EC, lenvatinib + pembrolizumab is standard regardless of PIK3R1 status (KEYNOTE-775); (4) Alpelisib access: compassionate use or clinical trial for PIK3R1-mutant EC; (5) PTEN IHC (surrogate for PTEN loss, co-occurring with PIK3R1 in many EC) provides complementary PI3K pathway information.
ESCAT IIB: TERT mutation in glioma is a: ESCAT IIB: TERT mutation in glioma is a diagnostic classifier and prognostic marker, not a therapeutic target. TERT testing is part of the mandatory integrated molecular workup for all diffuse gliomas per WHO CNS 5th edition (2021): IDH1/2, ATRX, 1p/19q, CDKN2A/B, TERT promoter, MGMT promoter (treatment-predictive). Note: TERT promoter is NOT covered by most routine exome sequencing panels — dedicated panel or separate Sanger/ddPCR assay needed. Oligodendroglioma precision: triple positive (IDH+/1p19q-codel+/TERT+) is the most reliable molecular classifier; TERT-negative IDH+/1p19q-codel tumors are diagnostically ambiguous. Treatment for TERT-positive GBM is identical to TERT-negative GBM: RT + temozolomide ± bevacizumab; no clinical benefit from TERT-specific approaches has been demonstrated.
ESCAT IIB: TERT promoter mutation is a v: ESCAT IIB: TERT promoter mutation is a validated adverse prognostic marker in differentiated thyroid cancer; it modulates treatment intensity (more aggressive RAI, enhanced surveillance) rather than selecting a targeted drug. TERT testing is NOT universally standard of care yet but is increasingly incorporated in high-risk PTC workup. Practical implementation: TERT testing should be performed in PTC with any of these features: T3/T4, N1b, M1, large tumor, extrathyroidal extension, multifocal disease, or aggressive histology (tall cell, columnar cell, diffuse sclerosing variants). If TERT+ and BRAF+: classify as highest risk; consider intensified RAI and kinase inhibitor planning if RAI-refractory. If TERT-/BRAF+: intermediate risk per ATA. Note: TERT promoter sequencing requires specific panel design — many standard targeted NGS panels do NOT cover the TERT promoter; verify panel before ordering.
ESCAT IIIA (target validated in another: ESCAT IIIA (Ziel validiert in einem anderen Tumor, kein klinischer Nachweis in HCC). OncoKB Level 4 (mit biologischen Nachweisen). Standard 1L HCC bleibt Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab unabhängig vom MET-Status.
ESCAT IIIA — clinical benefit in other t: ESCAT IIIA – klinischer Nutzen bei anderen Tumortypen (Fallberichte + Kleinserien in MM). OncoKB Level 3B. Nicht in NCCN MM Standardalgorithmen; nur nach Standard-Neuerreger-Regimen erschöpft, idealerweise in der klinischen Studie / MyDRUG Korb.
ESCAT IIIA — explanatory / subtype-routi: ESCAT IIIA — explanatory / subtype-routing biomarker; not treatment-selecting on its own. Primary citations now include the TCGA gastric classification paper (Bass et al., Nature 2014) and Kim et al. Nature Medicine 2018 (pembrolizumab response in EBV+ metastatic gastric). NCCN gastric v2025 and ESMO gastric 2024 retained as guideline corroboration. KEYNOTE-061 EBV+ subset analysis (Janjigian) is still pending source-ingestion; the parent trial KN-061 is now cited as Shitara 2018 Lancet (PMID 29880231) for context, but no EBV-specific subset claim is asserted on the basis of that citation. Co-positivity with MSI-H, PD-L1 CPS+, HER2+ is mostly mutually exclusive (EBV+ rarely overlaps with MSI-H — both confer immunogenicity through different mechanisms); HER2+ and EBV+ cooccur in <2% of cases. NOT a 1L-routing biomarker in current OpenOnco algorithm; documented for clinician context and for future ICI-prioritization rule when phase 3 EBV-stratified data emerges. Engine routing intentionally does not fire on this BMA alone; it is consumed by the render layer for explanatory display.

ESCAT IIIA: somatic PTPN11 in JMML is a: ESCAT IIIA: somatic PTPN11 in JMML is a validated prognostic biomarker and molecular target of investigational SHP2 inhibitors. HCT is the only proven curative option. CRITICAL CLINICAL DISTINCTION: Noonan syndrome-associated myeloproliferation (germline PTPN11) is typically self-limiting and does NOT require HCT — over-treatment with HCT in Noonan patients carries significant morbidity without benefit. Always confirm somatic vs germline origin of PTPN11 mutation before committing to HCT. Methods: compare tumor (bone marrow) vs germline (buccal swab/saliva) allele frequency; variant frequency >25–30% in bone marrow with homozygous loss suggests somatic with uniparental disomy. Post-HCT relapse: high (25–30%); salvage with second HCT or investigational agent. MRD monitoring by quantitative PCR for PTPN11 mutation pre/post HCT has predictive value for relapse risk.

ESCAT IIIB: APC mutation marks the adeno: ESCAT IIIB: APC mutation marks the adenoma-carcinoma sequence but is not currently actionable for therapy selection. Key clinical implications: (1) Germline testing: any patient <50y with CRC or with ≥10 adenomas should have germline APC testing to exclude FAP/AFAP; prophylactic colectomy is curative. (2) WNT pathway state: nuclear β-catenin IHC is a surrogate; useful when full sequencing unavailable but does not add actionability above sequencing. (3) Trial eligibility: WNT pathway basket trials (porcupine inhibitors RXC004, LGK-974) use APC mutation or CTNNB1 mutation as eligibility criteria. (4) Resistance context: APC loss in CRC that acquires KRAS or BRAF mutations represents late clonal evolution; serial ctDNA may track this.
ESCAT IIIB: DDR2 mutation in squamous NS: Escat IIIB: DDR2-Mutation im Plattenepithel NSCLC ist ein Untersuchungsziel ohne zugelassene Therapie. Klinisch wichtige Unterschiede: (1) DDR2 ist nicht in Standard NCCN-erforderlichen Biomarker-Tests (EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, KRAS, MET, RET, NTRK, PD-L1, TMB); NGS-Panels können es übrigens erkennen. (2) SRC-Inhibitoren (Dasatinib) haben dosislimitierende Toxizität (Flüssigkeitsretention, Pleuraerguss) bei Dosen, die für DDR2-Hemmung in soliden Tumoren benötigt werden. (3) Bei DDR2-mutanten Patienten, die bei der Standardtherapie vorangekommen sind, ist die Aufnahme in eine DDR2-Ziel-Korbstudie der empfohlene Ansatz. (4) DDR2-Mutation bei CRC oder Brustkrebs hat keine klinische Bedeutung.
ESCAT IIIB: ERBB4 mutation in NSCLC is a: Escat IIIB: ERBB4-Mutation in NSCLC ist ein Untersuchungsziel. Kritische Unterscheidung: (1) ERBB4 somatische Mutation (Kinase/extrazelluläre Domäne): selten, keine zugelassene Therapie. (2) NRG1-Genfusion (NRG1 ist der ERBB-4 Ligand): wirkungsfähig — Zenocutuzumab FDA Durchbruchsbezeichnung, ORR ~33% in NRG-1-Fusions-NSCLC/pankreas (eNRGy-Studie). NRG1 Fusionen erfordern RNA-Seq zum Nachweis (nicht auf DNA-nur-Panels erfasst). Diese sind klinisch unterschiedlich. (3) Afatinib ist Pan-HER (HER1/2/4), aber seine Zulassungen sind HER1-mutant NSCLC und HER2-exon 20 Einfügung NSClc; mit Afatinaib für ERBB4-Mutation ist Off-Label mit begrenzten Nachweisen. (4) Es gibt keine Begleitdiagnostik für ERBB4-Mutivierung; Standard NSCLA Biomarker Panel ist ausreichend.
ESCAT IIIB: KDR mutation in NSCLC is an: ESCAT IIIB: KDR mutation in NSCLC is an investigational marker. Practical notes: (1) KDR mutation is detectable on comprehensive NGS panels; not in NCCN's required biomarker panel (EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, KRAS, MET, RET, NTRK, PD-L1, TMB for NSCLC). (2) Anti-angiogenic treatment decisions use VEGF/VEGFR2 protein expression (PD-L1 analogue reasoning) or histology (bevacizumab contraindicated in squamous), not KDR mutation. (3) For KDR-mutant NSCLC patients who have progressed on standard therapy, basket trial enrollment with a VEGFR2/multi-TKI arm is appropriate. (4) KDR mutation in other tumor types (e.g., angiosarcoma, renal cell carcinoma) may have different clinical significance — those contexts are outside this BMA scope.
ESCAT IIIB: RB1 loss in SCLC is a diagno: ESCAT IIIB: RB1-Verlust im SCLC ist ein diagnostisches Merkmal und Resistenzmarker (CDK4/6i), wählt aber keine aktive gezielte Therapie. Rb-Proteinverlust durch IHC wird klinisch verwendet, um SCLC von anderen hochwertigen neuroendokrinen Neoplasmen zu unterscheiden: Rb -negative (SCLC) vs Rb retained (Karzinoidtumore, LCNEC kann variabel sein). SCLC-Molekül-Subtypen (ASCL1-high, NEUROD1-hift, POU2F3-high und YAP1-hi High) treten als Prädiktoren von DLL3 (Rovalpituzumab tesirine/tarlatamab) und LSD1-Inhibitor-Ansprechen auf, sind aber separate Biomarker von RB1. Tarlatamib (DLL3-targeted BiTE; FDA 2024 für 2L+ SCLC) wählt nicht basierend auf RB1-Status.
ESCAT IIIB: RB1 loss in urothelial cance: ESCAT IIIB: RB1-Verlust bei Urothelkrebs markiert den basalen/squamous Subtyp (zusammen mit CD44+, CK5/6+,CK14+) mit unterschiedlicher Biologie von luminalen Subtypen. Wesentliche klinische Implikation: Im Zusammenhang mit der molekularen Subtypisierung von Blasenkrebs scheinen RB1-niedrige/basale Tumoren günstigere Reaktionen auf neoadjuvante Cisplatin-basierte Chemotherapie (paradox besser trotz schlechterer Diagnoseprognosen bei Diagnose) zu haben. Dies hat nicht zu einer spezifischen, zugelassenen biomarker-getriebenen Therapie geführt. Achtung: Die EV-302/KEYNOTE-A39-Studie (Enfortumab Vedotin + Pembrolizumab, unabhängig vom molekularen Subtyp) hat bei 1L metastasierendem Urothelkarzinom weitgehend subtypbasierte Therapieentscheidungen ersetzt.

ESCAT IV: FBXW7 mutation in CRC has no c: ESCAT IV: FBXW7-Mutation im CRC hat keine aktuelle therapeutische Implikation über die Standard MSI/MMR/RAS/BRAF-Tests hinaus. Wesentliche Punkte: (1) FBxW7-mutation ist keine Begleitdiagnostik für zugelassene Wirkstoffe. (2) Es ist ein Resistenz-Prognostiker für CDK4/6-Inhibitoren (über CCNE1), relevant nur, wenn CRC in CDK4/6-Inhibitor-Studien eintritt. (3) Wenn bei NGS eine Mutation von FBXW7 gefunden wird, ist der klinisch praktikable Schritt, den MSI/MMR-Status (falls nicht bereits geschehen) zu bestätigen — FB XW7-Anreicherung in MSI-H bedeutet, dass der MSI H-Status der praktikabel Befund ist. (4) Nirogacestat (Gamma-Sekretase-Inhibitor, FDA-genehmigt für desmoid Tumor) zielt auf die Notch-Verarbeitung ab — mechanistisch relevant für die NOTC-Substratestabilisierung in FBxW7-mutanten Tumoren, aber desmoidespezifische Zulassung; keine CRC-Daten.
ESCAT IV: no approved targeted therapy f: ESCAT IV: no approved targeted therapy for KRAS G12V in NSCLC (as of 2026). The absence of a cysteine residue in the G12V substitution prevents covalent binding by G12C-selective inhibitors (sotorasib, adagrasib). Clinical priority: (1) confirm KRAS G12V by validated NGS; (2) co-test PD-L1, STK11, KEAP1, TMB; (3) treat per PD-L1 algorithm; (4) refer to KRAS G12V-specific trials. HLA-A*11:01 typing may be relevant if adoptive T-cell therapy trials are available locally. KRAS G12V occurs at higher frequency in never-smokers compared with G12C (smoker-associated). Do not confuse with KRAS G12C — the mutation subtype must be confirmed before counseling patients about targeted therapy options; patients may have heard of sotorasib/adagrasib from community oncologists.
ESCAT X — biological rationale present b: Escat X — biologische Begründung vorhanden, aber keine praktikable klinische Evidenz. t(4;14) Status definiert hochriskantes MM und beeinflusst die Wahl des proteasom-Inhibitoren-basierten Therapieschemas (KRd, IsaKRd und Daratumumab-Combos), aber FGFR3 selbst ist kein Behandlungsziel in MM.

ESMO clinical practice guideline on canc: ESMO clinical practice guideline on cancer in pregnancy (Peccatori 2013, updated). First-trimester teratogenicity: no chemotherapy except emergency hematologic salvage; counsel on therapeutic abortion vs delayed therapy. Second/third trimester safety profile (Loibl, Amant): doxorubicin + cyclophosphamide AC for breast — safe; weekly paclitaxel — safe; trastuzumab — contraindicated (oligohydramnios); ICI — limited data, defer to postpartum; rituximab — neonatal B-cell depletion but reversible, often acceptable; ABVD for Hodgkin — safe in T2/T3; BEACOPP — avoid; R-CHOP for DLBCL — feasible T2/T3 with MFM. Delivery 2-3 weeks after last cycle to allow nadir recovery. Direction `hold` for any first-trimester systemic; modulated to `de-escalate` later — engine should consume gestational age.

ET 2L cytoreduction for HU-intolerant or: ET 2L cytoreduction for HU-intolerant or HU-resistant patients per PT-1 (Harrison 2005). PT-1 noted MORE arterial thrombosis + serious bleeding + MF progression on anagrelide vs HU — therefore anagrelide is NOT preferred 1L; reserved for HU failure. Pegylated interferon-α (e.g. ropeginterferon) is an alternative 2L (especially for younger patients with disease-modification goal). Cardiac baseline assessment recommended (ECG ± echo) before initiation if any cardiac comorbidity. STUB — requires Clinical Co-Lead signoff.
ET 2L per PT-1 trial (Harrison et al., N: ET 2L per PT-1 trial (Harrison et al., NEJM 2005): non-inferior to HU on thrombosis but more arterial thrombosis + bleeding + myelofibrosis progression in some endpoints. Reserved for HU-intolerance/resistance or for younger ET patients wanting to avoid HU's theoretical leukemogenic concern. Cardiac evaluation (ECG ± echo) recommended before starting if comorbidity present.

Early loco-regional recurrence (<6 mo) a: Early loco-regional recurrence (<6 mo) after CRT carries dismal prognosis (mOS ~6–9 mo) and excludes most curative re-irradiation trials (RTOG 0421 / 1009 require ≥6 mo). Salvage surgery feasibility is the key axis — multidisciplinary review mandatory. Carotid encasement on imaging is a surgical contraindication and predicts fatal blowout if re-irradiated; embolization / palliation only. Airway compromise: tracheostomy before any chemo / RT escalation. Transition to KEYNOTE-048-style palliative systemic therapy (pembrolizumab ± chemo by CPS) when re-treatment infeasible.
Early-stage (non-metastatic) breast canc: Early-stage (non-metastatic) breast cancer: clinical or pathological stage I, II, or III. Defined by absence of distant metastasis (M0 per TNM 8th edition). Early-stage breast cancer is potentially curable with locoregional and systemic therapy; the treatment intent is curative, not palliative. Early stage is the gating criterion for neoadjuvant (pre-operative) or adjuvant (post-operative) systemic therapy rather than palliative 1L metastatic regimens. Neoadjuvant therapy (TCHP for HER2+; pembro+chemo for TNBC KEYNOTE-522; endocrine ± CDK4/6i for HR+) is preferred for stage II-III tumors. Stage I HR+ tumors may receive adjuvant endocrine therapy without neoadjuvant chemotherapy. Fires to route ALGO-BREAST-1L step 2 (HER2+ branch) to neoadjuvant therapy (IND-BREAST-HER2-POS-EARLY-NEOADJUVANT) rather than metastatic 1L (IND-BREAST-HER2-POS-MET-1L-THP).

Endogenous catecholamine that stimulates: Endogenous catecholamine that stimulates all adrenergic receptor subtypes: α1 (vasoconstriction → reverses anaphylactic vasodilation and hypotension, reduces mucosal edema), β1 (positive inotropy and chronotropy → reverses cardiogenic component of anaphylactic shock and supports tissue perfusion), and β2 (bronchodilation → reverses anaphylactic bronchospasm; mast cell membrane stabilization → decreases further mediator release; vasodilation in skeletal muscle). The combined α + β1 + β2 actions make epinephrine uniquely first-line for anaphylaxis — no other single agent reverses all three life-threatening components (hypotension, bronchospasm, upper airway edema). Also used for cardiac arrest (asystole, PEA, refractory VF/VT) and infusion-reaction-related hypotension. Approved as a generic medicine since the early 20th century; modern auto-injectors approved 1980s.

Pathogenic exonuclease-domain (EDM) variants drive hypermutator phenotype with TMB typically >100 mut/Mb. Epithelioid sarcoma is defined by SMARCB: Epithelioid sarcoma is defined by SMARCB1/INI1 loss and has historically poor prognosis in the proximal/aggressive variant. Tazemetostat (EZH2 inhibitor) is FDA-approved (2020) for metastatic or locally advanced epithelioid sarcoma not eligible for complete resection — the first and only FDA-approved targeted therapy. INI1 loss (detected by IHC) is the companion diagnostic. ORR ~15% in EZH-202 but durable responses seen. Note: tazemetostat is also approved for EZH2-mutant follicular lymphoma (different indication/biomarker). Distal-type has better prognosis than proximal-type; lymph node metastases are common (30%).

Erdafitinib is the first FGFR-targeted t: Erdafitinib is the first FGFR-targeted therapy in genitourinary oncology and remains the only oral targeted agent for FGFR2/3-altered metastatic urothelial carcinoma. NCCN-Bladder 2025 lists erdafitinib category 1 in 2L+ FGFR-altered after platinum + PD-1/L1; therascreen FGFR RGQ RT-PCR is the FDA-cleared companion diagnostic, but NGS panels (FoundationOne, MSK-IMPACT, Caris) detecting the same alleles + fusions are clinically interchangeable. Phosphate management requires close coordination — target serum phosphate 5.5-7.0 mg/dL for efficacy without crossing the soft-tissue mineralization threshold. Monthly OCT for first 4 months is mandatory due to CSR risk. THOR Cohort 2 (erdafitinib vs pembrolizumab in IO-naive 2L) was negative — sequencing is platinum → IO → erdafitinib, not IO-substitution. Bibliographic records SRC-BLC2001-LORIOT-2019 and SRC-THOR-LORIOT-2023 are available; SRC-FDA-BALVERSA remains missing.

Everolimus (MTOR-Inhibitor) ist FDA-genehmigt (2012) für Nierenangiomyolipom (AML) in Verbindung mit TSC. EXIST-2 Phase III (Bissler et al., Lancet 2013): N=118 (Everolimus 10 mg vs. Placebo); primärer Endpunkt: AML-Ansprechrate (≥50% Reduktion der Summe der längsten Durchmesser der Ziel-AMLs). AML Ansprechen: 42% (Ewerolimus) vs 0% (Placebo) (p<0.0001); mDOR: nicht erreicht. Krankheitsstabilisierung: 96% vs 55%. Everolimos reduziert auch AML Wachstumsrate und Risiko für spontane Blutungen (Wunderlich-Syndrom). Bei TSC-Patienten mit AML ≥ 3 cm wird prophylaktischer Everolimus einer prophylaxischen Embolisierung nach aktuellen Richtlinien vorgezogen. Hinweis: TSC1-Kremilinie ist der Biomarker für die Eignung (Tuberous Sklerose Complex Diagnose erforderlich); sporadische renale AML ohne TSC Merkmale sind eine andere Einheit. ESCAT IB: Phase-III-RCT-Daten, aber für das renale Angiomyolipom (gutartige Krankheitszusammenhang, nicht maligne RCC — also IB nicht IA trotz starker Beweise).

FBXW7 (F-Box and WD Repeat Domain Contai: FBXW7 (F-Box and WD Repeat Domain Containing 7) is the substrate-recognition subunit of the SCF (SKP1-CUL1-F-box) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex. FBXW7 recognizes phosphodegrons on multiple oncoproteins and mediates their ubiquitin-proteasomal degradation. Key substrates: NOTCH1/2, MYC, CCNE1, mTOR, JUN, MCL-1. Loss of FBXW7 → stabilization of these oncoproteins → resistance to multiple targeted therapies. Frequency: ~10–15% CRC (one of highest across cancers), ~15% T-ALL, ~6% gastric, ~5% pancreatic. Clinical significance: FBXW7 mutation is a resistance mechanism (to anti-NOTCH, CDK4/6i via CCNE1 upregulation, mTOR inhibitors via mTOR stabilization) rather than an independent therapeutic target. In CRC, FBXW7 mutation does not select any approved systemic therapy; it may co-occur with MSI-H (favoring immunotherapy) but is not independently actionable. ESCAT IV.

FLT3 gatekeeper mutation analogous to BC: FLT3 gatekeeper mutation analogous to BCR::ABL1 T315I, EGFR T790M, and ALK L1196M. Almost always emerges on top of pre-existing FLT3-ITD (rarely de novo). Most clinically relevant as acquired resistance to gilteritinib in relapsed/refractory FLT3-mut AML — the dominant on-target mechanism per ADMIRAL (Perl 2019, NEJM) post-progression series and several real-world cohorts. F691L also reduces quizartinib activity (originally a type-II FLT3 inhibitor with even narrower resistance profile) and midostaurin. No commercially available FLT3 inhibitor reliably overcomes F691L; clinical trials of next-generation FLT3 inhibitors (FF-10101, MAX-40279) and combination strategies (FLT3i + venetoclax, FLT3i + hypomethylator) are the current investigational options. Detection at gilteritinib relapse → route to alloSCT (if not already done), trial enrollment, or venetoclax-based salvage.

FOXL2 (Forkhead Box L2) is a transcripti: FOXL2 (Forkhead Box L2) is a transcription factor essential for granulosa cell differentiation and maintenance of ovarian identity. The p.C134W (c.402C>G) hotspot mutation is present in ~97% of adult granulosa cell tumors (AGCTs) and is the only known pathognomonic point mutation in any solid tumor (100% specificity if hotspot confirmed). The mutation is a dominant-negative gain-of-function: C134W FOXL2 protein mislocalizes and aberrantly activates target genes (including CYP19A1/aromatase), driving estrogen excess. Clinically, the mutation is used: (1) Diagnostic: confirms AGCT vs other sex cord-stromal tumors (Sertoli-Leydig, fibroma). (2) Prognostic/monitoring: ctDNA detection of FOXL2 c.402C>G for early relapse detection (AGCTs recur late — 10–20 years post-diagnosis; ctDNA surveillance under investigation). (3) Therapeutic target: FOXL2 inhibition and CDK4/6 inhibitors (olaparib, palbociclib, ribociclib) are in clinical trials. Luteinizing hormone-RH agonists (leuprolide) and progestins are used for recurrent disease but no FDA approval in this specific context. Familial Pancreatic Cancer (FPC) — operational definition: an individual with ≥2 first-degree relatives diagnosed with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), in the absence of a confirmed germline pathogenic variant in a known PDAC-susceptibility gene (BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, CDKN2A, STK11/Peutz-Jeghers, MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2/Lynch, TP53/Li-Fraumeni, PRSS1/SPINK1 hereditary pancreatitis). Negative expanded hereditary-cancer panel + ≥2-FDR PDAC family history satisfies the criterion. Lifetime PDAC risk for FPC kindreds is estimated at ~7-16% (vs. ~1.6% population baseline); risk scales with number of affected FDRs (2 FDR ~7%, 3+ FDR ~16-32%). CAPS Consortium 2020 + NCCN Pancreatic 2025 endorse pancreatic surveillance with annual MRI/MRCP and/or EUS in FPC kindreds starting age 50 (or 10y before youngest familial diagnosis). Pivotal innovaTV 204 (Coleman Lancet Oncol 2021, n=101): ORR 24%, mDOR 8.3 mo, mPFS 4.2 mo, mOS 12.1 mo → FDA accelerated approval Sep 20, 2021. Confirmatory innovaTV 301 (Vergote NEJM 2024, n=502, tisotumab vedotin vs investigator-choice chemo): mOS 11.5 vs 9.5 mo (HR 0.70, p=0.0038), mPFS 4.2 vs 2.9 mo (HR 0.67), ORR 17.8% vs 5.2% → FDA full approval Apr 29, 2024. Mandatory baseline ophthalmologic exam + per-cycle exams for first 9 cycles. No companion biomarker required (TF broadly expressed on cervical carcinoma). Bibliographic record SRC-INNOVATV-204 (Coleman 2021) is available; SRC-INNOVATV-301 and SRC-FDA-TIVDAK remain source gaps. Clinical claim linkage requires review.

First-in-class KIT/PDGFRA switch-control: First-in-class KIT/PDGFRA switch-control inhibitor that uses a dual-mechanism: it locks the kinase activation loop in the inactive conformation by binding both the switch pocket (αC-out) and the activation loop, broadly inhibiting primary exon 9/11/17 KIT mutations AND secondary resistance mutations across exons 13/14/17/18 — the vulnerability gap left by sequential prior TKIs (imatinib → sunitinib → regorafenib). Pivotal INVICTUS Phase III (4L+ advanced GIST, ripretinib 150 mg QD vs placebo) showed mPFS 6.3 vs 1.0 months (HR 0.15, p<0.0001) and mOS 15.1 vs 6.6 months (HR 0.36); FDA approval May 2020.

Drogenferienstrategie (intermittierende Dosierung) kann AE-Bürde reduzieren, während eine gewisse Kontrolle. Cemiplimab ist die zugelassene Option nach HHI-Fehler.

GLOW (Shah Nat Med 2023): zolbetuximab + CAPOX vs CAPOX — mPFS 8.2 vs 6.8 mo (HR 0.69); mOS 14.4 vs 12.2 mo (HR 0.77). FDA approval Oct 2024. Cycle-1 nausea is the dominant tolerability problem — mitigated by slow infusion + triple-antiemetic prophylaxis (5-HT3 + NK1-RA + dex) + dose interruption / reduction protocol; tolerance generally improves cycles 2+. Bibliographic record SRC-SPOTLIGHT-SHITARA-2023 and SRC-GLOW are available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off.

In BCC aktivieren SMO Mutationen oder PTCH1-Funktionsverlust konstitutiv das HH → Tumorwachstum. ERIVANCE-Pivotalstudie: ORR 43% (mBCC) / 30% (laBCC), mit dauerhaften Ansprechen. FDA-genehmigt 2012.
First-in-class selective ATP-competitive: First-in-class selective ATP-competitive small-molecule inhibitor of the mutant BRAF V600E (and to a lesser extent V600K, V600D) serine/threonine kinase. By preferentially binding the activated conformation of mutant BRAF, vemurafenib suppresses the constitutive RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling that drives BRAF V600 melanoma; tumor responses are typically rapid (weeks). Monotherapy provided the historical proof-of-concept (BRIM-3, vs dacarbazine: ORR 48% vs 5%, mOS 13.6 vs 9.7 mo) but is now superseded by combination with the MEKi cobimetinib (coBRIM) which mitigates paradoxical RAF activation in BRAF-WT cells and reduces cutaneous SCC / keratoacanthoma incidence. Active in BRAF V600E Erdheim-Chester disease, hairy-cell leukemia (off-label / accelerated), and rare BRAF V600 pediatric tumors.
First-in-class subcutaneous CD20×CD3 bis: First-in-class subcutaneous CD20×CD3 bispecific T-cell engager for relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma after ≥2 prior lines (including patients ineligible for or relapsed after CAR-T). EPCORE NHL-1 (Thieblemont et al., J Clin Oncol 2023): in r/r LBCL ≥3L (n=157, ~39% prior CAR-T) — ORR ~63%, CR ~39%, median DOR ~12 months, median PFS ~4.4 mo, median OS not reached at primary analysis. Step-up dosing (0.16 → 0.8 → 48 mg) + cycle-1 corticosteroid prophylaxis reduce CRS to predominantly Grade 1-2 (any-grade ~50%, G≥3 ~3%). ICANS ~6% any-grade. SC route + ambulatory schedule favourable vs IV bispecifics for outpatient-heavy practices. Continuous indefinite dosing (vs 12-cycle fixed-duration glofitamab) is the principal sequencing trade-off. See REGIMEN-EPCORITAMAB-STEP-UP-DOSING for the standalone cycle-1 step-up sub-schedule. Bibliographic record SRC-EPCORE-NHL-1-THIEBLEMONT-2023 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off.
First-line H. pylori eradication regimen: Erste Linie H. pylori Ausrottung Regime für Regionen mit Clarithromycin-Resistenz >15% — umfasst die Ukraine und die meisten Osteuropas per Maastricht VI/Florenz Konsens 2022. First-line breast imaging for any palpab: First-line Brustbildgebung für jede spürbare Masse, Brennschmerzen, Nippelentladung oder Screening Anomalie bei Frauen ≥30. Tomosynthesis verbessert die Krebserkennung und reduziert die Rückruf in dichten Brüsten.
First-line cytoreductive for newly-dx PV: First-line cytoreductive for newly-dx PV in HU-naive low-risk young patients (<60, no thrombosis history). First-line empirical antifungal in persi: First-line empirical antifungal in persistent FN despite broad- spectrum antibacterials (typically day 4-7 of unresolved fever), per IDSA / ECIL / NCCN. Echinocandin class also first-line for candidemia and invasive candidiasis (IDSA 2016 — replaced fluconazole as default). Major advantages over amphotericin B: comparable / superior efficacy in candidiasis, vastly better tolerability (no nephrotoxicity, no infusion reaction beyond mild histamine-related, no significant electrolyte wasting). Major advantage over azoles: minimal CYP-mediated DDIs (critical when patient is on cyclosporine, tacrolimus, vincristine, ibrutinib, venetoclax, or other CYP3A4 substrates). Disadvantages: limited Aspergillus activity (fungistatic; voriconazole or isavuconazole preferred for documented invasive aspergillosis), no Mucor or Cryptococcus coverage, IV-only (no oral switch). De-escalate to oral fluconazole when species and susceptibility known and patient tolerating PO. Loading dose 70 mg essential — single 50 mg dose produces sub-therapeutic exposure for first 48 h. As ORAL DAILY PrEP in HIV-negative adults at substantial risk, FTC/TDF reduces HIV acquisition by ≥99% with consistent daily adherence (iPrEx 2010, Partners PrEP, TDF2; >90% relative risk reduction at intention-to-treat). Cancer-prevention pathway: preventing incident HIV infection prevents downstream AIDS-defining malignancies (Kaposi sarcoma, NHL incl. Fluorinated purine nucleoside analog of: Fluorierte Purinnukleosidanalog von Adenosin. Phosphoryliertes intrazelluläres zu aktives Triphosphat (F-ara-ATP); in DNA + RNA integriert, hemmt Ribonucleotidreduktase + DNA-Primase + DNA Polymerase α → S-Phasen-Abnahme + Apoptose. Focal progression on imatinib classicall: Focal progression on imatinib classically arises from secondary KIT exon 13 / 14 (ATP-binding) or 17 / 18 (activation-loop) mutations emerging clonally. Sequence: dose-escalate to 800 mg if exon 11 with focal progression and trough low; switch to sunitinib (B2222 follow-on; ATP-binding mutations preferentially sensitive) at clear RECIST progression; regorafenib (GRID) at 3L; ripretinib (INVICTUS, switch-control inhibitor with broad coverage of secondary mutations) 4L. Imatinib trough monitoring (target ≥1100 ng/mL) flags pharmacokinetic non-response distinct from biological resistance. Nodule-within-mass is a sensitive early imaging sign of resistance (Choi response criteria literature).
Folate (tetrahydrofolate, THF) is the ac: Folate (tetrahydrofolate, THF) is the active cofactor for one-carbon transfer reactions in DNA synthesis (thymidylate synthesis from dUMP to dTMP), purine biosynthesis, and methionine cycle / S-adenosyl- methionine (SAM) generation for DNA methylation. Folic acid is the synthetic / fortified form; 5-MTHF is the dominant circulating form. Cancer-prevention rationale (LOW INTAKE → RISK): chronic folate deficiency disrupts DNA methylation and impairs dTMP synthesis (→ uracil misincorporation, double-strand breaks); ecological and observational data link low folate intake / status to increased colorectal cancer risk and possibly breast, pancreatic, esophageal. CONTROVERSY: HIGH INTAKE in patients with EXISTING adenomas or preneoplastic lesions may PROMOTE progression — the "dual-effect" hypothesis (Mason 2007).
