One of three Ashkenazi Jewish (AJ) found: One of three Ashkenazi Jewish (AJ) founder mutations (with BRCA1 c.5266dupC / 5382insC and BRCA2 c.5946delT / 6174delT). Combined carrier frequency for the three AJ founder mutations is ~1 in 40 (~2.5%) in unselected AJ population, vs ~1 in 400 (~0.25%) for any BRCA1/2 pathogenic variant in non-AJ populations. NCCN 2025 endorses population-wide AJ founder-panel testing (3-mutation panel) regardless of family history. c.68_69delAG creates a premature termination codon in exon 2, abolishing BRCT-mediated homologous-recombination repair — full BRCA1 loss-of-function phenotype. Lifetime cancer risks consistent with BRCA1 average: breast ~60-70%, ovarian ~40-45%, contralateral breast ~50% by age 70 in carriers diagnosed at age 50. Same surveillance and risk-reduction protocols as other BRCA1 pathogenic variants (annual breast MRI from age 25-30, RRSO 35-40 after childbearing). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.

OpenOnco keeps nivolumab + ipilimumab as: OpenOnco keeps nivolumab + ipilimumab as the canonical first-line IO backbone for fit metastatic melanoma patients without absolute contraindications to dual checkpoint inhibition (CheckMate-067). Single-agent pembrolizumab is the canonical default when the patient cannot tolerate the higher autoimmune risk of dual IO (KEYNOTE-006). Relatlimab + nivolumab (anti-LAG-3 + anti-PD-1) is an additional dual-checkpoint option with a different toxicity profile (RELATIVITY-047). The chapter expects the learner to weigh autoimmune history, organ function, and disease tempo against these three IO options before reaching for targeted therapy.
OpenOnco models the first-line decision: OpenOnco models the first-line decision as a standard R-CHOP track and an intensified Pola-R-CHP track. Frailty or organ dysfunction is evaluated before intensification. Higher IPI or high-risk biology can move the learner toward the intensified track if access and contraindications are addressed.

OpenOnco modelliert die Erstlinienentscheidung als Aromatase-Inhibitor plus CDK4/6-Inhibitor (Palbociclib, Ribociclib oder Abemaciclib) für endokrin-empfindliche metastasierende Erkrankungen. Intensiver wird inavolisib + Palbocicleb + Fulvestrant, wenn der Patient eine PIK3CA-Koalteration in der inavolissib-fähigen Einstellung und Zugangsbedingungen hat. Die Mutation Germline BRCA1/2 zieht eine parallele Option (Talazoparib-Monotherapie oder Olaparib-Postendoktrin-Progression) in die Diskussion. Viszerale Krise oder drohende Organversagen ist ein explizites Tor, das den Lernenden sogar bei endokrin-sensiblen Erkrankungen in Richtung Chemotherapie treiben kann.

OpenOnco models the first-line decision as docetaxel + trastuzumab + pertuzumab (THP) for HER2-amplified metastatic disease, with trastuzumab + pertuzumab maintenance continuing after taxane completion (CLEOPATRA). HR co-positive disease adds endocrine therapy to the maintenance phase rather than replacing the HER2-directed backbone. Frailty, organ dysfunction, or cardiac contraindications are evaluated against THP before any de-intensification choice, and active visceral crisis remains a separate emergency pathway.

OpenOnco splits the first-line mCRPC dec: OpenOnco splits the first-line mCRPC decision by prior ARPI exposure. ARPI-naive mCRPC routes to abiraterone or enzalutamide; ARPI-resistant disease pulls PARP-inhibitor reasoning into the canonical first option when a BRCA1/2 mutation (or, depending on the indication, a broader HRR alteration) is present. Patients without an actionable HRR alteration who have already received an ARPI move toward docetaxel chemotherapy at the next decision point. The transition from mHSPC to mCRPC is the moment when a fresh HRR result changes the algorithm — older germline-only tests should be repeated with tumor sequencing if the original result was negative.

Osteosarcoma is the most common primary: Osteosarcoma is the most common primary malignant bone tumor in children + adolescents. Bimodal age distribution: adolescent growth-spurt peak (10–20y; long-bone metaphyses) and elderly secondary peak (>60y; predominantly Paget disease-associated or post-radiation). Standard-of-care multi-modal treatment (full Indications pending): neoadjuvant chemotherapy → en-bloc surgical resection (limb-salvage preferred; amputation reserved for unresectable / vascular-bundle invasion) → adjuvant chemotherapy. MAP regimen (high-dose methotrexate, doxorubicin, cisplatin) is the global standard from EURAMOS-1 (good-responder arm). Histological necrosis ≥90% at resection predicts favorable outcome; poor responders (<90% necrosis) do NOT benefit from intensification per EURAMOS-1. Genetic relationships drive prevention-workstream surveillance: - Li-Fraumeni (germline TP53): osteosarcoma is the second-most common cancer in this syndrome; Toronto-protocol annual whole-body MRI + bone surveillance recommended. v0.2-B pilot. - Hereditary retinoblastoma (germline RB1) survivors: lifetime osteosarcoma risk markedly elevated, particularly within prior RT field. Ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in any: Ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor in any child / adolescent / young adult should trigger DICER1 germline testing — the proportion of DICER1-positive cases is high (~30-60%, higher in younger and poorly-differentiated cases). Diagnosis in a postmenopausal woman has a lower (though non-zero) DICER1-positive yield. Treatment: fertility-sparing unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (USO) with staging for stage IA well-differentiated tumors in young women; total hysterectomy + bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (TAH-BSO) for postmenopausal patients or high-grade / advanced-stage disease. Adjuvant chemotherapy (BEP — bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin — similar to germ-cell tumour regimens) for stage IC and above, or poorly-differentiated / retiform variants. Androgen excess resolves dramatically post-surgery (virilization symptoms regress but voice deepening may be permanent). Lifelong DICER1-syndrome surveillance for germline-positive survivors: contralateral ovary US q6-12 months (synchronous and metachronous DICER1-driven SLCTs reported), chest imaging (PPB risk in survivors' offspring + own residual risk), thyroid US, and abdominal-pelvic US.

PD-L1 CPS is a continuous IHC score used as an eligibility threshold for ICI-containing regimens in metastatic gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma. Thresholds vary by regimen: CPS ≥5 — nivolumab + fluoropyrimidine + platinum (CheckMate-649; mOS 14.4 vs 11.1 mo, HR 0.71 in CPS≥5 subgroup); CPS ≥1 — nivolumab + chemo as broader population (CM-649); CPS ≥1 — pembrolizumab + trastuzumab + chemo for HER2+ disease (KEYNOTE-811, covered separately in BMA-HER2-AMP-GASTRIC). Per NCCN and ESMO 2024, PD-L1 CPS testing by IHC 22C3 pharmDx is mandatory prior to 1L treatment selection. Threshold-gated indication selection is performed by the algorithm layer (IND-GASTRIC-METASTATIC-1L-PDL1-CHEMO-ICI); this BMA entry surfaces ESCAT tier context for tumor-board discussion only.

Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (Lynch-like): colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 20-25, endometrial sampling + TVUS q1-2y from age 30-35 in women (consider earlier given higher endometrial risk than POLE), EGD q3y from age 30, urinalysis q1y from age 30. Tumor ultramutator phenotype (TMB high) suggests immunotherapy responsiveness in advanced disease; pembrolizumab FDA- approved for TMB-H solid tumors. Risk-reducing hysterectomy + BSO after childbearing is reasonable to discuss in POLD1 carriers (analogous to Lynch INTENSIFIED-track decision). ESCAT IIA.

PTCH1 (Patched-1) is the primary tumor s: PTCH1 (Patched-1) ist der primäre Tumorsuppressor im Hedgehog- (HH)-Weg. Er hemmt normalerweise SMO durch Sequestering; wenn HH Ligand (SHH, DHH, IHH), bindet PTCHE1, diese Hemmung wird freigesetzt, so dass SMO GLI1/2 Transkriptionsfaktoren aktivieren kann. Somatischer PTSCH1-Verlust ist der dominante Treiber von sporadischen BCC (~90%). Die Mutation Germline PTCH1 verursacht Gorlin-Syndrom (Basal Cell Nevus-Syndrom): multiple BCCs aus dem frühen Erwachsenenalter, odontogene Keratozysten, Skelettanomalien, kalzifizierte Falx-Cerebri und deutlich erhöhtes Medulloblastom-Risiko (SHH-Subtyp, überwiegend desmoplastisch, im Kindesalter). Gorlin Syndrompatienten sind exquisit empfindlich gegen ionisierende Strahlung (Strahlung-induzierte BCC im Feld); die Strahlentherapie ist für die BCC-Behandlung bei Gorlin Patienten relativ kontraindiziert. Therapeutische Implikation: Der Verlust von PTCH1 in BCC rechtfertigt Igelhemmer (Vismodegib/Sonidegib) bei lokal fortgeschrittener/metastastischer Erkrankung — Routinetumor PTCHE1-Tests sind nicht erforderlich, da die Aktivierung des HH-Weges in B CC universell ist.

PTPN11 encodes SHP2, a protein tyrosine: PTPN11 encodes SHP2, a protein tyrosine phosphatase that acts as a positive regulator of the RAS/MAPK pathway. Gain-of-function mutations disrupt autoinhibition, leading to constitutive RAS/ERK activation. Clinical contexts: (1) JMML: somatic PTPN11 mutations in ~35% — the single most common driver. Somatic PTPN11 in JMML carries poor prognosis; germline PTPN11 (Noonan syndrome) may cause a transient self-limiting myeloproliferative process that resolves without HCT. Critical to distinguish somatic vs germline origin — germline PTPN11 is a very different clinical entity. (2) Noonan syndrome (germline): most common cause (~50%); N308D, Q79R, D61G hotspots. Features: short stature, cardiac defects (pulmonary stenosis, HCM), webbed neck. Very low lifetime malignancy risk beyond juvenile myeloproliferative disease. (3) Acute leukemias: PTPN11 mutations in ~7% of AML, ~5% of B-ALL. (4) Solid tumors: ~5% of NSCLC, gastric, colorectal (often co-occurring with KRAS). Therapeutic target: SHP2 inhibitors are in active clinical development — TNO155 (Novartis), RMC-4630 (Revolution Medicines), ERAS-601 (Erasca). MEK inhibitors (trametinib) also under evaluation in PTPN11-mutant JMML given downstream pathway convergence. ESCAT IIIA: somatic PTPN11 is prognostically relevant and the molecular target of SHP2 inhibitors in development; HCT remains standard; no approved SHP2 inhibitor. Patient-specific autologous polyclonal c: Patient-specific autologous polyclonal cell-therapy product manufactured ex vivo from a fresh resected tumor specimen (typically a single ≥1.5 cm cutaneous, subcutaneous, lymph-node, or visceral metastasis). The tumor is enzymatically dissociated; endogenous tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs — predominantly CD8+ effector T cells with native polyclonal TCR repertoire recognizing patient-unique tumor neoantigens) are expanded over ~22 days using interleukin-2 (IL-2) and an OKT3 anti-CD3 stimulus, then cryopreserved and shipped back. Treatment requires three steps: (1) non-myeloablative lymphodepleting chemotherapy (cyclophosphamide + fludarabine) to deplete suppressive Tregs and create homeostatic cytokine sinks; (2) single IV infusion of the expanded TIL product (target 7.5–72 × 10⁹ viable cells); (3) short-course high-dose IL-2 (aldesleukin 600,000 IU/kg IV q8-12 h for up to 6 doses)...
Patient-specific titration to maximum to: Patient-specific titration to maximum tolerated dose (5 → 7 → 10 mg BID) is a defining feature — patients tolerating starting dose with normotension should escalate, as exposure correlates with efficacy. KEYNOTE-426 + JAVELIN-Renal-101…

Pediatric VAC + IE (Ewing-like) protocol: Pediatric VAC + IE (Ewing-like) protocols are myelosuppressive and require strict hepatic / renal monitoring in infants (often <1 yr old). LVEF threshold 55% (not 50%) in pediatric oncology reflects long-life-expectancy sensitivity to anthracycline cardiotoxicity. Larotrectinib / entrectinib much better tolerated than cytotoxic in this age group — the organ-dysfunction flag pushes harder toward TRK-inhibitor monotherapy when fusion-positive (which is >90% of cases). For TRK-inhibitor: dose by BSA / weight per FDA pediatric label; hepatic dose reduction required at bilirubin >3× ULN.
Pediatric cystic nephroma is a strong DI: Pediatric cystic nephroma is a strong DICER1-syndrome signal — diagnosis in any child should trigger DICER1 germline testing AND cascade-testing of parents + siblings. Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome is a separate (non- DICER1) etiology that shares the Wilms-spectrum abdominal-tumour surveillance protocol (abdominal US q3-4 months from birth to age 7; AFP q2-3 months from birth to age 4 — focused on hepatoblastoma). Treatment: maximal safe surgical resection (nephron-sparing partial nephrectomy when anatomically feasible; total nephrectomy if not). Histopathology after resection is critical — distinguishes pure cystic nephroma (benign-borderline, surveillance only) from cystic partially differentiated nephroblastoma (Wilms-spectrum, requires adjuvant chemo per stage) and from progression to anaplastic sarcoma of the kidney (high-grade malignant, requires multimodal therapy). Lifelong DICER1-syndrome surveillance for germline-positive survivors: chest imaging (PPB risk), abdominal-pelvic US (ovarian, Sertoli-Leydig risk in girls), thyroid US, and CNS imaging (pineoblastoma, pituitary blastoma risk under age 5).
Pediatric infection screening is broader: Pediatric infection screening is broader than adult — include CMV / herpes given immunosuppression on VAC and likelihood of reactivation in neonates / infants. HBsAg+ infants: confirm vertical transmission, consult pediatric hepatology, entecavir / tenofovir prophylaxis adapted to weight. HIV+ pediatric: ART coordination critical — TRK inhibitors (larotrectinib, entrectinib) are CYP3A4 substrates, avoid CYP3A4 inhibitors. Pneumocystis prophylaxis (TMP-SMX) is standard on cytotoxic arm. Surfaces hold via parallel pre-treatment workup.

Pexidartinib (PLX3397), ein CSF1R/KIT/FLT3-Inhibitor, ist FDA-genehmigt (August 2019) für erwachsene Patienten mit symptomatischem Tenosynovial-Ganzzelltumor (TGCT), der mit schwerer Morbidität oder funktionellen Einschränkungen verbunden ist, die nicht zur Verbesserung der Operation geeignet sind. ILLUMINATE-Phase-III-Studie (Tap et al., Lancet 2019): N=120 (Pexidartinib vs Placebo, Crossover-Design); primärer Endpunkt ORR in Woche 25 durch RECIST 1.1 und TTP-MRI. ORR: 38% (RECIST) gegen 0% Placebo (p < 0,0001); 56% durch TTP/MRI vs 0%. mDOR: nicht erreicht bei medianen 23,1 Monaten Follow-up. Klinische Nutzenrate: 56%. Sicherheit: signifikante Hepatotoxizität (cholestatische Hepatitis, einschließlich eines tödlichen Falles in offener Verlängerung); ALT/AST-Erhöhungen in ~51%; FDA REMS-Programm obligatorisch. EMA für dieselbe Indikation zugelassen (2020). Keine Biomarker-begleitende Diagnose erforderlich – alle TGCT-Patienten sind aufgrund klinischer Kriterien (symptomatisch, operativ-resistent) anspruchsberechtigt. Für die Einleitung der Behandlung ist keine Prüfung der Fusionsreaktion CSF1R IHC oder COL6A3-CSF1 erforderlich.

Pheochromocytoma is a catecholamine-secr: Pheochromocytoma is a catecholamine-secreting neuroendocrine tumor of adrenal medullary origin; extra-adrenal counterparts (paragangliomas) arise from sympathetic / parasympathetic ganglia (head/neck, thoracic, abdominal). They are biologically and clinically a single spectrum (PPGL); this entity is anchored to the adrenal subset for ICD-10 cleanliness but cross-references SDHx-driven extra-adrenal paragangliomas in prevention workstream notes. Hereditary fraction is the highest known among adult cancers (~30–40%). NCCN and Endocrine Society recommend germline panel testing (RET, VHL, SDHB/C/D/AF2, NF1, TMEM127, MAX, FH) for ALL patients with PPGL — not restricted by family history. This makes PPGL a sentinel disease for hereditary cancer surveillance pathways (RET → MEN2 prophylactic thyroidectomy; VHL → multi-organ surveillance; SDHB → lifetime PPGL + RCC surveillance). Classical clinical triad: headache + palpitations + sweating; many patients present with paroxysmal or sustained hypertension. Phosphorylated water-soluble prodrug of: Phosphorylated water-soluble prodrug of aprepitant; rapidly converted by ubiquitous tissue phosphatases to active aprepitant within 30 minutes of IV administration. Active moiety blocks the substance P / NK1 receptor in CNS emetic centers (nucleus tractus solitarius, area postrema), preventing the delayed phase of chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV) that is incompletely controlled by 5-HT3 antagonists alone. A single 150 mg IV dose given on day 1 covers the full delayed phase (~5 days), eliminating need for oral days 2-3 capsules. Approved by FDA January 2008 (single-dose 150 mg formulation: October 2008) and EMA January 2008.

Pineoblastoma is one of the canonical em: Pineoblastoma is one of the canonical embryonal CNS manifestations of DICER1 syndrome — diagnosis in any child should trigger DICER1 germline testing regardless of family history. Distinct from pineocytoma (Grade 1, benign) and pineal parenchymal tumour of intermediate differentiation (PPTID, Grade 2-3). Treatment philosophy parallels other embryonal CNS tumours: maximal safe surgical resection (gross total resection is prognostically dominant); craniospinal irradiation in age-appropriate patients (deferred under age 3 due to neurocognitive toll); adjuvant high-dose chemotherapy regimens (often COG/SIOP protocols with carboplatin, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, cisplatin, etoposide combinations + autologous stem-cell rescue in high-risk cases). Trilateral retinoblastoma (bilateral RB1-carrier with pineal pineoblastoma) historically had near-uniform mortality; modern MRI surveillance from RB1-carrier diagnosis has shifted some cases to earlier detection with improved outcomes.

Piperacillin is a ureidopenicillin that: Piperacillin ist ein ureidopenicillin, das Penicilli-bindende Proteine (PBPs) bindet und die bakterielle Zell-Wand-Synthese hemmt, wodurch eine schnelle bakterizide Aktivität gegen die meisten Gram-negativen Bacilli einschließlich Pseudomonas aeruginosa, die meisten Enterobacterales, viele Anaeroben und ausgewählte Gram-positive Kokzien entsteht. Tazobactam ist ein irreversibler β-Lactamase-Inhibitor (Penicillansäuresulfon), der Plasmid-vermittelte und chromosomale Klasse A β -Lactamasen (TEM, SHV, CTX-M ESBLs teilweise) bindet und inaktiviert, die Piperacellinaktivität gegen viele β –Lactamitase-produzierende Organismen wiederherzustellen. Erstlinien-Empirische Monotherapie für febrile Neutropenie (FN) in den meisten Zentren pro IDSA, ECIL-4 und NCCN-Richtlinien wegen pseudomonaler Abdeckung, anaerobe Aktivität und gutes Sicherheitsprofil.

Pituitary blastoma is the strongest sing: Pituitary blastoma is the strongest single-tumour DICER1-syndrome signal — diagnosis in any infant should immediately trigger DICER1 germline testing AND cascade-testing of parents (>95% pituitary blastomas carry pathogenic germline DICER1). Distinct from far-more- common pituitary adenomas (which are not DICER1-driven and are typically adult-onset). Treatment: trans-sphenoidal or trans-cranial resection (technically challenging in infants — pituitary blastomas are bleeding-prone and locally invasive); adjuvant chemotherapy (carboplatin-VP16-cyclophosphamide-based regimens reported in case series); RT generally avoided under age 3 due to severe neurocognitive + endocrine toll. Hypercortisolism management (medical adrenal blockade, sometimes adrenalectomy) is an essential pre-operative bridge. Lifelong endocrine replacement (hydrocortisone, growth hormone, thyroid, gonadal axis) after curative-intent resection. Lifelong DICER1-syndrome surveillance for survivors.

Potent ATP-competitive small-molecule in: Potenter ATP-kompetitiver kleinmolekularer Hemmstoff aller drei AKT-Serin/Threonin-Kinase-Isoformen (AKT1, AKT2, AKT3) innerhalb des Signalweges PI3K-AKT-mTOR. Unterdrückt die nachgeschaltete Phosphorylierung von Effektorsubstraten (FOXO, GSK3, TSC2, MDM2, 4EBP1 über mTORC1), reduziert die Proliferations- und Überlebenssignalisierung und teilweise die Reversierung der endokrinen Resistenz bei HR+-Brustkrebs, getrieben durch PI3-K-Wegveränderungen. Tumore mit aktivierter PIK3CA / AKT1-Mutation oder PTEN-Verlust (~40-50% HR+/ HER2-mBC nach CDK4/6i) sind um das Ansprechen angereichert. Pivotale Evidenz CAPItello-291 (HR+/HER2-mBC nach KI ± CDK4/6i): Capivasertib + Fulvestrant vs Placebo + Folvestrant — insgesamt mPFS 7,2 vs 3,6 mo HR 0,60; in PIK 3CA/AKT1/PTEN-geänderter Untergruppe mPFS 7,3 vs 3.1 mo HR 0,50. FDA-Zulassung 2023 (mutationsgeschränkt).

In pNET: anti-VEGF/PDGF pathway disrupts tumour neovasculature; direct TKI effect on pNET cells that overexpress VEGFR. Pre-existing autoimmune disease is prese: Pre-existing autoimmune disease is present in ~10-15% of patients eligible for ICI therapy; historically excluded from pivotal trials. Real-world data (Abdel-Wahab 2018, 3557 pts) shows 55% experienced irAE flare and ~29% required systemic immunosuppression beyond steroids. Risk stratification by SITC 2021: - **Low risk** (generally safe to proceed with monitoring): thyroiditis, vitiligo, stable psoriasis, type 1 diabetes — irAE flare mild, manageable. - **Moderate risk** (proceed with specialist input): RA, IBD (Crohn/UC), sarcoidosis, sicca syndrome, psoriatic arthritis — flare rate ~50%; baseline DMARDs often OK to continue (methotrexate, HCQ but NOT high-dose steroids or anti-TNF at start). - **High risk** (strongest caution; consider alternative if available): active autoimmune hepatitis, myasthenia gravis, inflammatory myopathy, neuromyelitis optica — flare can be life-threatening; benefit-risk discussion mandatory. Pulmonary sarcoidosis specifically: ICI-induced sarcoid-like reactions are well-documented (5-7% of patients on ICI), often mimicking disease progression on imaging. Mit relevanter_Krankheiten=["*"] befestigt der Motor NICHT Indikationsspuren über den Präventionspfad (plan.py:297 schließt "*") aus — universelle, in DIS-HCC verankerte Indikationen sind Dokumentationen/Sidecar-Kandidaten bis zur zukünftigen Motorenerweiterung. Pre-triage universal RedFlag — multi-exp: Vortriage universal RedFlag — Multi-Expositions-Krebsrisiko nach IARC Monographen 100A-F + 105 + 132 (synergistische Kombinationen). Trigger verwendet explizit positive Befunde `multiple_iarc_group1_occupational_exposures_doccupted: true`. Pre-triage universal RedFlag — obesity (: Pre-triage universal RedFlag — obesity (BMI≥30) per IARC 13-cancer cluster + WCRF/AICR CUP. Authoring intent: route to structured weight-loss program + cancer-cluster screening modification (CRC priority — adenoma surveillance interval and starting-age individualization; breast supplemental imaging on density; endometrial symptom-prompted TVUS; HCC US+AFP q6mo if NAFLD/MASH-cirrhosis component). With relevant_diseases=["*"], the engine does NOT attach Indication tracks via the prevention path (engine excludes "*" at plan.py:297) — universal Indications anchored to DIS-CRC are documentation / sidecar candidates pending future engine extension. Preferred 1L for advanced/progressive RE: Preferred 1L for advanced/progressive RET-mutant MTC per NCCN (LIBRETTO- 531 randomized vs cabozantinib/vandetanib: superior PFS, fewer treatment-limiting AEs). LIBRETTO-001 ORR ~73% in RET-mutant MTC with median DOR not reached. Patient must have advanced/unresectable disease + symptomatic OR structural progression OR calcitonin doubling time <2 yr. Pralsetinib (ARROW) is the alternative RET-selective.
Preferred 1L for the ~95% of advanced SM: Preferred 1L for the ~95% of advanced SM that is KIT D816V+. Indolent SM (ISM) does NOT receive avapritinib at this dose for disease modification — avapritinib 25 mg in moderate-severe symptomatic ISM (PIONEER) is a separate, narrower symptomatic- control indication not authored here.
Preferred 2nd-gen TKI for younger CML pa: Preferred 2nd-gen TKI for younger CML patients targeting deep molecular response + treatment-free remission, OR for Ph+ ALL. AVOID in pulmonary comorbidity (COPD, prior pleural disease, PAH) due to effusion risk.

Bevorzugtes TKI der 2. Generation für jüngere CML-Patienten ohne Risikofaktoren für die CV-Therapie zur tiefen molekularen Reaktion + TFR. AVOID bei Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen (PAOD, vorherige MI, unkontrollierte Hypertonie), Pankreatitis in der Vorgeschichte, Diabetes, Hyperlipidämie. Strenge Nüchternkeitsanforderung ist nicht-triviale Haftbelastung.

Preferred 2nd-gen TKI for younger CML patients without CV risk factors targeting deep molecular response + TFR. AVOID in cardiovascular disease (PAOD, prior MI, uncontrolled hypertension), pancreatitis history, diabetes, hyperlipidemia…
Preferred 5-HT3 antagonist for HEC and f: Preferred 5-HT3 antagonist for HEC and for multi-day chemotherapy regimens because of long half-life and demonstrated superiority in delayed-phase CINV control vs ondansetron in head-to-head trials (Saito 2009, Aapro 2014). Triple antiemetic regimen for HEC: NK1 antagonist (aprepitant or fosaprepitant) + palonosetron 0.25 mg IV + dexamethasone 12 mg IV day 1, with dex tapered through delayed phase. Akynzeo (netupitant 300 mg + palonosetron 0.5 mg) fixed-dose oral capsule simplifies triple therapy to two pills (Akynzeo + dex) on day 1. Lowest QT signal in 5-HT3 class — preferred when ondansetron contraindicated due to QT concerns or cardiac comorbidity. Minimal CYP-mediated metabolism makes it the safer 5-HT3 choice in polypharmacy patients (e.g., patients on CYP3A4 inhibitors).
Preferred BTKi for CLL 1L per NCCN 2025: Preferred BTKi for CLL 1L per NCCN 2025 (over ibrutinib due to less cardiac toxicity). ELEVATE-TN (1L CLL): superior PFS vs Clb+O at 5y; ELEVATE-RR (r/r): non-inferior to ibrutinib with better safety. Funding pathway must be confirmed pre-start in Ukraine.
Preferred BTKi over ibrutinib in modern: Bevorzugte BTKi über ibrutinib in modernen CLL/MCL Richtlinien (ELEVATE-RR für r/r CLL — vergleichbare Wirksamkeit, weniger Herz-/Hypertonie-Ereignisse). ELEVAT-TN: 1L CLL Daten auch günstig. Ukraine: registriert, aber NICHT über NSZU erstattet — Finanzierung...
Preferred over zoledronate in patients w: Bevorzugtes über Zoledronat bei Patienten mit eingeschränkter Nierenfunktion. Krebs-Knochenmetastase Dosierung unterscheidet sich von Osteoporose Dosierung – halten Sie sich getrennt. Vorbehandlung Zahnclearance kritisch, um das ONJ-Risiko zu reduzieren.
Pregnancy — absolute contraindication to: Pregnancy — absolute contraindication to lenalidomide. Engine blocks both VRd and D-VRd, falls back to bortezomib + dex (Vd).

Prevention-persona BWS confirmed-carrier: Präventionspersona BWS bestätigt-Träger RedFlag (Pädiatrische Krebsveranlagung Welle M). Engine-Routen zur PräventionPlan für Wilms Tumor + Hepatoblastom Überwachung: Abdominal US q3mo von Kindheit bis Alter 8, AFP monatlich bis Alter 3-4 dann q 3mo bis Alter 4. STUB anhängig zwei-Klinisch-Co-Leitung Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode. Krankheit Anker DIS-WILMS pro Wave-M Kurzform; Hepatoblastom Krebs-Spektrum in der Begründung der gepaarten Indikationen notiert.
Prevention-persona Costello syndrome con: Prevention-persona Costello-Syndrom bestätigt-Träger RedFlag (Pädiatrische Krebs-Prädisposition Welle M). Engine-Routen zur PreventionPlan für embryonal-sarkom-Überwachung: abdominal/pelvic US q3-6mo bis Alter 8-10, dann Urinzytologie + Blase US ab Alter 10 lebenslang. Herz-Überwachung wird durch kombinierte Kardiologie-Wege angetrieben und behandelt, nicht dieser RF. STUB bis Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode. Der Krankheitsanker DIS-SOFT-TISSUE-SARCOMA deckt embryonale RMS; Neuroblastom + Blasen-TCC-Krebsspektrum, das in der Begründung der gepaarten Indikationen vermerkt ist.
Prevention-persona RedFlag (CHARTER §3 a: Prevention-persona RedFlag (CHARTER §3 amended 2026-05-18 Path A, HCP-mediated). Fires when patient profile shows chronic H. pylori (positive UBT / stool antigen / biopsy histology / stool PCR) AND no confirmed gastric malignancy. Engine routes such patients to a PreventionPlan recommending eradication therapy (per IND-H-PYLORI-PREVENTION-ERADICATION) as the etiological-cancer- prevention pathway. Evidence for H. pylori → gastric cancer causation (IARC Group 1): multiple Cochrane meta-analyses show eradication reduces gastric adenocarcinoma incidence (RR ~0.54-0.66, NNT ~15-50 depending on population baseline incidence). Effect is stronger in high-incidence populations and in younger individuals where atrophic gastritis / intestinal metaplasia has not yet developed. Evidence for H. pylori → gastric MALT lymphoma: eradication is the first-line treatment for early-stage gastric MALT lymphoma, with Wotherspoon regression in ~70-80% of cases (especially t(11;18)- negative). This is treatment-persona territory (existing MALT lymphoma in setting of confirmed H. pylori → treatment Indication, not yet authored) — distinct from prevention persona (chronic H. pylori → prevent MALT/adenocarc...

Prevention-persona RedFlag (CHARTER §3 amended 2026-05-18 Path A, HCP-mediated). Fires when patient profile shows chronic HCV (HCV-RNA detectable OR HCV-Ab+ with persistent viremia >6 months) AND no confirmed B-cell NHL diagnosis. Engine routes such patients to a PreventionPlan recommending DAA antiviral therapy (per IND-CHRONIC-HCV-PREVENTION-DAA) as the etiological-cancer-prevention pathway. Evidence for HCV → NHL causation (IARC Group 1): multiple cohort studies show 2-3x increased risk of indolent B-cell NHL in chronic HCV carriers; epidemiology especially robust for MZL subtypes. DAA cure (SVR12) has been associated with reduced NHL incidence in post-treatment cohorts (de-Re et al. and others) and with regression of established HCV-associated indolent NHL (the basis of IND-HCV-MZL-1L-ANTIVIRAL for the treatment persona). This is a STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode exemption (sources cited, draft flag set). Engine consumption is DEFERRED to v0.2 implementation wave — the PreventionPlan code path does not yet exist; this RF lands as schema-valid declarative content awaiting that wave.
Prevention-persona RedFlag combining red: Prevention-persona RedFlag combining red-meat ≥500g/week + processed-meat ≥50g/day thresholds per WCRF/AICR + IARC Monograph 114. Severity:major because processed-meat exposure is Group-1 carcinogen with population-attributable fraction ~13% for CRC (WCRF/AICR). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending dietary substitution + CRC screening per USPSTF. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode. Coexists with existing RF-LIFESTYLE-PROCESSED-MEAT-PREVENTION — both may fire.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for ATM heter: Präventionspersona RedFlag für ATM heterozygote Träger. Die Unterscheidung vom Biallelic A-T Phänotyp ist entscheidend: Heterozygoten haben nur eine Krebsprädisposition (kein neurologischer Phäotyp). Motorwege zur verbesserten Brustüberwachung + Pankreasüberwachung für FDR-of-PDAC Träger pro CAPS-Konsortium 2022; Prostatabewusstsein für Männer. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BAP1 synd: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für BAP1-Syndrom Familiengeschichte. STUB bis Zwei-Co-Lead-Anmelden.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BARD1 het: Prevention-persona RedFlag for BARD1 heterozygous carriers. Engine routes to enhanced breast surveillance + ovarian symptom-driven workup. NCCN places BARD1 in moderate-elevated breast tier (annual mammography from age 40; consider MRI). Triple-negative subset signal may justify earlier or MRI-inclusive screening in family- history-stratified cohorts. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BHD/FLCN: Prevention-persona RedFlag for BHD/FLCN confirmed carriers. Multi- organ surveillance: abdominal MRI q2-3y from age 20 for RCC (avoid radiation; many BHD lesions are hybrid oncocytic + slow-growing); chest HRCT baseline + symptom-driven (spontaneous pneumothorax triggers high-resolution imaging); dermatology q1y for skin surveillance. Nephron-sparing surgery (partial nephrectomy) preferred for ≤3cm renal lesions given multifocal/bilateral disease pattern. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for BRIP1 het: Präventionspersona RedFlag für BRIP1 heterozygote Träger. NCCN unterstützt RRSO bei vollendetem Gebären oder Alter 45-50; kein Populations-Ovarialkrebs-Screening empfohlen. Brustüberwachung pro Allgemeinpopulationsschema, es sei denn, die Familiengeschichte erhöht unabhängig das Risiko. STUB bis Zwei-Co-Lead-Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for C. sinens: Prevention-persona RedFlag for C. sinensis-driven cholangiocarcinoma prevention. Fires on any documented exposure history with confirmatory testing. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending praziquantel (if active infection) + lifelong hepatobiliary surveillance (US + CA 19-9 q12mo from age 40 in heavily-exposed cohorts). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA. East-Asian endemic belt has 10-50x higher cholangiocarcinoma incidence than non-endemic Western populations. Geographic context: relevant for East-Asian diaspora, immigrants, refugees, adoptees. Companion to RF-OPISTHORCHIS-CHOLANGIO-PREVENTION (Mekong-region liver-fluke pathway, biologically similar mechanism — identical surveillance protocol).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDH1 / HD: Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDH1 / HDGC confirmed carriers per IGCLC 2020 international guideline. Prophylactic total gastrectomy (PTG) recommended ages 20-30 (range 18-40 per individualised discussion); endoscopic surveillance is acknowledged inferior to PTG (diffuse-type signet-ring cell foci poorly visible) but offered to PTG-declining carriers. Female carriers: BRCA-style breast surveillance from age 30. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CDKN2A-sp: Präventivpersona RedFlag für CDKN2A-spezifische Träger (genspezifische RF vs. breiter FAMMM RF). Pankreasüberwachung nach CAPS-Konsortium 2018/2020: Wechsel EUS + abdominale MRI/MRCP alle 12 Monate ab 40 oder 10 Jahre vor dem frühesten PDAC in der Familie (je nachdem, was früher war). Melanomüberwachung: jährliche Ganzkörperhautuntersuchung + Dermoskopie ab 10-12; Kartierung von Fotografien für multiple atypische Mole. Patient sollte aggressiven Sonnenschutz + lebenslange CDKn2A -spezifische Kohorte kennen. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co- Lead-Auszeichnung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CHEK2 het: Präventionspersona RedFlag für CHEK2 heterozygote Träger. Risikoschätzungen variieren erheblich nach Variante: Zerschneiden > Splice > Missense. Motorwege zu einer verstärkten Brustüberwachung (jährliche Mammographie ab 40 Jahren + MRT-Betrachtung), bescheiden gestraffte SFB-Screening (Kolonoskopie ab 40 Jahre mit q5y Intervall pro NCCN), Prostatabewusstsein ab 40-45 Jahren für Männer mit c.1100delC. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-Modus.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for CMMRD con: Prevention-persona RedFlag for CMMRD confirmed-carrier pediatric cohort. Surveillance per Care for CMMRD (C4CMMRD) consortium 2014: whole-body MRI annually from diagnosis; brain MRI q6mo from age 2; colonoscopy q6mo from age 6; upper GI endoscopy + small-bowel capsule annual from age 8; CBC + serum protein electrophoresis + abdominal US q6mo. Cascade testing of siblings + parental MMR carrier confirmation. Immunotherapy (anti-PD-1) effective in established CMMRD-related cancers (Bouffet 2016, Larkin/CheckMate series). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for Cronkhite: Prevention-persona RedFlag for Cronkhite-Canada syndrome. risk_category set to chronic_condition (not genetic) because etiology is acquired autoimmune-like + non-Mendelian. Surveillance: colonoscopy q1-2y from diagnosis; upper endoscopy q1-2y; small-bowel capsule q2y; treat active disease with immunosuppression (prednisone taper + azathioprine maintenance) + nutritional support (protein replacement, electrolyte correction). Mortality reduced markedly with immuno- suppression treatment. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for DES in-ut: Präventionspersona RedFlag für die DES-in-utero-Expositionskohorte. Die Überwachung wird im Verhältnis zur Allgemeinbevölkerung intensiviert (jährlicher Beckenspiegel mit sorgfältiger vaginaler/zervikaler Untersuchung; Kolposkopie bei abnormaler Zytologie; Mammographie bei jüngerer Altersgrenze pro NCCN-Modifierrisiko; betrachten MRT-Mammascreening-Adjunkt mit doppeltem Risiko). STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for DICER1 co: Präventionspersona RedFlag für DICER1-Körperschaft. Kinderüberwachung nach Internationalem PPB-Register / IDSDB-Empfehlungen: - Brust CT q4-6 Mo von Geburt an bis zum Alter von 3, q6-12 Mo bis zum Jahr von 8 Jahren. - Abdominal US q3-6 Mo vom Geburtsjahr bis zum 8. Lebensjahr. - Schilddrüsen-Ausgangsalter nach Alter von 8 + q3-5 y. - Becken-USA bei weiblichen Trägern von Menarchen. - Hirn-MRT-Auszugslinie + Symptom-getrieben. Chirurgie-Kurativ für PPB Typ I, wenn frühzeitig erkannt; fortgeschrittene PPB -Typ III (feste Komponente) sehr aggressiv. Risikoreduzierende Oophorektomie, die nicht für die Sertoli-Leydig-Prävention befürwortet wird. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for EBV-drive: Präventionspersona RedFlag für EBV-getriebene Krebsprävention bei immunskompromissierten Wirtspersonen. Im Gegensatz zu HCV/HBV/ H. pylori gibt es kein kuratives Anti-EBV-Regime; der Präventionsweg ist (a) die Immunsuppression, wo möglich, zu reduzieren, (b) präventiver Rituximab bei Patienten nach Transplantation mit steigendem EB V-DNA (pro internationale PTLD-Richtlinien), (c) regelmäßiges EBv-DNS-Monitoring. STUB steht noch aus Co-Lead-Review. Das Eingieren durch zusätzlichen Immunskompromiss-Kontext ist beabsichtigt — EBV-Seroprevalenz liegt bei immunkompetenten Erwachsenen weltweit bei > 90%, so dass ein RF, der allein auf EB V ausgelöst wird, universell feuern und kein klinisches Signal liefern würde.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for FAMMM / C: Präventionspersona RedFlag für FAMMM / CDKN2A. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Anmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HBV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HBV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on HBsAg+ OR detectable HBV-DNA in patient without HCC. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending nucleos(t)ide analog suppression (per IND-CHRONIC-HBV-PREVENTION-ANTIVIRAL) + AFP+US HCC surveillance q6mo per AASLD protocol. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchor target DIS-HCC. HBV-associated DLBCL/NHL is also documented in literature but with weaker effect-size data than the HCV-NHL link; covered via the broader NHL prevention surveillance bullet in the antiviral indication rationale. Distinct from RF-UNIVERSAL-HBV-REACTIVATION-RISK (existing) which is the treatment-time RF for HBV reactivation during anti-CD20 / chemo.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HCV + HBV: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HCV + HBV coinfection cancer prevention. Higher severity (critical) than either mono-infection RF — coinfection carries documented synergistic HCC risk AND DAA-cure-induced HBV reactivation risk that requires combination antiviral. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending concurrent DAA + nucleos(t)ide analog + intensified HCC surveillance (US + AFP q4-6mo, more frequent than the q6mo cadence for either mono-infection). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-HCC. NHL prevention (HCV-driven) continues to be a secondary benefit; tracked via prose in the combined-antiviral indication rationale. Distinct from RF-CHRONIC-HCV-NHL-PREVENTION-OPPORTUNITY and RF-CHRONIC-HBV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (individual mono-infection RFs). When coinfection trigger fires, this RF takes precedence over the two individual RFs (higher priority).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HHV-8-dri: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HHV-8-driven malignancy prevention. Fires on HHV-8 seropositivity in HIV+, transplant, or other immunocompromised host without confirmed Kaposi sarcoma / MCD / PEL. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending immune restoration (ART for HIV+; transplant-immunosuppression rebalance) + mucocutaneous + oral + GI / lymph-node surveillance. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-KAPOSI. MCD and PEL are HHV-8-driven but not yet authored as distinct Disease entities — covered via the prose surveillance rationale in the indication for now. Distinct from RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (existing) — that is HIV-as-RF; this is HHV-8-positivity-as-RF (the co-factor that turns HIV-related immunocompromise into Kaposi risk specifically).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV + HBV: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV + HBV coinfection cancer prevention. Higher severity (critical) than mono-infection HBV RF — coinfection carries documented accelerated-fibrosis + elevated HCC risk AND a hard constraint on antiviral selection (tenofovir-based ART mandatory; entecavir monotherapy contraindicated). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending tenofovir-based ART (covers both viruses simultaneously) + AASLD HCC surveillance q6mo. STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-HCC. HIV-driven AIDS-defining malignancies (Kaposi sarcoma via HHV-8 reactivation, NHL, cervical) are covered separately via RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION and RF-CHRONIC-HHV8-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION. Distinct from RF-CHRONIC-HBV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION and RF-CHRONIC-HIV-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (individual mono-infection RFs). When coinfection trigger fires, this RF takes precedence (higher priority) and the indication enforces tenofovir-based ART selection.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HIV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on positive HIV serology in patient without AIDS-defining or HIV-associated malignancy. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending durable ART suppression (per IND-CHRONIC-HIV-PREVENTION-ART) + cancer screening cadence (annual anal cytology in MSM/HIV+; q3-yearly cervical Pap in WLHIV; opportunistic Kaposi/oral hairy leukoplakia visual screening). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS as the canonical HIV-associated NHL. KS, cervical, anal, Hodgkin, HCC are also HIV-associated; covered via screening recommendations in the ART indication rationale rather than discrete Disease anchors (until DIS-KAPOSI etc. land in v0.2-A authoring backlog).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPRC. STU: Präventionspersona RedFlag für HPRC. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPV-assoc: Prevention-persona RedFlag for HPV-associated cancer prevention. Fires on persistent high-risk HPV positivity OR incomplete/absent vaccination in age-eligible individual. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending vaccination (Gardasil-9) and/or risk-group-appropriate screening cadence (cervical: USPSTF Pap+HPV co-test q5y ages 30-65; anal: HRA + cytology q1y in MSM/HIV+/post-transplant). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-CERVICAL and DIS-ANAL-SCC. Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and vulvar/vaginal/penile not yet in KB — v0.2-A authoring backlog.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for HTLV-1-dr: Präventionspersona RedFlag für die HTLV-1-getriebene ATLL-Prävention. Im Gegensatz zu HCV/HBV/h. pylori gibt es kein Kurativ-Regime – die Intervention ist Überwachung + Übertragungsprävention, nicht heilen. STUB bis Co-Lead-Review. Geographischer Kontext: HTLAV-1 endemische Regionen umfassen Japan (Südwesten), Karibikbecken, Teile von Subsahara-Afrika, Teile Südamerikas, Mittlerer Osten. Ukraine ist niedrig Prävalenz; diese RF ist relevanter für Diaspora-Patienten oder diejenigen mit Reisen/Herkunft aus endemischen Regionen.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for I-131 the: Prevention-persona RedFlag for I-131 therapeutic-dose lifetime cumulative exposure. Surveillance: CBC q12mo for leukemia signal (sensitivity modest); breast surveillance per general-population USPSTF unless additional risk factors; oral + salivary symptom awareness. Highest-impact preventive intervention is hydration + lemon-juice sialagogue during I-131 administration (reduces salivary gland uptake) — retrospectively non-actionable for prior exposure. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for MASLD/NAF: Prevention-persona RedFlag for MASLD/NAFLD HCC risk. Cirrhotic MASLD meets AASLD HCC-surveillance threshold (US ± AFP q6mo). Non-cirrhotic advanced fibrosis is a gray zone — closer hepatology follow-up but not yet routine surveillance. Major actionable lever: weight loss + cardiometabolic management. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for NF1 confi: Prevention-persona RedFlag for NF1 confirmed-carrier / clinical- diagnostic-criteria-met cohort. Multi-organ surveillance: pediatric ophthalmology q6-12mo to age 8 (optic glioma); whole-body MRI for MPNST surveillance + symptom-driven biopsy of growing/painful/ neurologically-symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas; women: annual mammography from age 30, MRI from age 30-50. STUB pending two-Co- Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for O. viverr: Prävention-Person RedFlag für O. viverrini-getriebene Cholangiokarzinom-Prävention. Brände auf jeder dokumentierten Expositionsgeschichte mit Bestätigungstests. Motorwege zu PräventionPlan empfehlen Praziquantel (wenn aktive Infektion) + lebenslange hepatobiliäre Überwachung (US + CA 19-9 q12mo ab 40 Jahren in stark exponierten Kohorten). STUB ausstehende Co-Lead-Review. Krebsumfang: verankert in DIS-CHOLANGIOCARCINOMA. Nordostthailand hat die weltweit höchste Cholangiokarzinominzidenz (bis zu 90 pro 100K) – die in endemischen Regionen zuzuordnende Fraktion übersteigt 50%. Geographischer Kontext: relevant für Mekong-Region Diaspora, Flüchtlinge, Reisende und Adoptivpersonen. Begleiter zu RF-CLONORCHIS-CHOLANGIO-PREVENTION (Ostasiatischer Leber-Fluke-Weg, biologisch ähnlicher Mechanismus).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for PALB2 het: Präventionspersona RedFlag für PALB2 heterozygote Träger. PALF2 nähert sich BRCA2 Brustkrebs-Penetranz und garantiert BRCA-artige Überwachung mit jährlicher MRT- und Mammographie ab 30 Jahren sowie Pankreasüberwachung (EUS oder MRT alternierend jährlich ab 50 Jahren oder 10 Jahre vor frühester PDAC-Familie) für FDR-of-PDAC-Träger pro CAPS-Konsortium 2022. RRSO-Diskussion verschoben auf BRCA -Stil Schwelle bei niedrigerer ovarieller Penetrance. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for PCOS-anov: Präventions-Persona RedFlag für PCOS-Anovulations-Endometrium-Risiko. Getrennt von der breiten reproduktiven RF für klarere Routing-PCOS-spezifische Beratung (Progestin-Restauration, Metformin, Gewichtsverlust) unterscheidet sich von generischen reproduktiv-historische Beratung. Symptom-getriebene Endometrium Biopsie bei jeder abnormen Blutung ≥ 6 Monate Amenorrhoe vor der Menopause ODER jede post-menopausale Blutung. STUB bis Zwei-Co- Blei Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for RAD51C/RA: Prevention-persona RedFlag for RAD51C/RAD51D heterozygous carriers. Approaches BRCA-level ovarian penetrance — NCCN endorses RRSO at completed childbearing or age 45-50. Breast surveillance: individualised by family history; consider annual MRI in additional- risk subset. Olaparib PARP inhibitor active in RAD51C/D-mutant established ovarian cancer (PROfound + GEN-ALL trials). STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for S. haemat: Prevention-persona RedFlag for S. haematobium-driven bladder SCC prevention. Fires on any documented exposure history with confirmatory testing. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending praziquantel (if active infection) + lifetime urinary surveillance (urinalysis q6-12mo, cytology + cystoscopy for any new hematuria). STUB pending Co-Lead review. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-UROTHELIAL. S. haematobium-driven bladder cancers are predominantly SCC histology (distinct from urothelial / transitional cell carcinoma that dominates Western cohorts) — engine surfaces this distinction in the prevention rationale prose. Geographic context: Ukraine is non-endemic; this RF is relevant for patients with diaspora / refugee / travel / origin history from sub-Saharan Africa, Egypt, Sudan, Yemen, parts of South America.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for SDH-defic: Präventionspersona RedFlag für SDH-Defizienzsyndrom. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Anerkennung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for active to: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für den aktiven Tabakkonsum. Höchste Wirkung modifizierbare Krebs-Risiko-Faktor-Intervention. Motorwege zur PräventionPlan Empfehlung strukturierter Einstellung Beratung + Pharmakotherapie + LDCT Lungenscreening, wenn USPSTF-zugelassen. STUB bis Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Anweisung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for anthracyc: Präventivpersona RedFlag für Anthracyclin kumulative Dosis ≥ 250 mg/m2. Kardio-Überwachungsfokus (HF/Kardiomyopathie); t-AML-Überwachung überlappt sich durch separate RF-IATROGENIC-TOPO2-TAML-PREVENTION. Echo q1-5y je nach Risikoprofil (ASCO/COG-LTFU-Kadenz). Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung von Ausgangs- + Serien-Echo + BNP. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for aromatic-: Prevention-persona RedFlag for aromatic-amines → urothelial bladder cancer prevention. Fires on documented occupational exposure. DIS-UROTHELIAL anchor preferred but using DIS-HCC as fallback if not in KB on this branch. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic E: Präventionspersona RedFlag für chronische ETS-Exposition (Haushalt / Arbeitsplatz ≥ 10y). IARC Gruppe 1 + US Chirurg Allgemeine bestätigt Ursache von Lungenkrebs bei Nichtrauchern. risk_category=occupatational is north enum match — Schema fehlt ein explizites "Umwelt" enrum. Motorwege zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung der Expositionsbeseitigung (Kohabitantrauchentwöhnung / Arbeitsplatzrauchfreie Politikdurchsetzung / persönliche Minderung) + USPSTF-Screening-Stichwortprüfung + symptomgetriggerte Bewertung. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Leitungs-Abmeldung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic P: Präventionspersona RedFlag für chronische PPI-Exposition ≥10y. Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan empfehlen (1) Indikations-Überprüfung + De-Verschreibung, bei denen der PPI nicht mehr benötigt wird (am häufigsten Szenario), (2) Fasten Gastrin + Chromogranin A in Kohorte mit persistenter Säure-Suppression Indikation, (3) EGD mit Körper/Fundus-Biopsien bei Patienten mit erhöhtem Gastrin oder Symptomen; Überwachung EGD q3-5y, wenn atrophische Gastritis oder ECL-Hyperplasie dokumentiert. Angekert an DIS-GASTRIC (Gastrisches NET und atrophische-Gastris-abgeleitetes Adenokarzinom beide Magen-Körper-Erkrankungen); NET-spezifische Ergebnisse in Indikation Prosa durchgeführt. STUB bis Zwei-Klinisch-Co-Leitung Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-Modus.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic a: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic anti-TNF biologic exposure ≥3y in pediatric / adolescent / young-adult IBD cohort. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) EBV serology baseline in young adults, (2) B-symptom + lymphadenopathy awareness, (3) annual skin examination (synergistic with concomitant thiopurine + UV), (4) periodic shared-decision discussion of combination- therapy step-down where IBD activity allows (anti-TNF monotherapy has favourable cancer signal vs combination with thiopurine), (5) vaccination catch-up (HPV, HBV, influenza, pneumococcal). Severity = minor — absolute attributable risk in anti-TNF monotherapy is small; the meaningful signal is the combination- with-thiopurine HSTCL warning specifically in pediatric / young- adult cohort, addressed via combination-step-down counseling. Anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS + DIS-HSTCL. STUB pending two-Clinical- Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic i: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic inorganic arsenic exposure via drinking water >10 µg/L (WHO + US EPA MCL). IARC Group 1 carcinogen with established urothelial, lung, and non-melanoma skin cancer etiology. Anchored to DIS-UROTHELIAL per task brief; lung + skin surfaced via relevant_diseases. risk_category=occupational is closest enum match. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending water source change / filtration + intensified screening for affected organs. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic o: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic occupational outdoor UV exposure ≥10y in high-UV-index latitudes. IARC Group 1 solar UV. Distinct from broader RF-LIFESTYLE-UV-EXPOSURE-PREVENTION (which covers tanning beds + sunburn history + recreational UV). Anchored to DIS-BCC per task brief (closest skin DIS to UV-NMSC). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending photoprotection counseling + clinical skin exam cadence + patient skin self-exam education + Vitamin D balance. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic p: Präventionspersona RedFlag für chronische Pankreatitis → PDAC. Erbliche Pankreatsitis birgt das höchste Risiko (~40-50% Lebensdauer). STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic r: Präventionspersona RedFlag für chronische Wohn PM2,5 >35 μg/m3 Jahresdurchschnitt (WHO 2021 IT-1). IARC Gruppe 1 Außenluftverschmutzung + PM. Bevölkerungszugehörige Fraktion bescheiden individuell, aber große absolute Belastung in Gebieten mit hoher Exposition einschließlich Industrie Ukraine + bei kriegsbedingten Brand-/Schrottereignissen. risk_category=occupational is the nearst enum match — schema fehlt ein explizites "Umwelt"-Enum (§20 Ratifizierung anhängig). Motorwege zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung der Expositionsreduktion + USPSTF-Lungenkrebs-Screeningfähigkeit + symptomauslösende Bewertung. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic ≥: Prevention-persona RedFlag for chronic ≥3y post-transplant immunosuppression cohort. Engine routes to PreventionPlan with long-cycle surveillance cadence appropriate to the chronic cohort (vs the acute-window EBV-DNA cadence in the new-transplant RF). Distinct from RF-IATROGENIC-TRANSPLANT-IMMUNOSUPPRESSION- PREVENTION (which covers acute / new-transplant window). Both RFs may fire simultaneously in the early-chronic window (1-3y post-transplant) — engine routes to both surveillance tracks, render layer deduplicates overlapping recommendations. Anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS as the primary lymphoma anchor (late- onset PTLD histology more DLBCL-like; DIS-PTLD as the canonical early-onset EBV-driven entity). Multiple cancer types listed in relevant_diseases reflect the broad cumulative-risk profile of the chronic cohort. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for combined: Präventionspersona RedFlag für kombinierte HRT-Exposition ≥5y. Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung (1) gemeinsamer Entscheidungsdiskussion über den Nutzen von Risiko (vasomotorische Symptome, Knochendichte-Konservierung vs. Brust-/VTE/kardiovaskuläre Risiken), (2) niedrigste wirksame Dosis + kürzeste Dauer-Prinzip pro NAMS/ACOG, (3) Brustüberwachung pro USPSTF-Kadenz — ergänzende Bildgebung nicht für HRT allein empfohlen (Densitätsbezogene Zusatzbildgebung ist eine separate Achse), (4) symptomatisierte Endometrium-Beobachtung workup (jede abnorme Blutung → TVUS + Biopsie) für Frauen auf sequentielle/zyklische kombiniert oder mit intakter Gebärmutter auf jeder HRT, (5) jährliche GYN-Prüfung. Distinct von RF-IATROGENIC-TAMOXIFEN-ENDOMETRIAL-PREVENTION (verschiedener Mechanismus: SERM mit partiellem endometrischen Agonismus). STUB bis Zwei-Klinisch-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-Modus.

Präventionspersona RedFlag für kombinierte geringe Calciumaufnahme + Vitamin D-Mangel. WCRF/AICR Wahrscheinlichkeits-Beweis für Kalzium und CRC; IARC gebündeltes Signal für Vitamin D Status. RCT-Evidenz für Supplementierung wird bei Populationsdosen gemischt — Beratung betont angemessene Aufnahme/Erschöpfung nicht pharmakologische Dosierung. Motorwege zur PräventionPlan Empfehlung Ernährungsberatung + Vitamin-D-Ergänzung + CRC-Screening pro USPSTF. STUB bis Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for cumulativ: Prevention-persona RedFlag for cumulative hormonal-contraception exposure ≥10y, iatrogenic-axis only (exposure-as-risk). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending HPV co-test on schedule per ASCCP / USPSTF, age-appropriate mammographic screening per USPSTF, attentive symptom history (breast lump, abnormal bleeding). Severity minor — absolute risk increment small, effect on breast cancer attenuates after stop. Distinct from RF-REPRODUCTIVE-OCP-LONG-TERM (balanced risk-benefit counseling, see §20 reproductive bucket). STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for endometri: Präventionspersona RedFlag für Endometriose-assoziiertes Ovarialkrebsrisiko. Es gibt kein Routine-Populationsscreening-Tool (CA-125 + TVUS nicht für allgemeine oder Endometriose-Screening pro NCCN/USPSTF empfohlen). Beratung: Symptombewusstsein; risikoreduzierende Salpingektomie bei vollendeter Gebärmutterschaft oder Hysterektomien bei gutartigen Indikationen; BSO für Personen mit zusätzlichen Risikofaktoren vorbehalten. STUB bis Zwei-Co- Lead Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for heavy alc: Präventionspersona RedFlag für den Einsatz von Schweralkohol. Motorwege zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung einer strukturierten Einstellungs-/Moderationsberatung + Pharmakotherapie + entsprechendes Krebsscreening (ösophageale Endoskopie für hochrisikoreiche Brustkrebsüberwachung für Frauen). STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Abmeldung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for high cumu: Präventionspersona RedFlag für hohe kumulative UV-Exposition. IARC Gruppe 1 Klassifikation für Sonnenliegen (2009). NCCN Melanom + AAD Richtlinien unterstützen UV-Schutzberatung + Haut-Selbsttest + klinische Hautuntersuchung Kadenz. Motorrouten zu PräventionPlan empfehlen Sonnenschutz + Hautüberwachung. STUB bis zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead Signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for high-pari: Präventionspersona RedFlag für hochparitätsgebärmutterhalsrisikoverstärker bei HPV-positiven Frauen. Beratung: Einhaltung des Zervixscreenings nach Alters- und Methodenschema USPSTF/WHO; Aufholimpfung im Alter von 45 Jahren pro ACIP-Freiwilligkeit; Raucherabbruch (synergistisches Risiko). STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for in-utero: Prevention-persona RedFlag for in-utero DES exposure. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending annual gynecologic exam with speculum + bimanual + careful palpation of vaginal walls (specific technique for DES daughters per ACOG), colposcopy with vaginal + cervical staining for early detection of CCA, cervical cytology / HPV co-test on routine cadence, breast surveillance per age- appropriate USPSTF cadence. Cohort is aging — bimodal-risk window extends past 40y; surveillance does NOT stop at any age cutoff. Cancer scope: anchored to DIS-VULVAR-VAGINAL-SCC (closest existing Disease entity for vaginal-tract anchor) + DIS-CERVICAL. DES- associated cancer is histologically clear-cell adenocarcinoma — NOT yet authored as a distinct DIS-VAGINAL-CLEAR-CELL entity; histology-specific surveillance considerations carried via the indication prose. Future authoring of DIS-VAGINAL-CLEAR-CELL recommended. Distinct from RF-IATROGENIC-LONG-TERM-HRMNL-CONTRACEPTION- PREVENTION (post-natal hormonal exposure, exposure-as-cofactor). This is a one-time in-utero developmental exposure — surveillance cohort is closed (no new DES daughters); known existing cohort remains at lifelong elevated risk.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for late-firs: Prevention-persona RedFlag for late-first-pregnancy + short-breastfeeding combination. Modest individual effect sizes; cumulative effect non-trivial. Cannot retroactively modify primary trigger (timing of reproductive events) — counseling is forward-looking (encourage breastfeeding when feasible in subsequent pregnancies) + tightened breast cancer screening. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for long-term: Präventionspersona RedFlag für die langfristige kombinierte OCP-Anwendung ≥10y. Mischkrebsprofil — bescheidene Risikosteigerung (Brust, Hals-mit-HPV) UND substantieller Schutz (Ovarial, Endometrium). Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan Empfehlung der COUNSELING-BALANCE-Indikation, nicht unidirektionale Risikowarnung. Kritisch, dass Schicht stellen volle Risiko-Nutzen-Panel. STUB bis zwei-Klinisch-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-Modus.

Präventionspersona RedFlag für Langzeit-Tiefdosis-MTX-Exposition (RA, Psoriasis, IBD). Überwachung: Niedrige Schwellen-Workup für ungeklärte Lymphadenopathie, B-Symptome, Organomegalie, Masse — MTX-Entzug + 8-12 Wochen vorher beobachten (~50% Regression); persistent → DLBCL-Stil-WorkUp. Hautuntersuchung jährlich. STUB bis Zwei-Co-Lead-Auszeichnung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-Modus.

Prevention-persona RedFlag for long-term ≥3y thiopurine (azathioprine / 6-MP) exposure. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) annual whole-body skin exam by dermatologist + aggressive sun-protection counseling, (2) EBV serology baseline check in young adults pre-initiation (avoid initiation in EBV-seronegative young men per ECCO 2019), (3) annual B-symptom + lymphadenopathy review, (4) shared-decision discussion of indication continuation vs alternatives (MTX for RA, biologics for IBD) at year 5, (5) HPV vaccination catch-up where applicable. Anchored to DIS-DLBCL-NOS (lymphoma) + DIS-BCC (closest skin-cancer anchor for SCC and BCC). STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.

Prevention-persona RedFlag for long-term ≥5y calcineurin-inhibitor exposure (cyclosporine or tacrolimus). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending (1) annual or q6mo whole-body skin exam by dermatologist (q6mo if any prior skin cancer), (2) aggressive sun-protection counseling, (3) HHV-8 awareness in endemic cohorts + KS surveillance (skin, oral, GI), (4) HPV vaccination catch-up if transplant context, (5) shared-decision discussion with transplant team of switch to mTOR inhibitor (sirolimus / everolimus) in patients with cumulative skin- cancer burden — CONVERT + ProSparc evidence: mTOR-switch reduces new SCC. Anchored to DIS-KAPOSI + DIS-BCC. Distinct from broader RF-IATROGENIC-TRANSPLANT-IMMUNOSUPPRESSION-* RFs by drug-class specificity — applies also to non-transplant calcineurin-inhibitor users (psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, nephrotic syndrome). STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for low Medit: Prevention-persona RedFlag für niedrige Mediterranean-Diät-Hypothese. Populations-Level diätetische-Muster Hebel – unterscheidet sich von ein-nährstoffigen RFs (Faser, Kalzium, rotes Fleisch). PREDMED RCT (2013 primärer Endpunkt Herz-Kreislauf; 2015 sekundäre CRC-Analyse) + EPIC + NHS Beobachtungssignal. Ankert an DIS-CRC, weil Musterkrebs Evidenz am stärksten ist dort; Multi-Krebs Nutzen in rationale gerahmt. Motorrouten zur PräventionPlanen Sie Ernährungs-Musterberatung + USPSTF-Kadenz-Screening pro Anker. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Abmeldung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for low dieta: Prevention-persona RedFlag for low dietary fibre intake (<15 g/day). WCRF/AICR convincing-evidence rating for CRC. Effect size modest individually but population-attributable fraction non-trivial (low fibre intake is endemic in Western diets). Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending dietary counseling + USPSTF-cadence CRC screening. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for obesity (: Präventionspersona RedFlag für Adipositas (BMI ≥30). Engine-Routen zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung strukturierter Gewichtverlustintervention + bariatrische Chirurgiediskussion in der Klasse 2/3 Adisparität + Krebsscreening pro BMI-erhöhtes Risikoprofil. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for prior alk: Präventivpersona RedFlag für vorherige Alkylator-Chemotherapie-Exposition. Mediane t-AML Latenz 5-7y nach der Exposition; kumulative Inzidenz ~1-10% bei 10y. Motorwege zur PräventionPlan Empfehlung CBC q3-6mo für erste 10y post-chemo + niedrige Schwelle für die Markanalyse, wenn Zytopenien auftreten. STUB bis zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for prior the: Prävention-Person RedFlag für vorherige therapeutische Strahlung. Kindheit Krebs Überlebende Studie + LATE-Konsortium Dokument erhöhte zweiten primären malignen Risiko Jahrzehnte nach der RT. STUB bis zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for prior top: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für vorherige Topoisomerase-II-Inhibitor-Exposition. Unterscheidung von Alkylator t-AML: kürzere Latenz (2-3y vs 5-7y), charakteristische 11q23/21q22 zytogenetische, oft APL-ähnliche t(15;17). Motorwege zur PräventionPlan Empfehlung CBC q3mo für erste 5y nach Chemo + niedrige Schwelle für die Mark-Bewertung. STUB bis Zwei-Klinik-Co-Lead-Signoff pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode. Anmerkung: Die Anthracyclin-Exposition feuert auch RF-IATROGENIC-ANTHRACYCLINE-CARDIO-PREVENTION (separate Cardio + t-AML-Überwachungsüberlappung).
Prevention-persona RedFlag for processed: Prevention-persona RedFlag for processed-meat consumption ≥50g/day. WCRF/AICR convincing evidence + IARC Group 1 classification for CRC. Effect size modest individually but population-attributable fraction non-trivial. Engine routes to PreventionPlan recommending dietary counseling + CRC screening per USPSTF. STUB pending two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for refractor: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für feuerfesten Zöliakie → EATL-Prävention. Feuer auf persistente villöse Atrophie / Aberrant IEL-Klonalität / RCD2-Features. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinisch-Co-Lead-Anweisung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for reproduct: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für Risikofaktoren der Fortpflanzungsgeschichte. Wirkungsgrößen sind bescheiden individuell, aber kumulativ signifikant. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for salt/pick: Prevention-persona RedFlag for salt/pickle-heavy diet. Counseling: reduce to WHO <5 g/day; co-test for H. pylori in high-intake + high-prevalence settings (Eastern Europe, East Asia); diet-quality intervention (Mediterranean / DASH patterns) provides additional cardiovascular benefit. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for sedentary: Präventionspersona RedFlag für sitzenden Lebensstil / geringe körperliche Aktivität. WCRF/AICR überzeugende Beweisbewertung für SFB + Endometrium + postmenopausaler Brustkrebsschutz. Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan zur Empfehlung einer strukturierten Körperaktivitätsberatung nach HHS + ACS-Richtlinien. STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Leitungs-Abmeldung nach CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for smokeless: Prevention-persona RedFlag for smokeless tobacco. Most modifiable cancer exposure in users; cessation pharmacotherapy (nicotine replacement, varenicline) is effective. Oral examination at every encounter; biopsy any leukoplakia/erythroplakia >2 weeks; visual inspection with toluidine blue or autofluorescence in high-burden settings. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for sugar-swe: Präventionspersona RedFlag für zuckergesüßtes Getränk gewohnheitsmäßig. Beratung: Ersatzwasser/ungesüßte Getränke; Abbau bei abrupter Absetzen allmählich schwierig; Bewertung für Beitrag zur Gewichtszunahme + glykämische Dysregulation. Bescheidenste individuelle RR aber sehr häufige Exposition → große absolute populationszuverlässige Fraktion. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Leitungs-Auszeichnung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for tamoxifen: Präventivpersona RedFlag für Tamoxifen-Exposition ≥5y bei Frauen mit intakter Gebärmutter. ~2-7-fachen endometrisches Krebsrisiko. Motorrouten zur PräventionPlan empfehlen symptom-prompte Auswertung (postmenopausale Blutung → sofortiges Aufarbeiten mit TVUS + endemetrische Biopsie). Routine-asymptomatisches TVUS-Screening NICHT empfohlen per ACOG (false-positive aus Tamoxipen-bedingten subepithelialen Veränderungen). STUB bis zur Zwei-Klinik-Co-Leitungs-Signierung per CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for transplan: Prävention-Persona RedFlag für Transplantatimmunsuppression. Motorwege zur PräventionPlanen Sie mit intensiver Überwachung + reduzieren Sie die Immunsupprimierung Diskussion + gezieltes Screening. STUB.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for type-2 di: Präventionspersona RedFlag für Typ-2-Diabetes mellitus als multiorgan-mäßiger Krebsrisikoverstärker. Neu eingestelltes T2DM ≥ 50 mit Gewichtsverlust hat ~1% absolutes 3-Jahres-Risiko für Bauchspeicheldrüsenkrebs – ein reaktionsfähiges Überwachungssignal (EUS oder MR-Pankreas in Hochrisiko-Subset pro ACG 2022). Andere Krebs-Risiko-Beiträge sind Hintergrund und ändern die Bindung an die Populations-Screening-Anbindung anstatt Auslösung von Off-Schedule-Bildgebung. STUB bis zur Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung pro CHARTER §6.1 dev-mode.
Prevention-persona RedFlag for very hot: Präventionspersona RedFlag für sehr heißer Getränkekonsum ≥ 65°C. IARC Group 2A Klassifikation (2016). Primary IO resistance is operationally d: Primary IO resistance is operationally distinct from acquired resistance (PD after initial response >6 months). SITC consensus (Kluger 2020) defines primary resistance as PD within 6 months of IO start. Subsequent options vary by tumor: melanoma — BRAF/MEKi if V600E, T-VEC, TIL therapy at trial centers, IL-2; NSCLC — docetaxel ± ramucirumab, ADC if HER2/TROP2; urothelial — enfortumab vedotin + pembrolizumab combination remains active even after IO-mono PD per EV-302; RCC — cabozantinib monotherapy or lenvatinib + everolimus. IO-rechallenge is generally not standard but may be considered after >6 months treatment-free + non-PD discontinuation reason.

The strongest hematologic-cancer risk factor among rheumatic diseases — ~15-20x relative risk for marginal zone (MALT) lymphoma, predominantly arising in parotid and lacrimal glands, with lifetime incidence ~5-10%. Risk concentrated in patients with persistent parotid swelling, palpable purpura, cryoglobulinemia, low C4 complement, monoclonal gammopathy, lymph- node enlargement, or high EULAR Sjögren's Disease Activity Index (ESSDAI). Beinhaltet die PSC-IBD-Untergruppe (sehr hohes Risiko für CRC und Cholangiokarzinom) und PSC mit dominanter Gallenstriktur (zusätzliches Cholangikarzinomarisiko, das eine gezielte diagnostische Untersuchung erfordert). Kein aktuelles Cholangiokarzinom, Gallenblase Krebs, oder HCC-Diagnose. PSC ist der stärkste bekannte Risikofaktor für Cholangikarzinome — Lebensrisiko ~10-15% (vs ~0.01% in der allgemeinen Bevölkerung); jährliche Inzidenz ~0.5-1,5% pro Jahr. Gallenblase-Krebs-Risiko auch erhöht ~10-fach. Zirrhotische PSC fügt HCC Risiko in der Allgemeinen Zirhose Muster. Prodrug hydrolyzed by carboxylesterases: Prodrug hydrolyzed by carboxylesterases to active metabolite SN-38 (~100-1000× more potent than parent). SN-38 stabilizes the topoisomerase-I/DNA cleavable complex, producing single-strand DNA breaks that become lethal double-strand breaks during S-phase replication. SN-38 is glucuronidated by UGT1A1 to inactive SN-38G; patients homozygous for UGT1A1*28 (Gilbert-syndrome variant) or *6 have impaired clearance and severe neutropenia + diarrhea risk — CPIC and FDA label both recommend testing before high-dose use.
Prodrug requiring hepatic CYP3A4 / CYP2B: Prodrug requiring hepatic CYP3A4 / CYP2B6 activation to 4-hydroxy- ifosfamide, which decomposes to ifosforamide mustard — the active DNA- alkylating species producing N7-guanine inter-strand crosslinks and apoptosis in proliferating cells. Side-chain oxidation also generates acrolein (urotoxic — drives hemorrhagic cystitis, neutralized by mesna) and chloroacetaldehyde (the principal neurotoxic metabolite responsible for ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy).
Prodrug that is acid-activated in the pa: Prodrug, das in der parietalen Zellsekretion zu einem Sulfenamid-Kationen säureaktiviert ist, welches eine kovalente Disulfidbindung mit Cysteinrückständen der H+/K+-ATPase (Protonpumpe) bildet und irreversibel die Magensäuresekretation hemmt. Für die Erholung ist eine neue Pumpensynthese erforderlich (≥24 h Halbwertszeit trotz ~1 h Plasmahalbwertszeit). Krebspräventionsrelevanz: Für H ist eine tiefgreifende Magensäuresuppression erforderlich. Provides supplemental elemental calcium: Provides supplemental elemental calcium (~40% by mass of calcium carbonate). Absorbed in proximal small bowel via active vitamin-D- dependent transcellular transport (saturable at low calcium intake) and passive paracellular diffusion (linear with concentration). Cancer-prevention rationale: intraluminal calcium binds free bile acids and free fatty acids in the colon, reducing their proliferative and pro-inflammatory effect on colonic mucosa; additionally calcium modulates epithelial cell proliferation/differentiation via the calcium-sensing receptor. Calcium Polyp Prevention Study (Baron NEJM 1999) and follow-on trials: 1200 mg/day elemental calcium reduced metachronous adenoma recurrence by ~15-20%.

Pyrimidine analog. Intracellularly conve: Pyrimidine analog. Intracellularly converted to FdUMP, FdUTP, and FUTP. FdUMP forms a stable ternary complex with thymidylate synthase (TS) + reduced folate (leucovorin), depleting dTMP and blocking DNA synthesis. FUTP misincorporation into RNA disrupts pre-mRNA processing; FdUTP misincorporation into DNA produces strand breaks. Backbone of FOLFOX, FOLFIRI, FOLFIRINOX, FLOT, and capecitabine-bridged regimens. Bolus and continuous-infusion (CIV) schedules differ in toxicity profile (more myelosuppression with bolus, more mucositis/HFS with CIV).

Pyrimidine nucleoside analog of deoxycyt: Pyrimidine nucleoside analog of deoxycytidine. Phosphorylated by deoxycytidine kinase (rate-limiting) to active metabolites gemcitabine diphosphate (dFdCDP) and triphosphate (dFdCTP). dFdCDP inhibits ribonucleotide reductase, depleting deoxynucleotide pools required for DNA synthesis (self-potentiation effect — increases cellular dFdCTP). dFdCTP is incorporated into DNA, after which one additional natural nucleotide is added before DNA polymerase stalls — "masked chain termination" — making the lesion resistant to exonucleolytic repair. Cell cycle phase-specific (S phase) with G1/S blockade. PDAC backbone (gem-nab-pac MPACT, gem mono in frail), biliary tract cancers, NSCLC, bladder, NK/T-nasal lymphoma (SMILE), Hodgkin / DLBCL salvage (GDP).

Die kombinierte Hemmung stört sowohl die Thymidylat- als auch die Purin-De-Novo-Synthese, hält die DNA/RNA-Produktion ab und produziert S-Phasen-spezifische Zytotoxizität. Quantitative HBV DNA tracks response during nucleos(t)ide-analogue (NA) therapy with entecavir (ETV) or tenofovir alafenamide/disoproxil (TAF/TDF). Effective suppression (HBV DNA <2,000 IU/mL, ideally undetectable) is the primary virologic response endpoint per AASLD HBV 2024 and EASL HBV 2025. Sustained suppression reduces HCC incidence by ~50-70% in CHB cirrhotics (REVEAL-HBV cohort; Wong 2013 meta-analysis). Primary non-response or viral breakthrough (≥1-log rise on therapy) prompts adherence review, resistance testing, and regimen change (rare with ETV/TAF/TDF — high genetic barrier). ESCAT IIIA — biomarker directs antiviral continuation/switch decisions and is the primary HCC-prevention lever in chronic HBV.
Quantitative HBV DNA used to TRACK viral: Quantitative HBV DNA used to TRACK viral suppression over time during chronic-HBV antiviral therapy (entecavir or tenofovir TDF/TAF — first- line nucleos(t)ide analogues per AASLD 2024 / EASL 2025). Distinct from BIO-HBV-STATUS (serology-based screening / treatment-decision gate). Two clinical contexts: (1) Treatment monitoring in HBeAg+/HBeAg− chronic HBV: baseline HBV DNA + ALT + HBeAg + HBsAg → start NA → recheck q3 months for first year, then q6 months. Goal: HBV DNA undetectable on treatment; ALT normalization; HBeAg seroconversion (HBeAg+ patients) or HBsAg loss (functional cure — rare on NA monotherapy, ~1% per year). Virologic breakthrough (≥1-log rise from nadir) prompts adherence review then switch (entecavir → tenofovir if NA-naïve resistance). (2) Prophylaxis monitoring during B-cell-depleting therapy (rituximab, obinutuzumab) or anti-CD38 (daratumumab, isatuximab) in HBsAg+ or anti-HBc+ patients: entecavir prophylaxis baseline → HBV DNA q3 months during chemotherapy and for 12+ months post-treatment; any detectable HBV DNA = reactivation, hepatology consult. R140Q is the dominant IDH2 hotspot in AM: R140Q is the dominant IDH2 hotspot in AML (~70-80% of IDH2-mut AML; ~6-8% of all AML). Enasidenib (IDHIFA, AG-221) FDA-approved Aug 2017 for R/R-AML-IDH2 monotherapy (phase 1/2: ORR 38%, CR 19%). 1L combination with azacitidine in unfit patients (AG221-AML-005: ORR 71%). Differentiation syndrome (~14%) — same monitoring + dexamethasone protocol as ivosidenib. Hyperbilirubinemia (~80% any grade; UGT1A1 inhibition — usually asymptomatic, no dose adjustment unless symptomatic). IDHENTIFY R/R AML phase-3 did not show OS benefit vs conventional care over all comers but enriched in IDH2-mut who had not received prior HMA. Combination with venetoclax + azacitidine under study. Triggers RF-AML-IDH2-MUT-ACTIONABLE (existing) for algorithm routing.
R172K is the second IDH2 hotspot in AML: R172K is the second IDH2 hotspot in AML (~20-30% of IDH2-mut AML; ~2-3% of all AML).
