R175H is the most common TP53 missense h: R175H is the most common TP53 missense hotspot across all human cancers (~5-7% of TP53-mutant tumors per IARC TP53 Database). Structural class mutant — the R175 substitution to histidine disrupts the DNA-binding domain fold (zinc-coordination region). Beyond loss-of-function (LoF), R175H is a canonical example of mutant-p53 GAIN-OF-FUNCTION (GOF): the mutant protein acquires pro-oncogenic activities (chemoresistance via NF-kB, increased migration/invasion, metabolic reprogramming, chronic inflammation). Clinical implication: R175H+ tumors generally have worse chemo response than TP53-WT or even other TP53-mut tumors. In AML: TP53-mut (any) including R175H → very poor outcomes with intensive chemo, route to alloSCT or venetoclax-azacitidine + clinical trials. In MM: routes to quadruplet per high-risk cytogenetics composite. Emerging GOF-targeting strategies (eprenetapopt/APR-246, arsenic trioxide for structural mutants) are largely investigational; R175H specifically among the reactivatable structural mutants.
R248 is one of the six most-mutated codo: R248 is one of the six most-mutated codons in TP53 (along with R175, G245, R249, R273, R282). DNA-contact class: R248 sits in the L3 loop and makes direct base-specific contact with the DNA minor groove. Substitution to glutamine (R248Q) abolishes sequence-specific DNA binding while preserving overall fold (distinguishing it from structural R175H). R248Q has well-documented gain-of-function (GOF) activities in mouse models — accelerates tumorigenesis and metastasis beyond simple p53-null. Clinical implications mirror other TP53 hotspots: in AML/MDS routes away from intensive chemo toward venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT; in CLL/MCL/MM contraindicates chemoimmuno or routes to high-risk-cytogenetics regimens. Distinction from R248W (different substitution, also a hotspot) — R248Q tends to retain partial folding while R248W more disruptive; both are pathogenic.
R273 is among the top three most-mutated: R273 is among the top three most-mutated TP53 codons (with R175 and R248). DNA-contact class: R273 directly contacts the DNA major groove via its guanidinium side chain. R→H substitution preserves the thermal stability of the protein fold (distinguishing it from structural R175H) but eliminates specific DNA binding. R273H is one of the best-characterized GOF p53 mutants — promotes chemoresistance via NF-κB activation, drives invasion/metastasis through CXCR4 and RhoA pathways, reprograms metabolism (mevalonate pathway upregulation). Clinical implications mirror the TP53-mutant class: AML/MDS — venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT consideration; CLL/MCL — contraindicates chemoimmuno; MM — high-risk cytogenetics composite routes to quadruplet. Notably, R273H tumors are particularly resistant to platinum chemotherapy across solid-tumor types per multiple correlative analyses — relevant for ovarian, lung, esophageal cancer treatment selection.
R282 is the sixth most-mutated TP53 codo: R282 is the sixth most-mutated TP53 codon, often grouped with R248 and R273 as the canonical hotspot ring. Hybrid structural/contact mutant: R282 stabilizes the L1/S3 loop region adjacent to the DNA-binding surface, and R→W partially destabilizes the fold while altering contact geometry. Functional studies show R282W retains partial transactivation activity on a subset of canonical p53 targets (CDKN1A/p21, BBC3/PUMA at reduced levels) — termed "partial LoF" — while still gaining oncogenic activities. Clinically R282W behaves similarly to other hotspots: in AML/MDS poor chemo response → routes to venetoclax-azacitidine + alloSCT consideration; in CLL/MCL/MM high-risk regimen routing. Distinction from full LoF mutants (truncating, splice-site) may matter for emerging mutant-p53 reactivator drugs (eprenetapopt) where residual fold is required — R282W generally considered reactivatable in early-phase trials.

RB1 biallelic loss, together with TP53 loss, is the molecular hallmark of SCLC (~95% of cases have both). RB1 loss is not used to select therapy in SCLC (all SCLC patients receive the same backbone: EP/EC ± atezolizumab/durvalumab); rather, it is a diagnostic characteristic and potential therapeutic vulnerability. RB1 loss renders cells dependent on alternative cell cycle regulators (CDK4/6-independent E2F activation) — this is why CDK4/6 inhibitors have no activity in SCLC (pRb loss negates CDK4/6 inhibition). Investigational targeting of RB1-deficient SCLC: aurora kinase A inhibitors (alisertib — phase II, limited activity); EZH2 inhibitors (tazemetostat — RB1-null tumors may have heightened EZH2 dependence); LSD1 inhibitors; ATR/CHK1 inhibitors (replication stress in RB1-null context). ESCAT IIIB: RB1 loss is diagnostically informative and a conceptual therapeutic target, but no FDA-approved targeted therapy exploiting RB1 deficiency as of 2026.
RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma protein (: RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), the master G1/S checkpoint regulator. pRb normally sequesters E2F transcription factors to prevent S-phase entry; loss of pRb → uncontrolled cell cycle progression. Clinical contexts: (1) Hereditary retinoblastoma: germline RB1 mutation → bilateral/multifocal retinoblastoma in childhood; lifetime elevated risk of osteosarcoma, SCLC, melanoma. (2) SCLC: biallelic RB1 loss + TP53 mutation defines the SCLC molecular signature (~95% of SCLC). pRb loss by IHC is used in pathologic diagnosis. No targeted therapy for RB1 deficiency per se; SCLC treatment is chemotherapy (EP/EC) ± atezolizumab. (3) Urothelial carcinoma: RB1 alterations in ~30% of muscle-invasive bladder cancer; associated with basal/squamous subtype; not currently targeted. (4) Breast cancer: RB1 mutations occur in ~10% of TNBC; RB1 loss predicts resistance to CDK4/6 inhibitors (palbociclib, ribociclib, abemaciclib) — pRb is the substrate for CDK4/6 that drives cell cycle entry; without pRb, CDK4/6 inhibition is ineffective. RET-targeted therapy is typically multi-: RET-targeted therapy is typically multi-year (median PFS >25 mo on selpercatinib in LIBRETTO-001) — chronic exposure raises HBV reactivation risk meaningfully even in HBsAg-negative / anti-HBc+ patients. Standard practice: HBsAg + anti-HBc + anti-HBs serology pre- TKI; entecavir / tenofovir for HBsAg+. HIV+: selpercatinib / pralsetinib / cabozantinib are CYP3A4 substrates — coordinate ART to avoid CYP3A4 inhibitors (ritonavir-boosted PIs) which raise TKI exposure 2-3 fold. Active TB: rifampin (CYP3A4 inducer) lowers TKI exposure significantly — prefer rifabutin if anti-TB needed.

Rd continuous (lenalidomide + low-dose d: Rd continuous (lenalidomide + low-dose dexamethasone until progression) was the MAIA control arm (Facon NEJM 2019, PMID 30926586) and represents the standard-access first-line regimen for transplant-ineligible NDMM. MAIA control arm outcomes: ORR 75.8%, PFS HR (D-Rd vs Rd) 0.56 (95% CI 0.43–0.73), 30-month PFS ~53.3% for D-Rd vs ~37.8% for Rd. Rd continuous showed superiority over MPT and melphalan-prednisone in the FIRST trial (Benboubker NEJM 2014, PMID 25184863): PFS 26 months vs 21.9 months for MPT. Dose of dexamethasone: low-dose (40 mg weekly = "Ld schedule") is preferred over high-dose (480 mg/cycle); ECOG E4A03 showed equivalent efficacy and better tolerability with low-dose dex in NDMM (Rajkumar LANCET ONCOL 2010). Renal adjustment is critical: lenalidomide is ~80% renally cleared. CrCl 30-60 → 10 mg daily; CrCl <30 → 5 mg daily or 10 mg qod. Myeloma renal impairment often improves with therapy — recheck CrCl monthly and escalate dose when GFR recovers. Second primary malignancy (SPM) risk: CALGB 100104 and IFM 2005-02 documented elevated SPM (MDS/AML) with lenalidomide maintenance post-ASCT; risk applies to continuous Rd as well at smaller magnitude. Recombinant non-infectious nine-valent H: Recombinant non-infectious nine-valent HPV vaccine. Der regelmäßige Verzehr von Maté (Ilex paraguariensis Infusion) wird bei sehr hohen Temperaturen zubereitet und getrunken (≥ 65°C / ≥ 149°F) — charakteristisch für die traditionelle Kürbis- und Bombilla-Zubereitung in Südsüdamerika (Argentinien, Brasilien, Paraguay, Uruguay, Südchile) und Diaspora-Gemeinschaften. IARC Monograph 116 (2016) klassifizierte das Trinken sehr heißer Getränke über 65°C als Gruppe 2A (wahrscheinlich krebserregend) — begrenzte Hinweise beim Menschen (konsistente Assoziationen mit Esophageal-Quama-Zellkarzinomen bei Maté-Trink-, Hot-Tee- und Hot-Kaffee-Kohorten, mit Restkonfounding aus Tabak/Alkohol-Ko-Exposition nicht vollständig ausgeschlossen), ausreichende Hinweise bei Versuchstieren (thermische Verletzung → chronische Entzündung → Feldkarzinogenese in Nagetier-Esophagus-Modellen). Wichtig: bei Temperaturen < 60°C wird keine Assoziation beobachtet; Maté per se (das Kraut / seine Phytochemikalien) wird NICHT als Karzinom eingestuft...

IARC Gruppe 2A (wahrscheinlich karzinogen) Einstufung — verbunden mit einem Esopha-Plattenzellkarzinom (ESCC), insbesondere in Regionen mit hohem ESC-Hintergrundinzidenz. Mechanismus: thermische Verletzung des Speiseröhrenepithels → chronische Entzündung → Feldkarzinogenese. Hinweis: bei typischen westlichen Kaffee/Tee-Temperaturen (< 60°C), keine Assoziation beobachtet; Kaffee + Tee an sich sind nicht krebserregend. Präventionspersona RedFlag (§20 v0.3 Lifestyle Pilot).

Regular processed-meat consumption ≥50 g: Regular processed-meat consumption ≥50 g/day per WCRF/IARC threshold. IARC Monograph 114 (2015) classified processed meat as Group 1 carcinogen for colorectal cancer (sufficient evidence). Each 50 g/day of processed meat increases CRC risk by ~18% (meta-analyzed RR ~1.18; WCRF/AICR convincing-evidence rating). Processed meat = sausages, ham, bacon, salami, cured/smoked/salted/preserved meat. Red meat (Group 2A per IARC, probable carcinogen) is a separate but overlapping concern — threshold ≥500 g/week for red meat. Mechanisms: N-nitroso compounds, heterocyclic amines, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, heme iron. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 v0.3 lifestyle pilot).

Reversible non-steroidal inhibitor of cy: Reversible non-steroidal inhibitor of cytochrome P450 aromatase (CYP19A1), reducing peripheral conversion of androgens to estrogens (estradiol, estrone). In postmenopausal women aromatase activity in adipose, breast, and other peripheral tissue is the dominant estrogen source — anastrozole 1 mg/day suppresses circulating estradiol by ~80-95%. Revumenib (SNDX-5613), an oral menin inhibitor, is FDA-approved (Nov 2024) for relapsed/refractory KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia (AML and ALL). AUGMENT-101 (Issa et al. NEJM 2023; Erba et al. ASH 2023 update): KMT2A-rearranged R/R AML/ALL — ORR 23% (CR + CRh + CRi), complete remission with full recovery 18%; mOS 8.0 mo. FDA accelerated approval based on remission rate as surrogate endpoint. KMT2A rearrangement is present in ~10% of adult AML (more common in secondary/therapy-related AML and infant leukemia). Menin is an essential co-factor of KMT2A-fusion oncoproteins — revumenib disrupts menin-MLL interaction, restoring differentiation block. Combination strategies under evaluation: revumenib + venetoclax + azacitidine (phase II ongoing). ELN 2022 risk: KMT2A-rearranged AML classified as intermediate risk (specific partner-dependent — MLLT3 intermediate; others may be adverse).

Revumenib (Menin-Inhibitor) FDA-zugelassen (Nov 2024) für rezidivierte/refraktäre KMT2A-umgeordnete akute Leukämie einschließlich B-ALL. AUGMENT-101 kombinierte KMT2-A-rearrangierte Kohorte (AML + ALL): ORR 23%, CR/CRh 18%. KMT2, eine Neuordnung definiert eine hochrisikoreiche B-AL-Untergruppe: bei Säuglingen ist KMT 2A-AFF1 bei ~80% des Säuglings B-ALE (EFS < 30% mit Standardchemotherapie) vorhanden; bei Erwachsenen ist KMM2A -rearranded B-All sympathismatisch (NCCN/ELN). Revumenib stellt eine erste gezielte Option für diese historisch chemotherapeutisch-refraktäre Population dar. Blinatumomab (CD19 BiTE, FDA-genehmigt für R/R B-ALL) und inotuzumab ozogamicin sind auch in KMT2A-geordneten B-AL unabhängig vom KMT2-A-Status aktiv, aber Revumeniib ist der erste mutationsspezifische zugelassene Wirkstoff. AlloHCT in CR bleibt die Standardkonsolidierung für förderungsberechtigte Erwachsene.

Ruxolitinib cream (Opzelura) received FD: Ruxolitinib cream (Opzelura) received FDA approval (September 2022) for mild-to-moderate atopic dermatitis; separately, ruxolitinib phosphate (Jakafi, oral) is FDA-approved for steroid-refractory acute/chronic GVHD but NOT specifically approved for CTCL as of 2026. However, the JAK/STAT pathway is aberrantly activated in MF/SS (~30–50% have JAK3 mutations or JAK1/STAT3/STAT5 alterations), making JAK inhibitors an active investigational area. Phase II evidence: ruxolitinib (oral) ORR ~29% in relapsed/refractory MF (RUXO-MF pilot data); itacitinib (JAK1 inhibitor) and cerdulatinib (JAK/SYK inhibitor) in phase II trials for CTCL. The CTCL-specific approvals are for non-JAK-targeted agents: romidepsin (HDAC inhibitor; FDA 2009 CTCL), brentuximab vedotin (CD30+; FDA 2017), mogamulizumab (CCR4; FDA 2018), vorinostat (FDA 2006). JAK3-mutant CTCL: JAK3 mutation identifies a subset with stronger a priori rationale for JAK inhibitor use; ESCAT IIA reflects absence of dedicated FDA approval in CTCL despite biological rationale and early phase data.

SMARCB1 (INI1/hSNF5/BAF47) is a core sub: SMARCB1 (INI1/hSNF5/BAF47) ist eine Kernuntereinheit des SWI/SNF Chromatin-Remodellierungskomplexes. Biallelic Inaktivierung entfernt SWI / SNF-Antagonismus von EZH2 (PRC2-Komplex), was zu H3K27me3 Akkumulation und epigenetische Silenzierung von Tumorsuppressoren-Genen führt. Dies macht SMARCB1-defiziente Tumoren selektiv empfindlich auf EZ H2-Hemmung. SMARCb1-Verlust definiert drei Haupttumortypen: (1) Epithelioidsarkom — Tazemetostat FDA-zugelassen (2020; EZh-202-Studie). (2) Maligner Rhabdoidtumor (MRT, AT/RT im ZNS) — extrem aggressiv; keine zugelassene gezielte Therapie; EZH2-Inhibitoren in der Untersuchung. (3) SMARCB1-defizientes Akknom, sinonasales Karzinom — selten. IHC für INI1 (nuklearer Verlust) ist die Begleitdiagnostik für Tazemetostat im Epithelsarkom und ist einfacher als molekulare Tests. SMO (Smoothened) is a G-protein-coupled: SMO (Smoothened) ist ein G-Protein-gekoppelter Rezeptor, der Hedgehog (HH)-Signalisierung überträgt. Normalerweise unterdrückt durch PTCH1; aktiviert, wenn PTCHE1 seine hemmende Funktion verliert (ob über PT CH1-Funktionsverlust oder SMO-Zunahmemutation). SMO aktivierende Mutationen (~10–20% der BCCs) und PTSCH1-Funktionseinbuße (~90% der GCCs), beide führen zu konstituierender HH-Wegaktivierung. Vismodegib und Sonidegib sind SMO-Antagonisten – sie binden die SMO Transmembrandomäne und blockieren die nachgeschaltete HH-Signalisierung (GLI1/2-Repression). In der Praxis erfordert die BCC HHI-Therapie keine Vortests für die SBO-Mutation vs. PTCH1-Alle BCCs haben eine HH -Wegaktivierung. SMO Mutationen treten auch im sporadischen Medulloblastom (SHH-Subtyp) und selten bei anderen Tumoren auf. Resistenz: sekundäre SMOmutationen (D473H am häufigsten) treten während der Vismodegiob-Therapie auf, treiben erworbene Resistenzen an. Sonidegib kann bei einigen Vismodegib-resistenten D473H-Muten wirksam sein.

Cinacalcet is the only FDA-approved medical therapy specifically labeled for hypercalcemia of parathyroid carcinoma. It has no cytostatic/cytotoxic effect on the tumor — it controls the biochemical consequence (PTH-driven hypercalcemia) in unresectable, recurrent, or metastatic disease. Distinct from bisphosphonates (DRUG-ZOLEDRONATE) / denosumab (DRUG-DENOSUMAB) — already in the KB — which act on osteoclast-mediated bone turnover to prevent skeletal-related events from bone metastases rather than suppressing PTH secretion; the two mechanisms are complementary and may be used concurrently in refractory hypercalcemia, per the parent Disease entity's narrative (DIS-PARATHYROID-CARCINOMA).

STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no Gorlin/ NBCCS-specific Indication exists yet). Two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff queued. SUFU germline (BMA-SUFU-GERMLINE- MEDULLOBLASTOMA) is the alternate NBCCS-like locus.

STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no HPT-JT- specific Indication exists yet). Two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff queued. STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no NF2-specific Indication entity exists yet). Two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff queued. STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no SUFU-/Gorlin- specific Indication exists yet). Two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff queued. STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no TSC-specific Indication entity exists yet; surveillance triggered via RF / Algorithm layer). STUB — Wave A+B germline expansion. Linked Indication: none (no WT1- specific Indication exists yet). Two-Clinical-Co-Lead signoff queued. Variant location largely predicts syndrome subtype: contiguous-gene deletions → WAGR; zinc-finger missense → Denys- Drash; intron-9 splice variants → Frasier. Other 11p13 contiguous-gene deletion phenotypes (e.g. simultaneous involvement of PAX6) explain aniridia and warrant ophthalmology follow-up.

SUFU germline pathogenic variants cause a Gorlin-syndrome–like predisposition with much higher medulloblastoma risk than PTCH1 (~30% lifetime vs ~5% in PTCH1), and lower BCC burden. SUFU-driven medulloblastomas cluster in the SHH-activated molecular subgroup (infant/young-child onset, desmoplastic / MBEN histology in many cases). Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol (per Foulkes et al. 2017 / AACR Pediatric Predisposition Working Group): brain MRI q4mo from diagnosis through age 3, q6mo from age 3-5, annually to age 8 — denser-than-PTCH1 cadence reflects higher MB risk. Dermatology surveillance for BCC q6-12mo from puberty. Avoid craniospinal external-beam radiation when alternatives exist (second-malignancy risk in carriers). Hedgehog-pathway inhibitors (vismodegib, sonidegib) have limited activity in SUFU-mutant SHH-MB — downstream-of-SMO position renders SMO inhibitors ineffective; this is a critical distinction from PTCH1-driven disease. ESCAT IIA.
SUFU germline — drives Gorlin-syndrome v: SUFU germline — drives Gorlin-syndrome variant with markedly higher pediatric medulloblastoma risk (~33%, SHH-subtype, often <3 years) compared with PTCH1-Gorlin (~5%). Lower BCC burden than PTCH1. Other features overlap NBCCS (jaw keratocysts may be less prevalent). AVOID craniospinal radiation when feasible — drives second primaries / treatment-related BCCs. Surveillance: brain MRI every 3-4 months in infants/young children. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.

Hand-Fuß-Reaktionen sind weniger als Fluoropyrimidin; Haupttoxizität ist Myelosuppression.

Second most common IDH1 variant. Distrib: Second most common IDH1 variant. Distribution differs by disease: R132C is the dominant IDH1 variant in cholangiocarcinoma (~25-30% of IDH1-mutant CCA per ClarIDHy) and chondrosarcoma; in glioma it is rarer than R132H (<5%); in AML R132C accounts for ~30% of IDH1 mutations. Critically, R132C is IHC-NEGATIVE with the R132H-specific antibody (clone H09) — relying on IHC alone misses these patients. Ivosidenib (Tibsovo) is approved for IDH1-mutant cholangiocarcinoma (ClarIDHy 2L+) and IDH1-mutant AML (AGILE in combination with azacitidine 1L unfit; monotherapy R/R) — labels cover all IDH1 variants on the proven hotspot list (R132C/R132G/R132H/R132L/R132S), not just R132H. Reuses existing REG-IVOSIDENIB and IDH1-keyed indications via this biomarker entity.
Second of three Ashkenazi Jewish founder: Second of three Ashkenazi Jewish founder mutations. Single-nucleotide duplication (cytosine) in exon 20 causing frameshift and premature termination — truncates BRCA1 within the BRCT2 domain, abolishing C-terminal protein-binding function critical for homologous-recombination repair coordination. Also called 5382insC in legacy nomenclature (offset by stop-codon counting convention shift). Recurrent founder effect in AJ populations (~0.8-1.0% carrier frequency in AJ vs <0.1% non-AJ); also reported as a recurrent variant in Polish, Russian, Belarusian populations (likely separate founder events or AJ admixture). Lifetime cancer risks consistent with BRCA1 average. NCCN 2025 endorses population-wide AJ founder-panel testing (3-mutation panel) regardless of family history. Same surveillance and risk-reduction protocols as other BRCA1 pathogenic variants. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.
Second-generation HIV-1 integrase strand: HIV-1-Integrase-Strangtransfer-Inhibitor der zweiten Generation (INSTI), formuliert als langwirksame injizierbare Nanosuspension. Blockiert die Integration der viralen DNA in das Wirtschromosom – derselbe INSTI-Mechanismus wie Dolutegravir und Biclegravir, mit einer ähnlichen hohen Resistenzbarriere. Sustained-release IM depot bietet therapeutisches Plasma-Cabotegravir für ~2-3 Monate pro Dosis. Da HIV-1 PRE-EXPOSIRE PROPHYLAXIS bei HIV-negativen Erwachsenen mit erheblichem Risiko, CAB-LA reduziert sexuellen HIV-Erwerb um ~69% gegen tägliche orale FTC/TDF in HPTN 083 (Zisgen MSM / Transgender Frauen) und um ~89% in HPN 084 (Zigender Frau mit Risiko in Subsahara-Afrika) — überlegene Wirksamkeit oraler PrEP, angetrieben durch eine verbesserte Einhaltung über tägliche Pillen. Krebs-Präventionsweg: Vorbeugen von Vorkommnissen HIV-Infektion verhindert nachgeschaltete AIDS-Definition maligne Erkrankungen (Kaposi Sarkom, NHL inkl. PCNSL, invasive Gebärmutterhalskrebs) und HPV-Rela...

Second-generation phosphonamidate prodru: Phosphonamidat-Prodrug der zweiten Generation von Tenofovir; stabilisiert, um der Plasmahydrolyse (versus TDF) zu widerstehen, so dass es bevorzugt TenoFOvir intrazellulär an Hepatozyten (HBV) und Lymphozyten liefert. Einmal in Zielzelle, intracelluläres Kathepsin A spaltet TAF an Tenofotovir, das dann zu Tenophovir-DP phosphoryliert und wettbewerbsfähig HBV Polymerase / HIV-1 Reverse Transkriptase mit Kettenabbruch hemmt. Erzielt eine um ~90 % geringere systemische Tenofovir-Exposition als TDF bei äquivalenten intrazellulären Konzentrationen – verringerte Nieren- und Knochentoxizität.

Secondary KIT mutations after imatinib f: Secondary KIT mutations after imatinib failure cluster in exon 13/14 (ATP-binding pocket — V654A, T670I) or exon 17/18 (activation loop — D816, D820, N822, Y823). Sunitinib (Demetri Lancet 2006) covers exon 13/14 secondaries; regorafenib (GRID) provides 3L coverage; ripretinib (INVICTUS) is a switch-control inhibitor active across both classes — preferred 4L+.

Secondary-amine tricyclic antidepressant: Sekundär-Amino-trizyklisches Antidepressivum; primäre Wirkung ist die Hemmung der noradrenergen Reuptake (modest serotonin reuptap hemmung), mit Antagonismus bei Histamin H1, Muskarin und α1-adrenerge Rezeptoren. Mechanismus bei der Tabakabnahme ist nicht vollständig etabliert — vorgeschlagene Beiträge umfassen norad renergene Modulation des Nikotinabzugs, Angst/Depressiv-Symptome-Abschwächung während der Stop-Versuche und direkte Wirkung auf den Raucher-bezogenen dopaminergen Kreisen. Cochrane Metaanalyse (Hughes 2014 Update) — Nortriptyline verdoppelt etwa die Langzeitstillstandsrate gegenüber Placebo (RR ~2.0), vergleichbar mit Bupropion und NRT; LESS-Evidenz und LOWER-Tolerabilität als Varenicline (DRUG-VARENICLINE — First-Line pro USPSTF 2021). OFF-LABEL-Anwendung; zweite / dritte Option zur Beendigung, wenn Varenicilin / Bupropions / NRT gescheitert ist oder kontraindiziert sind.
Select persistent, unexplained, or new f: Wählen Sie persistente, unerklärliche oder neue Erkenntnisse.
Selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist; blo: Selektiver 5-HT3-Rezeptor-Antagonist; blockiert die vagale Stimulation von Erbrechenreflex.
Selective ATP-competitive BRAF V600E/K k: Selektiver ATP-kompetitiver BRAF V600E/K Kinase-Inhibitor. Längere Zielresidenzzeit vs. Vemurafenib/Dabrafenib → weniger paradoxe ERK-Aktivierung in WT BRAF-Zellen. In mCRC BRAFV600E + Cetuximab (BEACON CRC) – erste BRAF/KKinase-Hemmer im SFB.
Selective ATP-competitive small-molecule: Selektives ATP-kompetitives Kleinmolekül TKI von VEGFR-1, VEG FR-2 und VEGF-3 mit sub-nanomolarer In-vitro-Potenz und verbesserter Selektivität gegenüber Multikinase-TKI der ersten Generation (Sunitinib, Sorafenib). Blockiert die VEGH-getriebene Endothelproliferation, Migration und Überleben in der Mikroumgebung des Tumors, was überwiegend anti-angiogene Effekte mit minimaler direkter Zytotoxizität hervorruft. Die kurze Halbwertszeit (~2,5-6 h) gibt eine titrierbare BID-Dosis — eine charakteristische patientenspezifische Dosiseskalation, die auf der Blutdruckreaktion beruht (bis zu 10 mg BID, wenn BP mit 5 mg tolerierbar ist). pivotale Hinweise: AXIS (axitinib vs sorafenib 2L mRCC post-sunitinib/cytokines: mPFS 6,7 vs 4,7 mo); KEYNOTE-426 (Pembrolizumab + Axitinab vs sunitinibi 1L mRK: mPCS 15,7 vs 11,1 mo, OS HR 0,53), JAVELIN Renal 101 (Avelumab + Axitinib vSunitinibib 1L MRCC).
Selective BRAF V600E/K inhibitor. Always: Selektiver BRAF V600E/K-Inhibitor. Immer mit Trametinib (MEKi) kombiniert, um eine paradoxe RAF-Aktivierung in BRAF-WT-Zellen zu verhindern und die Wirksamkeit zu verbessern.
Selective Coverage Versus Comprehensive: Selektive Abdeckung Versus Umfassende Abdeckung Radiotherapie in schlecht differenzierten und anaplastischen Schilddrüsenkrebs
Selective IDH1 inhibitor for R/R IDH1-mu: Selective IDH1 inhibitor for R/R IDH1-mutant AML in adults. Pivotal Study 2102-HEM-101 (single-arm, n=153, R/R IDH1-mut AML, olutasidenib 150 mg PO BID) — CR + CRh 35%; mDOR 25.9 mo (CR/CRh subgroup); transfusion independence 56-month; ~30% transitioned to allo-HSCT. Compares favorably to ivosidenib (alternative IDH1 inhibitor — separate regimen entity, future). BOXED WARNINGS: differentiation syndrome (~16%) + hepatotoxicity (~21% Grade ≥3 transaminitis). Used as bridge to allo-HSCT in fit patients. Ivosidenib + azacitidine combination (AGILE trial, newly-diagnosed unfit IDH1-mut AML) is a separate regimen entity. STUB — pending Study 2102-HEM-101 trial Source ingestion (SRC-OLUTASIDENIB-DEBOTTON-2023) and Co-Lead sign-off.
Selective JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor. Blocks JA: Selektiver JAK1/JAK2-Inhibitor. Blockiert die JAK-STAT-Signalisierung, angetrieben von JAK2 V617F (und CALR/MPL über JAK2-Dimerisation). Verringert Milz- und Symptome in MF/PV/ET; beseitigt Klon nicht.
Selective JAK2 inhibitor for MF post-rux: Selective JAK2 inhibitor for MF post-ruxolitinib failure or intolerance. JAKARTA-2 phase-2 + FREEDOM-2 phase-3 confirmatory. Wernicke encephalopathy boxed warning — mandatory thiamine measurement + supplementation. Take with food. STUB — pending Co-Lead sign-off.
Selective JAK2 inhibitor with FLT3 activ: Selektiver JAK2-Hemmer mit FLT3-Aktivität. Aktiv in MF nach Ruxolitinib-Ausfall / Intoleranz. Boxenwarnhinweis für Wernicke Enzephalopathie (Thiamin-Mangel).
Selective KIT and PDGFRA inhibitor desig: Selektiver KIT- und PDGFRA-Inhibitor zur Bindung der aktiven Exterieurbildung; einzigartig aktiv gegen die imatinib-resistenten KIT D816V (fortgeschrittene systemische Mastozytose) und PDGFRA D842V (GIST) Aktivierungsschleifenmutationen. NAVIGATOR (PDGFRa D842,V GIST) ORR ~88%; EXPLORER + PATHFINDER (fortgeschritten SM) ORS ~75% mit tiefen molekularen Ansprechraten.
Selective MEK inhibitor used in combinat: Selektiver MEK-Hemmer in Kombination mit Dabrafenib. Reduziert Resistenz + Hauttoxizität gegenüber BRAFi allein.
Selective MET inhibitor with similar eff: Selektiver MET-Inhibitor mit ähnlichem Wirksamkeitsprofil wie Capmatinib. VISION-Studie: ORR ~46% in 1L MET ex14+ NSCLC.
Selective TKI of BCR-ABL1 (~30× more pot: Selektives TKI von BCR-ABL1 (~30× potenter als Imatinib). Aktiv gegen die meisten Imatins-resistenten Mutationen außer T315I, V299L, F317L. Das vaskuläre Nebenwirkungsprofil (PAOD, MI, Schlaganfall) ist die dosislimitierende Langzeitbetroffenheit.
Selective TKI of BCR-ABL1, KIT, PDGFR-α/: Selektives TKI von BCR-ABL1, KIT, PDGFR-α/β. Gründer des gezielten CML-Ära. Standard CML 1L für risikoarme, komorbide oder kostengezwungene Patienten.
Selective allosteric (non-ATP-competitiv: Selective allosteric (non-ATP-competitive) inhibitor of MEK1/MEK2 kinases that bind a pocket adjacent to the ATP site, locking MEK in an inactive conformation. Blocks downstream phosphorylation of ERK1/2 in the constitutively activated RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK pathway, suppressing proliferation and survival signaling in BRAF V600-mutant tumor cells. Combined with a BRAF inhibitor (encorafenib) the doublet mitigates paradoxical MAPK reactivation seen with BRAFi monotherapy and prolongs response duration. Clinical evidence: COLUMBUS (encorafenib + binimetinib vs vemurafenib in BRAF V600 unresectable / metastatic melanoma, mPFS 14.9 vs 7.3 mo, mOS 33.6 vs 16.9 mo). Historically evaluated as the third agent in BEACON-CRC triplet (no OS gain over encorafenib + cetuximab doublet — doublet is the standard for BRAF V600E mCRC).
Selective alpha-1 blockade gives less re: Die selektive Alpha-1-Blockierung gibt weniger Reflextachykardie und eine einfachere allgemeine Verfügbarkeit als Phenoxybenzamin (DRUG-PHENOXYBENZAMINE), wodurch Doxazosin eine allgemein verwendete praktische Alternative für obligatorische präoperative PPGL-Alphablockade ist; die Wahl zwischen den beiden ist pro lokale Praxis/Verfügbarkeit, nicht als KB-Level-Vorliebe modelliert. STUB bis zur klinischen Ko-Lead-Auszeichnung (CHARTER §6.1, dev-mode-expremted).
Selective competitive antagonist at the: Selective competitive antagonist at the 5-hydroxytryptamine type 3 (5-HT3) serotonin receptor located peripherally on vagal afferent terminals in the GI tract and centrally in the chemoreceptor trigger zone (area postrema). Distinguishing features vs first-generation 5-HT3 antagonists (ondansetron, granisetron): ~30× higher receptor binding affinity, ~7× longer plasma half-life (~40 h vs ~4-6 h), and demonstrated allosteric receptor cross-talk with NK1 receptors that contributes to superior delayed-phase CINV control. A single IV or oral dose covers both acute (0-24 h) and delayed (24-120 h) phases of CINV. Approved by FDA July 2003 and EMA March 2005.

Selective competitive antagonist at the histamine H2 receptor on gastric parietal cells, blocking histamine-stimulated gastric acid secretion (basal, nocturnal, food-stimulated, and pentagastrin- stimulated) — produces ~50-90% acid suppression depending on dose. In allergic reactions and chemotherapy infusion reactions, the H2 antagonism complements H1 antagonist (diphenhydramine) blockade — histamine acts on both H1 (bronchospasm, vasodilation, urticaria, pruritus) AND H2 (vasodilation, gastric secretion, cardiac inotropy) receptors, and combined H1 + H2 blockade is superior to either alone for prevention and treatment of urticaria, mild anaphylactoid reactions, and chemotherapy infusion reactions (paclitaxel, carboplatin retreatment, monoclonal antibodies). Famotidine is preferred among H2 antagonists in oncology because of lack of CYP-mediated drug interactions (cimetidine inhibits C...
Selective competitive antagonist of the: Selektiver Konkurrentantagonist des Wirkstoffs P / NK1-Rezeptor in ZNS-Emetikzentren (Nukleus tractus solitarius, Area Postrema), blockiert die späte Phase der Chemotherapie-induzierte Übelkeit und Erbrechen (CINV) vermittelt durch Substanz P. Unterscheidung der pharmakokinetischen Funktion ist eine außergewöhnlich lange terminale Halbwertszeit von ~7 Tagen (~169 Stunden), die Rezeptorabdeckung über die volle 5-Tage verzögerte Phase von einer einzigen oralen Dosis ohne Notwendigkeit für Nachbeobachtung Dosen an Tagen 2-3 bietet. Von der FDA im September 2015 und EMA im April 2017 zur Prävention von verzögertem CINV bei Erwachsenen, die HEC oder MEC erhalten, zugelassen.
Selective high-affinity antagonist of th: Selective high-affinity antagonist of the human substance P / neurokinin-1 (NK1) receptor in the central nervous system, blocking the late vomiting signal mediated by substance P binding in the nucleus tractus solitarius and area postrema. This complements the early-phase blockade by 5-HT3 antagonists (which control acute CINV) by preventing the delayed phase (24-120 h post-chemotherapy). Standard component of triple-antiemetic prophylaxis (NK1 + 5-HT3 + dexamethasone, ± olanzapine) for highly emetogenic chemotherapy (HEC) such as cisplatin ≥50 mg/m², AC (anthracycline + cyclophosphamide), and BEACOPP. Approved by FDA March 2003 and EMA November 2003.
Selective inhibitor of MET (c-MET) tyros: Selektiver Inhibitor der MET (c-MET) Tyrosinkinase. GEOMETRY Mono-1: ORR ~68% in 1L MET ex14-mutant NSCLC.
Selective inhibitor of PI3K-alpha (p110α: Selektiver Inhibitor von PI3K-alpha (p110α Isoform). Aktiv in PIK3CA-mutant HR+/HER2- metastasiert — kombiniert mit Fulvestrant pro SOLAR-1.
Selective inhibitor of cyclin-dependent: Selektiver Inhibitor der cyclinabhängigen Kinasen 4 und 6 — blockiert Rb-Phosphorylierung, die Zellen in G1 abfangen. Kombiniert mit endokriner Therapie in HR+/HER2- metastasierter; bescheidener Nebeneffekt (PALLAS / PENELOPE-B-Negativ).
Selective inhibitor of cyclooxygenase-2: Selective inhibitor of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2; ~10-20-fold selectivity over COX-1 at therapeutic concentrations), suppressing prostaglandin- driven inflammation, proliferation, and angiogenesis with relatively spared platelet COX-1 (no antiplatelet effect at standard doses) and reduced gastric mucosal COX-1 (less GI bleeding than non-selective NSAIDs). Cancer-prevention rationale: COX-2 is upregulated in adenomas and many tumors; inhibition reduces PGE2-driven proliferation and immune escape. In FAP, celecoxib reduced duodenal polyp burden (Steinbach NEJM 2000) — formerly FDA-approved for FAP-related polyposis (orphan designation), withdrawn 2011 by sponsor after post-marketing study did not confirm benefit.
Selective irreversible CYP17A1 inhibitor: Selektiver irreversibler CYP17A1-Inhibitor – blockiert die Nebennieren- und intratumorale Androgensynthese (Testosteron, DHT-Vorläufer). Immer in Kombination mit niedrig dosiertem Kortikosteroid (Prednison) zur Minderung des Mineralokortikoidüberschusses (Hypertonie, Hypokaliämie, Flüssigkeitsretention).
Selective irreversible inhibitor of the: Selektiver irreversibler Inhibitor der chymotrypsinähnlichen Aktivität des 20S-Proteasoms (β5 / LMP7-Untereinheiten). Bindungen kovalent über Epoxyketon – unterscheidet sich von Bortezomibs reversiblem Boronat –, was eine anhaltende Hemmung + Aktivität im Bortezomib-refraktären Myelom verursacht. Einzeldosen können die Proteasome-Aktivität > 80 % für > 24 Stunden unterdrücken.
Selective oral inhibitor of CSF1R (colon: Selective oral inhibitor of CSF1R (colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor), KIT, and FLT3. In TGCT (formerly PVNS), tumor cells overexpress CSF1 (via COL6A3-CSF1 translocation), driving recruitment of CSF1R-expressing macrophages and osteoclast-like giant cells that constitute the bulk of the tumor mass. Pexidartinib depletes these CSF1R+ cells, reducing tumor burden. ILLUMINATE trial: ORR 38% (vs 0% placebo), with 15% complete response. FDA-approved August 2019 — first systemic therapy for TGCT.
Selective oral inhibitor of EZH2 (Enhanc: Selektiver oraler Hemmer von EZH2 (Enhancer of Zeste Homolog 2) — der katalytischen Untereinheit von PRC2 (Polycomb Repressive Complex 2). Blockiert H3K27 Trimethylierung, die Tumor-Suppressor-Gene entschärft. Effektiv gegen EZh2 Wildtyp (epigenetische Abhängigkeit) und Y641 Gain-of-Funktion mutierte FL – überlegene Reaktion in mutierten Teilmenge.
Selective partial agonist at the α4β2 ni: Selektiver Partialagonist am α4β2 nikotinischen Acetylcholinrezeptor – der Hauptvermittler der Nikotin-induzierten dopaminergen Belohnung. Partieller Agonismus erzeugt eine bescheidene Dopaminfreisetzung (entlastendes Verlangen und Entzug) und blockiert gleichzeitig die Nikotinbindung (verringert die Verstärkung aus allen Zigaretten, die während der Titration geraucht werden).
Selective short-acting β2-adrenergic ago: Selective short-acting β2-adrenergic agonist that activates β2 receptors on bronchial smooth muscle, stimulating adenylyl cyclase → increased intracellular cAMP → relaxation of bronchial smooth muscle and bronchodilation. Onset of action 5-15 min after inhalation, peak effect 30-60 min, duration 4-6 h. Also produces mast cell membrane stabilization (modestly reducing histamine release), enhanced mucociliary clearance, and decreased microvascular permeability. Selectivity for β2 over β1 (~30:1) limits cardiac stimulation at therapeutic doses but loses selectivity at high doses or with parenteral routes (tachycardia, palpitations, modest blood pressure changes). In oncology supportive care, used for: (1) bronchospasm component of chemotherapy infusion reactions and anaphylaxis (adjunct to epinephrine, NOT substitute); (2) acute exacerbations of underlying asthma / COPD precipitated by inf...
Selective small-molecule inhibitor of hy: Selektiver kleinmolekularer Hemmer des hypoxieinduzierbaren Faktors 2α (HIF-2α). VHL-Inaktivierung (somatisch in ~90% des Klarzell-RCC, Keimlinie im von Hippel-Lindau-Syndrom) → HIF-2 Alpha-Stabilisierung → treibt den angiogenen/glykolytischen ccRCC-Phänotyp an. Belzutifan stört die HIF-2-α-Heterodimerisierung mit HIF-1β und unterdrückt das nachgeschaltete Transkriptionsprogramm.
Selective, high-affinity D2-dopamine rec: Selective, high-affinity D2-dopamine receptor agonist with a long elimination half-life (~65 hours) permitting once- or twice-weekly oral dosing. Activates D2 receptors on pituitary lactotroph cells, suppressing prolactin synthesis/secretion and inducing lactotroph adenoma shrinkage in the majority of prolactinomas. First-line therapy for prolactinoma; superior prolactin-normalization rate, tumor-shrinkage rate, and tolerability compared with bromocriptine (older, less selective dopamine agonist).
Selectively and reversibly blocks post-s: Selectively and reversibly blocks post-synaptic alpha-1 adrenergic receptors, reducing catecholamine-mediated peripheral vasoconstriction with less reflex tachycardia than non-selective irreversible agents (phenoxybenzamine) because alpha-2 presynaptic auto-inhibition of norepinephrine release is preserved. Used as an alternative preoperative alpha-blocker in pheochromocytoma / paraganglioma (PPGL) where mandatory preoperative alpha-blockade is required before surgery to prevent intraoperative hypertensive crisis (Endocrine Society 2014 PPGL guideline).
Selectively binds BCL-2, displaces pro-a: Selektive Bindung von BCL-2, verdrängt pro-apoptotische BH3-Proteine, stellt Apoptose in BCL-2-abhängigen Krebszellen wieder her. Hoch aktiv in CLL (wo CLL BCL 2-addiziert ist), AML, multiples Myelom. Substantielle Tumorlyserisiko zu Beginn — strenge 5-Wochen-Dosierung Rampe + TLS Prophylaxe erforderlich.
Selectively binds and activates retinoid: Selectively binds and activates retinoid X receptors (RXRα, RXRβ, RXRγ), which heterodimerize with other nuclear receptors to regulate gene expression involved in cellular differentiation and proliferation. In CTCL induces apoptosis and differentiation of malignant T-cells.
Selectively phosphorylated by viral thym: Selectively phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase to acyclovir monophosphate, then by host kinases to acyclovir triphosphate, which inhibits viral DNA polymerase and terminates viral DNA chain elongation. Active against HSV-1, HSV-2, VZV; modest activity against EBV, CMV.
Selectively reduces platelet count by in: Selektiv reduziert die Thrombozytenzahl durch Interferieren mit Megakaryocytendifferenzierung. Senkt nicht WBC oder Hct (im Gegensatz zu HU). Wird als 2L-Zytoreduktion bei ET verwendet, wenn HU intoleranziert oder unzureichend ist.

Semi-synthetic aminopenicillin that bind: Semisynthetisches Aminopenicillin, das an Penicilli-bindende Proteine (PBPs) bindet, indem es aktiv Bakterien teilt, die Vernetzung der Peptidoglykan-Zellwandschicht hemmt und autolysinvermittelte bakterizide Wirkung auslöst. Spektrum: breiter als Penicilin V/G — enthält viele Streptococcus spp., Enterocockus faecalis, Listeria monocytogenes, Helicobacter pylori und einige Gram-Negative (E. coli, Proteus mirabilis, Haemophilus influenzae, Salmonella, Shigella) ohne β-Lactamase-Ausdruck. Semi-synthetic podophyllotoxin derivativ: Semi-synthetic podophyllotoxin derivative; stabilizes the cleavable topoisomerase II–DNA complex, preventing strand religation and producing protein-linked DNA double-strand breaks that trigger apoptosis. Etoposide phosphate (Etopophos) is a water-soluble prodrug rapidly converted to etoposide by serum phosphatases, allowing faster IV administration without solvent reactions.
Semi-synthetic taxane derived from Europ: Semisynthetisches Taxan, abgeleitet aus europäischer Eibe (Taxos baccata). Zellen halten an der G2/M fest, was Apoptose auslöst. Pharmakologisch ähnlich wie Caspofungin, aber mit einer flachen Dosierungsstruktur (keine Körpergewichts- oder Leberanpassung bei den meisten Patienten), ohne Aufladedosis und dem einfachsten DDI-Profil der Echinocandin-Klasse (keine signifikanten Wechselwirkungen mit Cyclosporin, Tacrolimus, Sirolimus). FDA-zugelassen 2005. Bemerkenswert zugelassen zur Vorbeugung invasiver Candidiasis bei HSCT-Empfängern – zentrale Indikation in der onkohämatologischen unterstützenden Behandlung.

Semisynthetic lipopeptide echinocandin that non-competitively inhibits β-(1,3)-D-glucan synthase, the enzyme complex (Fks1/Fks2) that synthesizes β-(1,3)-D-glucan, an essential structural polymer of the fungal cell wall absent from mammalian cells. Cell-wall instability produces fungicidal activity against most Candida species (including C. glabrata, C. krusei, and many fluconazole-resistant strains) and fungistatic activity against Aspergillus species. NO activity against Cryptococcus, Mucorales (Mucor, Rhizopus), Fusarium, or Trichosporon (these lack significant β-glucan or have alternative cell-wall structures). Excellent safety profile vs amphotericin B; narrow drug interaction profile vs azoles. FDA-approved 2001 — first echinocandin approved. Semisynthetic water-soluble camptothecin: Semisynthetische wasserlösliche Camptothecin-Analog, die die kovalente Topoisomerase I–DNA spaltbare Komplex bindet und stabilisiert, verhindert die Religion des durch das Enzym erzeugten Single-Strand DNA-Nicks. Serum calcitonin is a highly specific biomarker for medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) — produced by parafollicular C-cells. In MEN2 RET germline carriers, calcitonin trends inform timing of prophylactic thyroidectomy (RET codon-stratified per ATA Thyroid 2015 + Endocrine Society MEN 2023): - MEN2B (M918T): prophylactic thyroidectomy <1 year, before calcitonin rise becomes detectable - MEN2A high-risk codons (634, 883): thyroidectomy by age 5 - MEN2A moderate-risk codons (609, 611, 618, 620, 630, 631): may delay until calcitonin becomes detectable on stimulation testing Basal + stimulated (pentagastrin / calcium-stimulated where available) calcitonin tracks residual disease post-thyroidectomy. CEA is a complementary marker. Doubling time of calcitonin post-resection is a strong prognostic indicator (<6 mo = aggressive). ESCAT IIIA — calcitonin directs prophylactic surgery timing and post-operative monitoring.
Serum tumor marker (CEACAM5). NOT recomm: Serumtumormarker (CEACAM5). NICHT empfohlen für die allgemeine Populations-CRC-Screening (niedrige Empfindlichkeit für Frühstadiumserkrankungen, falsche positive Effekte durch Rauchen, IBD, Zirrhose, Pankreatitis). PRIMARISCHE Überwachung Anwendung: nach kurativ-intent Resektion des Stadiums II/III CRC — q3-6 Monate CEA für 2 Jahre dann q6 Monate für 3-5 Jahre (NCCN/ESMO-Konkordant), steigende Trend löst Bildgebung Workup für Rezidiv. Zwei aufeinander folgende Anstiege > 5 ng/ml oder Verdoppelung innerhalb von 1-2 Monaten rechtfertigen CT Brust/Abdomen/Pelvis und betrachten die Koloskopie. Etwa 30% der CRCs nicht sekretieren CEA (Mikrosatelliten-unstabil, Mucinous, Signet-Ring-Histologien); bei diesen Patienten CEA-Überwachung hat begrenzte Ertrag. Unterscheidung von BIO-CTDNA-MRD, die höhere analytische Empfindlichkeit für molekulare Resterkrankung bietet. STUB bis Zwei-Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Serum tumor marker (MUC1 epitope) used f: Serum tumor marker (MUC1 epitope) used for breast cancer follow-up; ASCO and NCCN do NOT recommend CA 15-3 for screening of asymptomatic individuals (insufficient sensitivity/specificity, no mortality benefit shown). Limited role in surveillance after curative-intent treatment of early-stage breast cancer — most guidelines (ASCO 2013, NCCN 2025) advise against routine serial measurement in non-metastatic survivors. Primary utility: response monitoring in established metastatic disease (rising trend may precede imaging progression by weeks to months). Can be falsely elevated in benign breast disease, liver disease, ovarian cancer, and some lung cancers. STUB pending two-Co-Lead signoff.

Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favourable subtype of ATLL. Smoldering: ≥5% circulating abnormal lymphocytes, no organ involvement (skin/lung lesion permitted), LDH normal, BUN normal, albumin normal, no hypercalcemia, no lymphadenopathy or organomegaly. Chronic-favourable: similar to smoldering but lymphadenopathy/organomegaly permitted, LDH ≤2× ULN, BUN ≤ULN, albumin ≥ULN, Ca normal, no CNS/bone/GI/effusion. AZT+IFN-α (anti-HTLV-1 mechanism) yields 5-yr OS ~46% vs ~20% for chemotherapy in these subtypes (Bazarbachi 2010 meta-analysis, JNCI). Aggressive subtypes (acute/lymphoma/chronic-unfavourable) do NOT respond to AZT+IFN — route those to CHOEP+mogamulizumab via RF-ATLL-HIGH-RISK-BIOLOGY.

Sirolimus (rapamycin), an mTORC1 inhibitor, is FDA-approved (May 2015) and EMA-approved (2017) for treatment of LAM in adults. MILES phase III RCT (McCormack et al., NEJM 2011): N=89 (46 sirolimus, 43 placebo); 12-month treatment + 12-month observation. Primary endpoint: FEV1 change from baseline to 12 months (mL/month rate). FEV1 slope: +1 mL/month (sirolimus) vs -12 mL/month (placebo); difference 11 mL/month (p<0.001). Secondary: FVC improvement, VEGF-D reduction, 6-min walk improvement, QoL. After 12-month observation: benefits partially lost (FEV1 decline resumes), suggesting need for continuous therapy. mTOR inhibition does not eliminate LAM cells but controls their mTORC1-driven proliferation. Everolimus is used for TSC-associated LAM and for renal angiomyolipoma (EXIST-2). VEGF-D ≥800 pg/mL is a diagnostic biomarker (non-invasive diagnosis of LAM possible in right clinical context without biopsy).

Small-molecule PSMA-binding ligand conju: Kleinmolekularer PSMA-bindender Ligand, konjugiert zu β-emittierendem Radionuklid Lu-177. PSMA wird auf > 90% der Prostata-Adenokarzinomzellen angegeben; Lu-177-PSMA-617 bindet PSMA und liefert zytotoxische β -Strahlung direkt an Tumorstellen. Small-molecule allosteric inhibitor of m: Kleinmolekularer allosterischer Inhibitor des mutierten IDH2-Enzyms (R140Q, R172K Hotspots). Mutant IDH2 katalysiert die neomorphe Umwandlung von α-Ketoglutarat in 2-Hydroxyglutarate (2-HG), einem Oncometabolit, das die DNA + Histonhypermethylierung antreibt und die myeloische Differenzierung blockiert. Enasidenib reduziert 2-HG, restauriert die TET2-abhängige Demethylierung und führt zu einer terminalen Differenzierung von leukemischen Blasten. FDA-genehmigt Aug 2017 auf Basis von Phase 1/2-Einzelarmdaten in R/R AML (AG221-AML-001).
Small-molecule inhibitor of the menin-KM: Small-molecule inhibitor of the menin-KMT2A (MLL) protein-protein interaction. KMT2A-rearranged and NPM1-mutated leukemias are dependent on menin recruitment to KMT2A-fusion or wild-type KMT2A complexes that drive aberrant HOXA / MEIS1 transcription. Disrupting menin-MLL displaces the leukemogenic transcriptional program, inducing differentiation and apoptosis of leukemic blasts. FDA-approved Nov 2024 on the basis of AUGMENT-101 phase 1/2 trial.

Sokal score (Sokal 1984) uses age, splee: Sokal score (Sokal 1984) uses age, spleen size, platelet count, blast %. High-risk (Sokal >1.2) marks ~20-25% of CML-CP at diagnosis with worse 10-yr OS and PFS on imatinib vs intermediate/low. ENESTnd (Saglio 2010) and DASISION (Kantarjian 2010) show 2nd-gen TKIs achieve faster + deeper molecular responses than imatinib in high-Sokal subgroups. ELN 2020 prefers ELTS (RF-CML-HIGH-RISK-ELTS, existing) but Sokal remains the more widely-used bedside score. Companion to RF-HASFORD-HIGH; both can fire together. Conflict- resolution: this RF intensifies toward 2nd-gen TKI; cardiotoxicity flags (RF-CML-COMORBIDITY-COMPLEX) may de-escalate back to imatinib.

Square-planar platinum(II) coordination: Square-planar platinum(II) coordination complex. After cellular uptake and aquation (Cl displaced by water in low-chloride intracellular environment), the activated species forms intra- and inter-strand DNA cross-links, predominantly 1,2-d(GpG) and 1,2-d(ApG) adducts. These adducts distort the DNA helix, blocking replication and transcription, and trigger apoptosis when not repaired. Resistance mechanisms include enhanced nucleotide excision repair, glutathione detoxification, and reduced cellular uptake (CTR1 transporter). Backbone for esophageal CRT, head-and-neck CRT, NSCLC, gastric (legacy), cervical, ovarian, testicular germ-cell, and bladder.

Sub-regimen entity authored separately for reuse across DLBCL / FL / future glofitamab combinations and to allow the renderer to surface the day -7 scheduling requirement as a distinct phase in patient-facing plans. Pair with parent schedule (REGIMEN-GLOFITAMAB-MONO-DLBCL-3L) starting 7 days later. Bibliographic record SRC-NP30179-DICKINSON-2022 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off.
Standard 12-week varenicline course is t: Standard 12-week varenicline course is the most effective single-agent tobacco-cessation pharmacotherapy (USPSTF + AHCPR). Set quit date day 8 of treatment (~end of titration). Extension to 24 weeks improves long-term abstinence in patients abstinent at 12 weeks. Counsel patients on neuropsychiatric monitoring (EAGLES 2016 reassured but residual caution).
Standard 1L cytoreduction for high-risk: Standard 1L cytoreduction for high-risk PV (age >60 OR prior thrombosis) AND high-risk ET (same criteria). Targets: - PV: Hct <45% (mainstay; CYTO-PV trial), platelets <400K - ET: platelets <400-450K Phlebotomy is the foundation in PV (with HU layered for cytoreduction); ASA at low dose unless contraindicated (extreme thrombocytosis with acquired vWD = relative contraindication). STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 1L for AML unfit for intensive: Standard 1L for AML unfit for intensive 7+3 (VIALE-A: median OS 14.7 vs 9.6 mo for aza alone). Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor co-administration (azole prophylaxis) requires venetoclax dose reduction. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 1L for MDS-HR (and bridging to: Standard 1L for MDS-HR (and bridging to alloHCT in eligible patients). Azacitidine and decitabine functionally equivalent; choice often local. Ven+aza in HR-MDS is increasingly used (off-label extrapolation from VIALE-A AML data; no Phase-3 HR-MDS-specific RCT). STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 1L for R/M HNSCC with CPS ≥1 (t: Standard 1L for R/M HNSCC with CPS ≥1 (the majority of HNSCC). HPV+ oropharyngeal R/M handled identically (no de-escalation in recurrent setting). Reuses pembrolizumab + cisplatin + carboplatin + 5-FU drug entities.
Standard 1L for advanced / metastatic GI: Standard 1L für fortgeschrittene/metastasierende GIST mit Imatinib-sensitivem Genotyp (KIT exon 11 ~50%; KIT exon 9 ~10% — eskalieren auf 800 mg; PDGFRA Non-D842V exon 18; PPGFRA exon 12/14). Standard 1L for fit transplant-eligible: Standard 1L für fit transplantierbare MCL (Alter <65, ECOG 0-1). Nordic Protokoll oder LYMA-Stil. Hauptbeitrag: HiDAC + autoSCT Konsolidierung + R Wartung drastisch verbessert PFS (median > 7-8 Jahre vs ~ 3 Jahre auf R-CHOP allein). Kardiotoxizität Risiko + kumulative HiDAC Toxizität — Fitness Auswahl kritisch.
Standard 1L for fit-for-intensive AML. A: Standard 1L for fit-for-intensive AML. Add midostaurin if FLT3-ITD/TKD+ (RATIFY: improved 4-y OS 51% vs 44%). Day-14 BM check at end of induction; if blasts persist → re-induction. Consolidation HiDAC 3 g/m² q12h d1, 3, 5 for 3-4 cycles in young fit favorable / intermediate-risk; alloHCT for adverse-risk in CR1. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 1L for low-risk CML chronic pha: Standard 1L for low-risk CML chronic phase, elderly, comorbid patients, or where cost / access is limiting. IRIS established imatinib 400 mg daily; 10-y OS ~83%. ELN 2020 milestones: ≤10% at 3 mo, ≤1% at 6 mo, ≤0.1% (MMR) at 12 mo. PCR monitoring q3mo for first year, then q3-6mo. TFR attempt eligible after ≥3 years on TKI + sustained DMR (MR4.5) ≥2 years per ELN. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 1L for low-risk Sokal/EUTOS CML: Standard 1L for low-risk Sokal/EUTOS CML, elderly, or in cost-constrained settings (generics widely available, NSZU-reimbursed in Ukraine). 2nd-gen TKIs (dasatinib, nilotinib, bosutinib) achieve faster deep molecular response but no…
Standard 1L for low/intermediate-risk AP: Standard 1L für APL mit niedrigem/mittlerem Risiko (Sanz WBC ≤10). APL0406: 2-Y-EFS 97% vs. 86% mit ATRA+chemo (AIDA), OS 99% vs 91%, weniger hämatologische Toxizität, keine Anthracyclin-Kardiotoxizität. ATRA initiierte im Voraus bei klinischem APL-Verdacht (nicht auf eine zytogenetische Bestätigung warten). Tägliches EKG + Elektrolyt-Protokoll während der ATO-Induktion obligatorisch. Standard 1L for the imatinib-sensitive G: Standard 1L für die imatinib-sensiblen GIST-Genotypen (~85% aller GIST). Wiederverwenden cross-line REG-IMATINIB-GIST-1L, die das KIT exon 9 Dosis-Eskalationsregel codiert.
Standard 1L for the ~50-100% of advanced: Standard 1L for the ~50-100% of advanced MTC that is RET-mutant (sporadic ~50% RET M918T; hereditary MEN2 ~100%). Reuses cross-disease DRUG-SELPERCATINIB.
Standard 1L induction regimen for transp: Standard 1L induction regimen for transplant-eligible MM (4 cycles before harvest, then ASCT, then 2 cycles consolidation, then lenalidomide maintenance). For transplant-ineligible patients, VRd-lite (8-12 cycles, modified dosing per SWOG S0777) is the preferred 1L triplet. Standard-risk cytogenetics → VRd; high-risk → escalate to D-VRd (REG-DARA-VRD).
Standard 1L regimen for newly-diagnosed: Standard 1L regimen for newly-diagnosed DLBCL NOS for the past 20+ years. ~60% cure rate overall, ~80% for low-IPI / ~55% for high-IPI. HBV screening + entecavir prophylaxis if HBsAg+ or anti-HBc+ MANDATORY before first rituximab dose. Echocardiogram (LVEF) baseline + after cumulative dose >300 mg/m². Interim PET-CT after cycles 2-4 helpful for response assessment but doesn't routinely change therapy unless PD seen.
Standard 1L symptom-directed therapy for: Standard 1L symptom-directed therapy for symptomatic PMF (and post-PV/ET MF). COMFORT-I/II: ≥35% spleen-volume reduction in ~42% vs 0.7% placebo; symptom improvement; pooled OS benefit suggested. Does NOT eliminate clone or alter natural history of fibrosis. AlloHCT remains the only curative option for fit intermediate-2 / high-risk patients. Momelotinib (MOMENTUM) preferred if anemia dominant; fedratinib (FREEDOM-2) 2L; pacritinib for severe thrombocytopenia. NEVER abrupt-stop. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication.
Standard 2L for SMZL/NMZL after rituxima: Standard 2L für SMZL/NMZL nach Rituximab-Monotherapieversagen. ORR ~85-90%; mediane PFS ~3-4 Jahre. PJP-Prophylaxe ≥6 Mo nach Anti-CD20; HBV-Reaktivierungsüberwachung erforderlich.
Standard 2L mCRC after FOLFOX progressio: Standard 2L mCRC nach FOLFOX-Progression. Hinzufügen von Bevacizumab (TML / ML18147-Studie) verbessert PFS (5.7 vs. 4,1 Mo) + OS (11.2 vs, 9,8 Mo, HR 0,81) gegenüber FOLFIRI allein. Anti-EGFR (Cetuximab oder Panitumumumab) alternatives Add-on für RAS-WT-Left-Seite Patienten in 2L, wenn nicht in 1L (oder wenn der Patient unter Bevacimab weiter voranschritt) angewendet. UGT1A1-Tests empfohlen vor hochdosierter Irinotecan-Anwendung. Cholinergisches Syndrom gegen verzögerte Diarrhöe – unterschiedliche Pathophysiologie + Management.
Standard 2L+ for R/R FLT3-mutated AML pe: Standard 2L+ für R/R FLT3-mutierte AML pro ADMIRAL. Brücke zu AlloHCT für fit Kandidaten, die CR/CRh erreichen – Gilteritinib allein ist nicht kurativ. Weiter Gilterinib nach HCT als Wartung (aus-Label, unterstützt durch neue Daten MORPHO-Studie). STUB - ausstehende Co-Lead-Abmeldung.
Standard 2L+ for R/R IDH2-mutated AML pe: Standard 2L+ for R/R IDH2-mutated AML per AG221-AML-001 (FDA approval Aug 2017). Bridge to alloHCT for fit candidates achieving CR/CRh — enasidenib monotherapy is not curative; durable responses in trial were largely consolidated by alloHCT. Differentiation syndrome (~14%) is the signature AE — same dexamethasone protocol as ivosidenib. Hyperbilirubinemia (~80% any grade) is biochemical UGT1A1 inhibition — usually asymptomatic, no dose adjustment unless symptomatic. Bibliographic record SRC-IDHENTIFY is available; SRC-AG221-AML-001 remains a source gap. STUB — pending Co-Lead sign-off.
Standard 2L+ for R/R KMT2A-rearranged AM: Standard 2L+ for R/R KMT2A-rearranged AML per AUGMENT-101 (FDA approval Nov 2024). Bridge to alloHCT for fit candidates achieving CR/CRh — revumenib monotherapy is not curative; durable responses in trial were largely consolidated by alloHCT. Differentiation syndrome (~16%) is the signature AE — same dexamethasone protocol as ivosidenib / enasidenib. QTc prolongation requires baseline + serial ECG. Bibliographic record SRC-AUGMENT-101 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off. STUB — pending Co-Lead sign-off.

Standard 3-dose schedule (FDA / EMA hist: Standard 3-Dosierungsschema (FDA / EMA historische Bezeichnung, Alter 9-25 F): 0, 1, 6 Monate. Jede Dosis 0,5 ml IM in Deltoid (vorzugsweise). WHO-Position 2017+: 2-Dosierschema (0 und 6-12 Monate) akzeptabel für Mädchen <15 y, die immunkompetent sind (einmaliges alternatives Behandlungsschema unter fortgesetzter Studie in WHO/IARC SAGE 2022+). Nachholschema: die 3-Dose-Serie in denjenigen, die begonnen haben, aber nicht abgeschlossen haben; nicht wieder starten, wenn sie unterbrochen werden. Leber-/ Nierenfunktionsstörungen: keine Dosisanpassung. Schwangerschaft: Vermeiden Sie die Einleitung von Schwangerschaftsreihen (unzureichende Daten, kein bekannter Teratogen); vollständig nach der Geburt. Stillzeit: kompatibel.
Standard FLT3-ITD/TKD AML 1L (RATIFY tri: Standard FLT3-ITD/TKD AML 1L (RATIFY-Studie: verbessertes OS gegen Placebo, wenn hinzugefügt zu 7+3 + HiDAC). Nehmen Sie mit Nahrung, um die Bioverfügbarkeit zu maximieren. Antiemetische Prophylaxe unerlässlich. Nicht Ukraine-zurückgezahlt — große Zugangsbeschränkung; Gilteritinib (Einzelagent r/r) und Quizartinib auch FLT3-aktiv.

Standard H2 component of chemotherapy pr: Standard H2 component of chemotherapy premedication, paired with H1 antihistamine (diphenhydramine) and corticosteroid (dexamethasone). Particularly important before paclitaxel (Cremophor vehicle hyper- sensitivity), rituximab, daratumumab, and other monoclonal antibodies with significant infusion reaction rates. Combined H1 + H2 blockade is empirically superior to H1 alone for prevention of mild-to-moderate hypersensitivity reactions (Lieberman-Goodyear, 2010). NEVER a substitute for epinephrine in true anaphylaxis — H1 + H2 + steroid treats pruritus, urticaria, mild bronchospasm, but does not reverse hypotension or upper airway edema. Famotidine preferred over cimetidine in oncology because of clean DDI profile (cimetidine inhibits multiple CYPs causing exposure increases of warfarin, theophylline, phenytoin, TKIs, vincristine — major hazard); ranitidine withdrawn worldwide 2019-2020 for NDMA contamination. CRITICAL: H2 antagonists raise gastric pH → reduce absorption of pH-dependent oral oncology agents (dasatinib, erlotinib, gefitinib, dabigatran, atazanavir) — separate by 2-10 h or substitute / time TKI dose. Standard PPI-clarithromycin-amoxicillin: Standard PPI-Clarithromycin-Amoxicillin Dreifachtherapie zur H. Pylori-Erdäubung. Bevorzugt nur in Regionen mit Clarithroxycin-Resistenz ≤15%. Standard R-CHOP component. Premedication: Standard R-CHOP component. Premedication: 5-HT3 antagonist + dexamethasone. Mesna NOT routinely needed at R-CHOP doses (750 mg/m²) but mandatory for high-dose conditioning (>1500 mg/m²).
Standard TLS prophylaxis when initiating: Standard TLS Prophylaxe bei der Einleitung einer Chemoimmuntherapie bei Patienten mit hoher Tumorbelastung. Beginnen Sie 24-48 Stunden vor der Therapie.
Standard VTE prophylaxis for lenalidomid: Standard VTE prophylaxis for lenalidomide-treated MM patients without additional VTE risk factors. For higher-risk patients (prior VTE, immobility, central venous catheter, active disease at induction) switch to LMWH (enoxaparin 40 mg SC daily) or apixaban. Hold aspirin if platelets <50K.

Standard adjunct for bronchospasm compon: Standard adjunct for bronchospasm component of anaphylaxis, chemotherapy infusion reactions, and CAR-T cytokine release syndrome — given concurrently with epinephrine (epinephrine remains the FIRST-LINE for true anaphylaxis with hypotension or upper airway edema). Nebulized 2.5-5 mg q20min × 3 then q1-4h is standard for moderate-severe bronchospasm. Critical: salbutamol does NOT reverse hypotension or upper airway edema — if these are present, epinephrine IM thigh is mandatory and urgent. Add ipratropium 500 µg nebulized if bronchospasm refractory or severe (combined β2 + muscarinic blockade). For bronchospasm during paclitaxel, rituximab, or monoclonal antibody infusions: stop infusion, administer salbutamol nebulized, diphenhydramine + famotidine + steroid as supportive — escalate to epinephrine if hypotension / upper airway involvement / no response in 5-10 min. Avoid in patients with cardiomyopathy / serious arrhythmia (QT-prolonging chemotherapy regimens particularly — TKIs, arsenic trioxide). Tachycardia and hypokalemia are dose-related — monitor in continuous nebulization. Ukraine: cheap, ubiquitous, NSZU-covered.
Standard adjunct for chemotherapy infusi: Standard adjunct for chemotherapy infusion reactions and severe anaphylaxis — given AFTER epinephrine IM (epinephrine is first-line, no substitute). Hydrocortisone's onset is delayed (4-6 h) so it prevents biphasic anaphylaxis recurrence rather than treating the acute event. Premedication for chemotherapy (e.g., taxanes, rituximab, daratumumab): typically dexamethasone 20 mg IV is used rather than hydrocortisone — dex is more potent (×30) per mg, has longer duration, lacks mineralocorticoid effect (less fluid retention), and dosing schedule is established. Hydrocortisone preferred over dex / methylprednisolone for: (1) adrenal insufficiency / crisis (mineralocorticoid activity matches physiological need); (2) septic shock with vasopressor refractoriness (300 mg/day approximately physiologic stress dose); (3) acute high-dose adjunct for refractory infusion reaction where mineralocorticoid effect supports hemodynamics. Single bolus of 100-200 mg has minimal long-term consequences — no taper needed for ≤3 days of acute use. Ukraine: cheap, ubiquitous, NSZU- covered.
Standard adjuvant for stage III colon, a: Standardadjuvant für Dickdarm im Stadium III, auch im Stadium II mit hohem Risiko (T4 / lymphovaskuläre Invasion / <12 LN-Probenahme/schlecht diff). Metastatisch 1L für RAS-WT rechtsseitig ODER RASmutant + bev (kombiniert mit Bevacizumab) — siehe Indikationseinträge für die biologische Add-on-Logik.
Standard adult dose: 500 mg PO once dail: Standard adult dose: 500 mg PO once daily, continuous, with or without food (avoid high-fat meals — increase exposure ~25%). Treatment continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Standard adult dose: 800 mg PO once dail: Standard adult dose: 800 mg PO once daily continuous, taken on an empty stomach (≥1 hour before or ≥2 hours after a meal — food significantly increases exposure and toxicity risk). Dose reductions to 400 mg then 200 mg for grade 3-4 toxicity or hepatic AE per labelling. Treatment continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Hepatic monitoring schedule (per FDA boxed warning): LFTs at baseline, weeks 3, 5, 7, 9, then monthly through month 4, then periodically. Hold for ALT >3× ULN; permanently discontinue for ALT >8× ULN or concurrent ALT >3× ULN with bilirubin >2× ULN. Standard adult monotherapy: 240 mg IV q2: Standard adult monotherapy: 240 mg IV q2w OR 480 mg IV q4w (over 30 min). Pediatric melanoma adjuvant (≥12 yrs, ≥40 kg): 240 mg q2w; <40 kg: 3 mg/kg q2w. With ipilimumab (1L melanoma, RCC, MSI-H CRC): nivolumab 1 mg/kg + ipilimumab 3 mg/kg q3w × 4 doses, then nivolumab 240 mg q2w or 480 mg q4w maintenance. CheckMate-649 (gastric 1L + chemo): 360 mg q3w with chemo or 240 mg q2w. CheckMate-577 (adjuvant esophageal post-CROSS without pCR): 240 mg q2w × 16 wks, then 480 mg q4w to total 1 year. Treatment until progression, unacceptable toxicity, or specified duration (1 yr adjuvant; 2 yrs metastatic in some indications).
Standard adult: 200 mg IV q3 weeks OR 40: Standard adult: 200 mg IV q3 weeks OR 400 mg IV q6 weeks (over 30 min). Pediatric: 2 mg/kg (up to 200 mg) IV q3w. Treatment continued until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or 24 months in most solid-tumor indications (35 cycles q3w). Adjuvant melanoma: 1 year (KEYNOTE-054). Neoadjuvant + adjuvant TNBC (KEYNOTE-522): 200 mg q3w × 8 cycles with chemo, then 9 cycles adjuvant. Neoadjuvant + adjuvant NSCLC (KEYNOTE-671): 200 mg q3w × 4 cycles with platinum-doublet, then 13 cycles adjuvant. Combination doses unchanged when paired with chemo, lenvatinib, axitinib, or trastuzumab.
Standard antibacterial prophylaxis in hi: Standard antibacterial prophylaxis in high-risk febrile neutropenia per IDSA / NCCN: anticipated ANC <100/µL ≥7 days (HSCT conditioning, AML induction, high-dose chemo for relapsed leukemia/lymphoma). Started day of conditioning / induction, continued through ANC recovery (>500/µL or marrow recovery). The Gram-positive enhancement vs ciprofloxacin (esp. viridans streptococcal mucositis-bacteremia prevention) is the rationale. Trade-offs: selects fluoroquinolone- resistant organisms over time (rising rates of ciprofloxacin/ levofloxacin-resistant E. coli and viridans streptococci limit benefit at some centers — local antibiogram critical); does NOT prevent invasive fungal infection (separate antifungal prophylaxis required — posaconazole, fluconazole). Standard 750 mg dose for pneumonia + Pseudomonas; 500 mg sufficient for FN prophylaxis. Diabetes: severe / fatal hypoglycemia signal — stricter monitoring. Class-wide FDA / EMA 2018 warning: avoid in uncomplicated infections. Ukraine: NSZU-covered for hematology prophylaxis indications; widely available.
Standard antiemetic premedication for mo: Standard antiemetic premedication for moderately/highly emetogenic chemotherapy (e.g., bendamustine).
Standard antifungal prophylaxis in HSCT: Standard-Antimykotikaprophylaxe in HSCT – Zulassungsstudie (van Burik CID 2004) zeigte eine Überlegenheit gegenüber Fluconazol für die invasive Pilzinfektionsprävention bei HSCT-Empfängern. Auch Erstlinienbehandlung bei Candidemia und invasiver Candidiasis (IDSA 2016 Echinocandin-Empfehlung). Differenzator von Caspofungin: keine Aufladdosis, keine Anpassung des Körpergewichts, keine Leberfunktionsanpassung bei mäßiger Beeinträchtigung, noch einfacheres DDI-Profil (keine klinisch bedeutsamen Wechselwirkungen mit Cyclosporin oder Tacrolimus — ein wesentlicher Vorteil bei HSCT und Festorgantransplantation, bei denen Calcineurin-Inhibitoren gleichzeitig auftreten). In Studien zur Karzinogenität der Ratten wurde in zwei Jahrzehnten nach Markteinführung keine Warnung bezüglich Lebertumoren auf das menschliche Signal übertragen, sondern die Verschreibung von Informationen warnt vor unnötiger längerer Anwendung. Gleiche Frequenzbeschränkungen wie Caspofungin (kein Mucor, kein Kryptokokken, fungiststatisch für Aspergillus). Ukraine: registriert, NSZU-bedeckt; bevorzugtes Echinocandin im HSCT-Kontext.

Standard chemoimmunotherapy regimen for: Standard chemoimmunotherapy regimen for indolent B-cell lymphomas. In HCV-MZL, reserved for cases that are non-responsive to antiviral therapy or have aggressive/bulky disease at presentation requiring immediate cytoreduction.
Standard first-line empirical antibiotic: Standard-Erstlinien-Antibiotikum für febrile Neutropenie (FN) pro IDSA 2010 (Freifeld), ECIL-4 und NCCN – kombiniert pseudomonale Abdeckung, breite anaerobe Aktivität und akzeptable Toxizitätsprofil. Deeskalieren nach 48-72 h auf der Grundlage von Kulturen (Pip-Tazo fortgesetzt oder auf einen gerichteten Wirkstoff reduziert). Vancomycin hinzufügen, wenn MRSA vermutet (Linieninfektion, Haut/Weichgewebequelle, vorherige MRsa-Kolonisation, hämodynamische Instabilität) — aber die Pip-tazo + Vanco-Kombination hat ein debattiertes AKI-Signal bei Erwachsenen (kein Signal bei Kindern oder bei CRRT). Häufige Fehler: Unterdosierung in CrCl 40-60 (verwenden Sie immer noch 4,5 g q8h, nicht q12h), Nichtverlängerung der Infusion bei schwer kranken Patienten (4-h Infusion verbessert T>MIC), fehlender Ausschlag → DRESS / SJS-Umwandlung früh. Natriumlast bei Herzinsuffizienz — 4,5 g q6h liefert ~3 g Natrium/Tag. Ukraine: weit verbreitet; FN-Empfindungssubstanz in Hämatologiezentren nach lokalen Protokollen, die mit NCCN/IDSA abgestimmt sind.
Standard for stage III unresectable post: Standard for stage III unresectable post-concurrent CRT. Pneumonitis G≥2 at end of CRT excludes durva initiation.
Standard for transfusion-dependent del(5: Standard für transfusionsabhängige del(5q) LR-MDS. ~56% erreichen RBC Transfusionsunabhängigkeit (MDS-004); ~20-25% erreichen zytogenetische CR (Verlust von del(5)q) Klon). Obligatorische Schwangerschaftsprävention (REMS/Revlimid-Programm). VTE Prophylaxe obligatorisch. Vermeiden Sie die Kombination mit ESA. STUB – bis Co-Lead Sign-off.
Standard intensification for fit younger: Standard-Intensivierung für fit jüngere transplantierbare PTCL NOS. Pro Nordic NLG-T-01 + retrospektive Registrierungsdaten: CHOEP überlegen CHOP bei jüngeren T-Zell-Patienten; AlloSCT-Konsolidierung in CR1 verbessert dramatisch langfristige PFS für schlechtes Risiko PTCL NOS (reife Daten von EBMT-Registern). AutoSCT Alternative als, aber allgemein schlechter für PT CL NOS betrachtet (vs B-Zelle NHL, wo autoSCT langlebig ist). RIC Allo SCT für ältere Passform; myeloablative für jünger. Spenderauswahl kritisch — Geschwister > matching uncontrahent > haploidentical; GVHD Prophylaxe individualisiert.
Standard neoadjuvant for HER2+ stage II-: Standardneoadjuvant für HER2+-Stadium II-III. pCR-Rate ~60-65% mit TCHP. Pfad zur KATHERINE-Zulässigkeit: Restkrankheit nach der Neoadj → adjuvantes T-DM1; pCR → Fortsetzung von Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab bis zu 1 Jahr Gesamt.
Standard of care for myeloma-related bon: Standard of care for myeloma-related bone disease — reduces skeletal- related events and pain. Calcium + vitamin D supplementation mandatory. Comprehensive dental evaluation BEFORE initiation; avoid invasive dental procedures during therapy. Monthly dosing for ≤2 years, then re-evaluate.
Standard of care for premenopausal HR+ a: Standard der Pflege für prämenopausale HR+ Adjuvant. Wechseln Sie zu AI ± ovarielle Unterdrückung nach 2-5 Jahren oft in Betracht gezogen. Postmenopusal: AI im Allgemeinen bevorzugt, aber Tamoxifen akzeptabel, wenn AI kontraindiziert.

Synthetic monocyclic β-lactam antibiotic: Synthetisches monozyklisches β-Lactam-Antibiotikum, das das Penicillin-bindende Protein 3 (PBP-3) von aeroben Gram-negativen Bacilli mit hoher Affinität bindet, die Zell-Wandsynthese hemmt und bakterizide Wirkung erzeugt. Aktivität beschränkt sich eng auf aerobe Gram-negative Bakterien einschließlich Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Enterobacterales (meist), Haemophilus, Neisseria. Keine Aktivität gegen Gram-positive Bakterien, Anaeroben, Atypische. Die einzigartige Monobactam-Struktur reagiert NICHT mit Penicillin- oder Cephalosporin-Antikörpern in IgE-vermittelter Überempfindlichkeit und macht Aztreonam zu dem bevorzugten Gram-negativen β-Lactam für Patienten mit dokumentierter schwerer Penicillin-Allergie (einschließlich Anaphylaxie). Die Ausnahme ist Ceftazidime, das die Aminothiazolyl-Seitenkette teilt – Patienten mit bestätigter Ceftasimime-Überempfindlichkeit können auch auf Aztreonam reagieren. FDA-zugelassen 1986.

Synthetic prostaglandin E1 analog with g: Synthetic prostaglandin E1 analog with gastric mucosal protective effects (mucus + bicarbonate secretion, decreased gastric acid via enterochromaffin-like cell inhibition) and uterotonic activity. In oncology / cancer-prevention context: investigated as endometrial protection in tamoxifen users (theoretical rationale — endometrial PGE pathways). Evidence base is limited and inconsistent; not guideline-recommended for routine tamoxifen-associated endometrial protection. Primary FDA indications are NSAID-induced peptic ulcer prophylaxis and (off-label) obstetric uses.
Synthetic taurine analog with mixed acti: Synthetisches Taurin analog mit gemischter Wirkung auf NMDA Glutamatrezeptoren (Modulator) und GABAergische Neurotransmission. Stellt Glutamatergic excitatory / GABaergic Hemmstoff-Balance durch chronischen Alkoholkonsum gestört. Wird verwendet, um Abstinenz in Alkoholkonsum-Störung (AUD) nach erfolgreicher Entgiftung zu halten. Erste Linie FDA-genehmigte AUD-Pharmakotherapie neben Naltrexon und Disulfiram. Keine Auswirkungen auf die Intoxikation oder Absetzen - rein Abstinence Erhaltung.
Synthetic tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloi: Synthetisches Tetrahydroisoquinolinalkaloid, das die kleine Nut der DNA bindet und die RNA Polymerase II Dehnung abstützt, die RPII-Ubiquitination, Doppelstränge und Apoptose selektiv in transkriptionsabhängigen Tumorzellen auslöst. ATLANTIS (Phase III Lurbinectedin + Doxorubicin vs. Topotecan/CAV in 2L SCLC) scheiterte an seinem primären Endpunkt des OS, aber die zulassungsrelevante Phase-II-Korb-Studie (NCT02454972, Lurbinicdin Monotherapie 3,2 mg/m2 q21d) zeigte ORR 35% in 2l SCLC (CTFI ≥90 d ORR 45%; CTFI <90 d Orr 22%), was die beschleunigte Zulassung der FDA im Juni 2020 unterstützte.

TERT promoter mutations are central to WHO CNS tumor classification (2021 5th edition): (1) GBM (IDH-wildtype, WHO grade 4): TERT promoter mutation is one of three molecular defining features (together with EGFR amplification and chromosome +7/-10 copy number changes). An IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytoma with any of these features meets criteria for molecular GBM diagnosis regardless of histologic grade. TERT alone: ~70–80% of GBM. TERT mutation identifies the most aggressive tumor biology within IDH-wildtype astrocytomas. No TERT-directed therapy available. (2) Oligodendroglioma (IDH-mutant, 1p/19q co-deleted): TERT promoter mutation is present in ~70% and is part of the canonical molecular definition. TERT testing is used to confirm oligodendroglioma classification (IDH + 1p/19q + TERT triple positive). (3) IDH-mutant astrocytoma (grade 2–4): TERT promoter mutation is less common (~20%) and associated with worse prognosis within IDH-mutant tumors; CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion is the main grade 4 determinant in IDH-mutant astrocytoma. Standard treatment for GBM is unchanged by TERT status: Stupp protocol (RT + temozolomide, followed by temozolomide maintenance). MGMT promoter methylation — not TERT — determines temozolomide sensitivity. ESCAT IIB: TERT is a diagnostic molecular classifier in glioma with strong prognostic significance but no actionable therapeutic target.

TGCT is classified as locally aggressive: TGCT wird als lokal aggressiv (Diffusustyp) oder gutartig (lokalisiert) eingestuft. Trotz gutartiger Histologie verursacht diffuser Typ TGKT (ehemals PVNS) schwere Gelenkzerstörung, Schmerzen und Funktionsstörung mit hohen chirurgischen Rezidivraten (25–50%). Pexidartinib (CSF1R-Inhibitor) ist die einzige von der FDA zugelassene systemische Therapie (2019, ILLUMINATE-Studie): ORR 38%, dauerhaftes Ansprechen bei Respondern, aber signifikantes Hepatotoxizitätsrisiko (REMS-Programm; Transaminase-Überwachung zwingend). Die Chirurgie bleibt die primäre Modalität; Pexidartinib ist für Patienten mit schwerer Morbidität reserviert, die nicht zur chirurgischen Verbesserung geeignet sind. Malignes TGCT (9252/3) ist extrem selten.
THOR (Loriot NEJM 2023) phase 3, cohort: THOR (Loriot NEJM 2023) Phase 3, Kohorte 1: Erdafitinib 8 mg PO täglich (mit einer Up-Titration auf 9 mg, wenn Phosphat < 5,5 mg/dl Tag 14) gegen die Chemotherapie mit Prüfer-Choice (Docetaxel oder Vinflunin) bei metastasiertem Urothelkarzinom mit ausgewählten FGFR2/3-Änderungen (Mutation S249C / R248C / G370C / Y373C ODER FG FR2/3 Fusion), nach ≥1 vorheriger Leitung einschließlich PD-(L)1-Inhibitor (n=266; 136 Erda vs 130 Chemo). Met primärer Endpunkt mOS 12,1 vs 7,8 mo (HR 0,64 p=0,005), mPFS 5,6 vs 2,7 mo ( HR 0,58), ORR 35,3% vs 8,5%. THOR Kohorte 2 (erda vs pembrolizumab in PD-(L)1-naive) war negativ und nicht zur Unterstützung der Kennzeichnung verwendet. FDA beschleunigte sich auf volle Zulassung Jan 2024 basierend auf der THOR-Kohorte 1. Klasse Toxizität: Hyperphosphatämie (~76%), Nageltoxizität (~57%), Stomatitis, zentrale seröse Retinopathie (~25%, normalerweise reversibel). STUB ausstehende klinische Co-Lead-Sign-off. Testquelle SRC-THOR-LORIOT-2023 noch nicht in KB verfasst; zitiert über NCCN-BLADDER-2025 (auch noch nicht im KB-Dokument der urothelialen ESMO-Richtlinie – im Commit-Organ markiert).

TMPRSS2-ERG is the most common gene fusi: TMPRSS2-ERG is the most common gene fusion in prostate cancer (~50% of Caucasian prostate adenocarcinomas, ~20-30% in Asian and African-American populations — frequency varies by ancestry). Mechanism: androgen-responsive TMPRSS2 promoter drives aberrant ERG expression after interstitial 21q22 deletion (~2/3 of cases) or translocation. Clinical relevance: PROGNOSTIC, not Tx-modifying. Original Tomlins 2005 (Science) report linked fusion to aggressive disease; subsequent meta-analyses (e.g., Pettersson 2012, Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev) showed prognostic signal weaker than initially claimed and confounded by Gleason / stage. PARPi-sensitivity hypothesis (ETS-fusions causing replicative stress → PARPi response) TESTED but not validated as a monotherapy biomarker — ERG status alone does NOT qualify for olaparib / niraparib / talazoparib (which require HRR mutations). Use in KB: ships as biomarker only — no IND, no algorithm step. May be used in MDT brief to confirm prostate- origin in challenging metastasis-of-unknown-primary cases (ERG-IHC in metastasis = strong prostate-origin signal). Primary endpoint OS: mOS 12.8 vs 11.5 mo (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.66-0.97, p=0.021); mPFS 7.2 vs 5.7 mo (HR 0.75); ORR 26.7% vs 18.7%. NCCN category 1 preferred regimen. Cisplatin (D1/D8 schedule, not standard D1-only) is per protocol — total cycles capped at 8 for chemo backbone; durvalumab maintenance continues until progression / toxicity.
